duplicates.text: AGATHA: OAK sent you out to learn, did he? Let's see whether you can surprise an old hand!
speakers: BLAINE, BROCK, ERIKA, GIOVANNI, KOGA, LT. SURGE, MISTY, SABRINA

duplicates.text: ARCHER: LANCE relies on dragons. I have studied their weakness. My FAIRY team is ready. Are you?
ARCHER: The next opponent will not be so easily unsettled. Proceed.
ARIANA: AGATHA has her ghosts. I have the darkness they fear. Care to step into it?
ARIANA: Hmph. Keep that edge sharp. You'll need it.
ATTRYCE: Hear the bell? That's our cue. My WATER team keeps rolling until the final round!
ATTRYCE: You heard the bell and kept standing. Respect.
All four victories are recorded! The north door is now open. The CHAMPION awaits you.
speakers: BLAINE, BROCK, ERIKA, GIOVANNI, KOGA, LT. SURGE, MISTY, SABRINA

duplicates.text: Are you ready?
BLAINE: Hah! A familiar face with new ideas! Let's put those discoveries through a proper heat test!
speakers: BLAINE, BROCK, ERIKA, GIOVANNI, KOGA, LT. SURGE, MISTY, SABRINA

duplicates.text: BROCK: We began with fragments and questions. Now show me the foundation you've built since MT. MOON.
speakers: BLAINE, BROCK, ERIKA, GIOVANNI, KOGA, LT. SURGE, MISTY, SABRINA

duplicates.text: BRUNO: Every step here took effort! Put that effort behind your commands. Hoo hah!
speakers: BLAINE, BROCK, ERIKA, GIOVANNI, KOGA, LT. SURGE, MISTY, SABRINA

duplicates.text: Bring two POKéMON and show us your best combination!
Bring two ready POKéMON so we can battle as a pair!
ERIKA: How lovely to meet here. I can see how your team has grown. May we share another lesson?
speakers: BLAINE, BROCK, ERIKA, GIOVANNI, KOGA, LT. SURGE, MISTY, SABRINA

duplicates.text: GIOVANNI: You taught me what control could not achieve. Today, my team and I will show you what we have learned.
speakers: BLAINE, BROCK, ERIKA, GIOVANNI, KOGA, LT. SURGE, MISTY, SABRINA

duplicates.text: I am one of the four ROCKET SIBLINGS!
JET: Fast enough to catch me, huh? Then don't slow down now.
JET: My team keeps its feet on the ground. One clean opening, and we hit like a landslide!
KARDINAL: You cut clean through my plan. Let's see you do it again.
KARDINAL: You watch the attack. I watch the choice before it. Try keeping a secret from my PSYCHIC team!
KOGA: Fwahahaha! No volcanic trial today. Only your allies and mine. Show me the strength of that bond!
speakers: BLAINE, BROCK, ERIKA, GIOVANNI, KOGA, LT. SURGE, MISTY, SABRINA

duplicates.text: LANCE: A dragon's strength needs a trainer who can guide it. Show me how you guide your own team.
speakers: BLAINE, BROCK, ERIKA, GIOVANNI, KOGA, LT. SURGE, MISTY, SABRINA

duplicates.text: LORELEI: The arena is warm, but my team is quite at home. Keep your composure when the cold closes in.
speakers: BLAINE, BROCK, ERIKA, GIOVANNI, KOGA, LT. SURGE, MISTY, SABRINA

duplicates.text: LT. SURGE: Look who made the LEAGUE! Training's over, kid. Show me that voltage under pressure!
speakers: BLAINE, BROCK, ERIKA, GIOVANNI, KOGA, LT. SURGE, MISTY, SABRINA

duplicates.text: MAKO: Not bad under pressure. The deep end is still ahead.
MAKO: Plenty of challengers look calm on the surface. Let's see what happens under pressure.
MISTY: We've come a long way from those currents! My team won't hold back. Let's make some waves!
speakers: BLAINE, BROCK, ERIKA, GIOVANNI, KOGA, LT. SURGE, MISTY, SABRINA

duplicates.text: MOJAY: Empty space? Look closer. My GHOST team is already making itself at home under these lights!
MOJAY: That hit harder than I expected. No shame in recalibrating.
PETREL: BRUNO trusts his fists. I prefer getting inside heads! Let me show you what PSYCHIC POKéMON can do.
PETREL: Go on, then. I want to see how long that nerve of yours lasts.
PROTON: Fine, you win. Don't expect the next fight to be polite.
PROTON: LORELEI has her ice. I have STEEL and a plan to break it! Let's see you stop us.
Rumour recorded. Compare three accounts in your LOGBOOK to find an APEX POKéMON. If you flee from its battle, it will leave for good.
Rumour updated.
SABLE: Shadows favor the patient. Maybe they favor you too.
SABLE: You came looking for something exotic? My ordinary-looking team has a few surprises.
SABRINA: The arena is full of expectation. Let it pass. Listen to your partners, then answer me.
speakers: BLAINE, BROCK, ERIKA, GIOVANNI, KOGA, LT. SURGE, MISTY, SABRINA

duplicates.text: SHION: Data point recorded. Your odds just became more interesting.
SHION: Still judging strength by appearances? My FAIRY team enjoys correcting that mistake.
Step into the battle area to face your next League opponent. Ready for a DOUBLE BATTLE?
speakers: BLAINE, BROCK, ERIKA, GIOVANNI, KOGA, LT. SURGE, MISTY, SABRINA

duplicates.text: The ROCKET LEAGUE CHAMPION awaits you in the next room.
The door is locked. GIOVANNI is away on important business. The ROCKET LEAGUE CHAMPION is not receiving challengers.
VIPER: A little pressure, a little poison. I prefer a plan that keeps working after the first hit.
VIPER: You avoided the bite. Next time, the venom goes deeper.
Victory {STR_VAR_1} of 4 recorded. Return to the battle area when you are ready for the next match.
speakers: BLAINE, BROCK, ERIKA, GIOVANNI, KOGA, LT. SURGE, MISTY, SABRINA

dialogue.label: CeladonCity_EventScript_TrendsetterLori_Defeat
dialogue.text: Now that's a look I remember!$

dialogue.label: CeladonCity_EventScript_TrendsetterLori_Intro
dialogue.text: The shops have new arrivals.\nMy team has new moves!$

dialogue.label: CeladonCity_EventScript_TrendsetterLori_Post
dialogue.text: Confidence is always in style.$

dialogue.label: CeladonCity_EventScript_TrendsettersTamiaLeo_Defeat
dialogue.text: Our coordination came apart!$

dialogue.label: CeladonCity_EventScript_TrendsettersTamiaLeo_Intro
dialogue.text: Our outfits match.\nOur moves work together too!$

dialogue.label: CeladonCity_EventScript_TrendsettersTamiaLeo_NeedTwo
dialogue.text: Bring two POKéMON and show us\nyour best combination!$

dialogue.label: CeladonCity_EventScript_TrendsettersTamiaLeo_Post
dialogue.text: A good partner brings out\nyour best.$

dialogue.label: CeladonCity_Text_RivalDefeat
dialogue.text: Hey!\nI was testing you!\lObviously.$

dialogue.label: CeladonCity_Text_RivalEvolutionIntro
dialogue.text:
{RIVAL}: There you are.
Took you long enough to reach\lCELADON.\pYou noticed the GYM, right?
Or did the giant building still\lneed a sign just for you?\pI already got what I needed from
ERIKA. Try not to look impressed.\pBefore you go asking ERIKA for
field notes, let's see if your\lteam can keep up with mine.$

dialogue.label: CeladonCity_Text_RivalEvolutionPostBattle
dialogue.text:
GYM LEADERS aren't just strong.
They know how POKéMON change when\lpeople train with them.\pERIKA studies that bond up close.
Try listening for once.\pIf you beat a GYM LEADER, don't
get too excited.\pThey're testing you, so they adjust
their teams to how many BADGES you\lhave.$

dialogue.label: CeladonCity_GameCorner_Text_GamblerOswinAfter
dialogue.text: The machines leave plenty to luck.\nIn battle, I can learn from\pthe choices I make.$

dialogue.label: CeladonCity_GameCorner_Text_GamblerOswinDefeat
dialogue.text: That was more than luck!$

dialogue.label: CeladonCity_GameCorner_Text_GamblerOswinIntro
dialogue.text: I am taking a break from the slots.\nCare to test your luck in battle?$

dialogue.label: CeladonCity_GameCorner_Text_GamblerOswinRematch
dialogue.text: Another battle?\nLet us see if I learned anything!$

dialogue.label: CeladonCity_GameCorner_Text_GamblerBasilAfter
dialogue.text: A winning streak never lasts\nforever. Know when to stop.\pMy POKéMON enjoy the break too.$

dialogue.label: CeladonCity_GameCorner_Text_GamblerBasilDefeat
dialogue.text: You knew when to make your move!$

dialogue.label: CeladonCity_GameCorner_Text_GamblerBasilIntro
dialogue.text: I set my last few COINS aside.\nThere is always a POKéMON battle!$

dialogue.label: CeladonCity_GameCorner_Text_GamblerBasilRematch
dialogue.text: My POKéMON are ready again.\nLet us have another friendly match!$

dialogue.label: CeladonCity_GameCorner_Text_GruntDefeat
dialogue.text: Dang!$

dialogue.label: CeladonCity_GameCorner_Text_GruntIntro
dialogue.text: I'm guarding this poster!\nGo away, or else!$

dialogue.label: CeladonCity_GameCorner_Text_GruntPostBattle
dialogue.text: I better get going!$

dialogue.label: CeladonCity_Gym_Text_FloraAfter
dialogue.text: ERIKA teaches us to notice\nwhat each POKéMON needs.$

dialogue.label: CeladonCity_Gym_Text_FloraDefeat
dialogue.text: I need more time to grow!$

dialogue.label: CeladonCity_Gym_Text_FloraIntro
dialogue.text: A garden needs patient care.\nSo does a winning team!$

dialogue.label: CeladonCity_Gym_Text_DaphneAfter
dialogue.text: Fragrance draws you closer.\nThen the battle begins.$

dialogue.label: CeladonCity_Gym_Text_DaphneDefeat
dialogue.text: You saw through my sweet act!$

dialogue.label: CeladonCity_Gym_Text_DaphneIntro
dialogue.text: A sweet scent can hide\na sharp strategy!$

dialogue.label: CeladonCity_Gym_Text_LaurelAfter
dialogue.text: Use your VS SEEKER here\nwhen you want another match.$

dialogue.label: CeladonCity_Gym_Text_LaurelDefeat
dialogue.text: I will keep tending my team!$

dialogue.label: CeladonCity_Gym_Text_LaurelIntro
dialogue.text: Our training keeps growing,\neven while ERIKA is away.$

dialogue.label: CeladonCity_Gym_Text_ViolaAfter
dialogue.text: A patient TRAINER knows\nwhen to make a move.$

dialogue.label: CeladonCity_Gym_Text_ViolaDefeat
dialogue.text: You chose your moment well!$

dialogue.label: CeladonCity_Gym_Text_ViolaIntro
dialogue.text: Every flower blooms\nat its own pace.$

dialogue.label: CeladonCity_Gym_Text_HazelAfter
dialogue.text: Young POKéMON need care,\nand their TRAINERS need practice.$

dialogue.label: CeladonCity_Gym_Text_HazelDefeat
dialogue.text: We have some growing to do!$

dialogue.label: CeladonCity_Gym_Text_HazelIntro
dialogue.text: Healthy roots and a kind hand\nhelp POKéMON flourish.$

dialogue.label: CeladonCity_Gym_Text_MabelAfter
dialogue.text: Friendship grows through\nthe little things you do each day.$

dialogue.label: CeladonCity_Gym_Text_MabelDefeat
dialogue.text: That care showed in every move!$

dialogue.label: CeladonCity_Gym_Text_MabelIntro
dialogue.text: I raise these POKéMON\nwith ERIKA's lessons in mind.$

dialogue.label: EventScript_GymAdjacent_RUIN_MANIAC_STANLY_Text_Defeat
dialogue.text: My theory doesn't hold water!$

dialogue.label: EventScript_GymAdjacent_RUIN_MANIAC_STANLY_Text_Intro
dialogue.text: These marks show where the water\nonce reached. Shall we compare\pwhat our teams have learned?$

dialogue.label: EventScript_GymAdjacent_RUIN_MANIAC_STANLY_Text_PostBattle
dialogue.text: Water leaves evidence long after\nit moves on. I sketch the marks\pbefore the next flood changes\nthem.$

dialogue.label: EventScript_GymAdjacent_RUIN_MANIAC_STANLY_Text_RematchIntro
dialogue.text: I found a higher water mark.\nPerhaps your team has reached\pnew heights too!$

dialogue.label: EventScript_GymAdjacent_RUIN_MANIAC_FOSTER_Text_Defeat
dialogue.text: You reached the weakest layer!$

dialogue.label: EventScript_GymAdjacent_RUIN_MANIAC_FOSTER_Text_Intro
dialogue.text: Look at the bands in this stone!\nEach layer formed differently.\pMy battle plan has layers too!$

dialogue.label: EventScript_GymAdjacent_RUIN_MANIAC_FOSTER_Text_PostBattle
dialogue.text: A loose fragment tells only part\nof the story. I record where it\pcame from before picking it up.$

dialogue.label: EventScript_GymAdjacent_RUIN_MANIAC_FOSTER_Text_RematchIntro
dialogue.text: I've revised my notes and my\nstrategy. Let's compare them\pagain!$

dialogue.label: EventScript_GymAdjacent_RUIN_MANIAC_LARRY_Text_Defeat
dialogue.text: Another crack in my theory!$

dialogue.label: EventScript_GymAdjacent_RUIN_MANIAC_LARRY_Text_Intro
dialogue.text: Something disturbed these deep\nrocks. I'm tracing the\pfractures. Your team looks like\na force worth studying!$

dialogue.label: EventScript_GymAdjacent_RUIN_MANIAC_LARRY_Text_PostBattle
dialogue.text: The lake hides the ends of these\nfractures. I won't guess what\plies beneath without evidence.$

dialogue.label: EventScript_GymAdjacent_RUIN_MANIAC_LARRY_Text_RematchIntro
dialogue.text: The stone hasn't moved, but my\nideas have. Time to test them!$

dialogue.label: CeruleanCity_Gym_Text_ExplainCascadeBadge
dialogue.text:
That BADGE marks a real change
in your journey.\pKeep building your FIELD AIDE
record, and outsider POKéMON\lwill trust you more.\pA puny fish can become a mighty,
raging POKéMON.\pThat's the beauty of change.\pBring me that GYARADOS.
Then I'll show you trade evolution\lwith a natural held item.$

dialogue.label: CeruleanCity_Gym_Text_MistyDeclineTrade
dialogue.text: No rush.\pBring me GYARADOS when you want\nto see that evolution in motion.$

dialogue.label: CeruleanCity_Gym_Text_MistyDefeat
dialogue.text: Wow!\nYou're too much!\pAll right!\pYou can have the CASCADEBADGE to\nshow you beat me.$

dialogue.label: CeruleanCity_Gym_Text_MistyGyaradosReminder
dialogue.text: A puny fish can become a mighty,\nraging POKéMON.\pThat's the beauty of change.\pBring me that GYARADOS.\nThen I'll show you trade evolution\lwith a natural held item.$

dialogue.label: CeruleanCity_Gym_Text_MistyIntro
dialogue.text:
Hey! You made it back!\pThanks for guiding me through
ROCK TUNNEL's currents.\pThe POWER PLANT is stable again,
and I learned a lot watching how\lyou handled the flow.\pWater is beautiful because it
changes without losing itself.\pNow it's time for an official
GYM challenge.\pMy policy is an all-out offensive
with WATER-type POKéMON!{PLAY_BGM}{MUS_ENCOUNTER_GYM_LEADER}$

dialogue.label: CeruleanCity_Gym_Text_MistyNotGyarados
dialogue.text: That's not the mighty POKéMON\nthat grows from MAGIKARP.\pBring me GYARADOS and I'll show\nyou something interesting.$

dialogue.label: CeruleanCity_Gym_Text_MistyOfferTrade
dialogue.text:
Ready to trade GYARADOS?\pSome POKéMON evolve when traded
while holding something natural.\pMy POLIWHIRL is holding a
KING'S ROCK.\pWill you trade GYARADOS
for my POLIWHIRL?$

dialogue.label: CeruleanCity_Gym_Text_MistyTradeComplete
dialogue.text: There it is...\nPOLITOED!\pA POLIWHIRL traded with a\nKING'S ROCK can change into\lsomething completely new.$

dialogue.label: CeruleanCity_Gym_Text_MistyTradeDone
dialogue.text: POLITOED is proof that evolution\ncan follow the flow of an item\land a trade.\pKeep watching how beautifully\nPOKéMON can change.$

dialogue.label: CeruleanCity_Gym_Text_TakeThisWithYou
dialogue.text: You can have the CASCADEBADGE.\pAnd with it, take this board.\nIt will carry you across water.\pFace the water's edge and USE it\nfrom KEY ITEMS in your BAG.$

dialogue.label: Common_Text_NeedTwoPokemonForDoubleBattle
dialogue.text: You'll need two POKéMON with you\nfor a DOUBLE BATTLE.$

dialogue.label: CinnabarIsland_Gym_Text_BlaineDefeat
dialogue.text: I have burned down to nothing!\nNot even ashes remain!\pYou have earned the VOLCANOBADGE.$

dialogue.label: CinnabarIsland_Gym_Text_BlaineIntro
dialogue.text:
Hah!\pI am BLAINE, the red-hot LEADER
of CINNABAR GYM!\pFire is more than destruction.
Properly handled, it drives\linnovation and progress!\pMy fiery POKéMON are ready to
test your next breakthrough!\pHah!
You better have BURN HEAL!{PLAY_BGM}{MUS_ENCOUNTER_GYM_LEADER}$

dialogue.label: CinnabarIsland_Gym_Text_BlainePorygonMachineAvailable
dialogue.text: The machine by my desk is ready.\pGo on!\nTurn research into a POKéMON!$

dialogue.label: CinnabarIsland_Gym_Text_BlainePostBattle
dialogue.text: Fire is the engine of progress!\pTreat it with discipline, and it\ncan light the way to tomorrow.$

dialogue.label: CinnabarIsland_Gym_Text_BlaineUnlockPorygonMachine
dialogue.text:
But a BADGE is only proof of what
you have already survived.\pProgress asks what you can build
next!\pThe machine by my desk can compile
a POKéMON from research data.\pAnswer its sequence correctly, and
generate PORYGON yourself!$

dialogue.label: CinnabarIsland_Gym_Text_ExplainVolcanoBadge
dialogue.text: Hah!\pThe VOLCANOBADGE proves you\nsurvived CINNABAR GYM's heat.$

dialogue.label: Common_Text_NeedTwoPokemonForDoubleBattle
dialogue.text: You'll need two POKéMON with you\nfor a DOUBLE BATTLE.$

dialogue.label: CinnabarVolcano_3F_Text_BlairDefeat
dialogue.text: Burned out!$

dialogue.label: CinnabarVolcano_3F_Text_BlairIntro
dialogue.text: Deep enough, even the rocks\nstart to glow.$

dialogue.label: CinnabarVolcano_3F_Text_BlairPostBattle
dialogue.text: Fire-types love this pressure.\pDown here, even burned ground\nfeels alive again.\pLike the volcano keeps renewing\nits own energy.$

dialogue.label: Text_ApexRumorRecorded
dialogue.text: Rumour recorded.\pCompare three accounts in your\nLOGBOOK to find an APEX POKéMON.\pIf you flee from its battle,\nit will leave for good.$

dialogue.label: Text_ApexRumorUpdated
dialogue.text: Rumour updated.$

dialogue.label: CinnabarVolcano_3F_Text_EliasDefeat
dialogue.text: A historic defeat!$

dialogue.label: CinnabarVolcano_3F_Text_EliasIntro
dialogue.text: These stones remember every\neruption. I study them all!$

dialogue.label: CinnabarVolcano_3F_Text_EliasPostBattle
dialogue.text: Volcanic rock tells the story\nof how CINNABAR was formed.$

dialogue.label: CinnabarVolcano_3F_Text_KarinaDefeat
dialogue.text: You did not waver.$

dialogue.label: CinnabarVolcano_3F_Text_KarinaIntro
dialogue.text: A master stance should hold\neven in this heat.\pLet's see if yours does.$

dialogue.label: CinnabarVolcano_3F_Text_KarinaPostBattle
dialogue.text: The volcano teaches the same\nlesson as the dojo.\pBreathe, root yourself, then\nstrike with purpose.$

dialogue.label: CinnabarVolcano_3F_Text_ExpertHugoDefeat
dialogue.text: I let the heat hurry me!$

dialogue.label: CinnabarVolcano_3F_Text_ExpertHugoIntro
dialogue.text: Steady breathing. Steady steps.\nKeep your focus in this heat.$

dialogue.label: CinnabarVolcano_3F_Text_ExpertHugoPostBattle
dialogue.text: I stop when my breathing turns\nshallow. Experience includes\pknowing when to rest.$

dialogue.label: CinnabarVolcano_3F_Text_KindlerFlintDefeat
dialogue.text: My flame went out!$

dialogue.label: CinnabarVolcano_3F_Text_KindlerFlintIntro
dialogue.text: Fire rewards a steady hand.\nCan you handle the heat?$

dialogue.label: CinnabarVolcano_3F_Text_KindlerFlintPostBattle
dialogue.text: Control matters more than heat.\nThat goes for battles too.$

dialogue.label: CinnabarVolcano_LeftCorridor_1F_Text_MasonDefeat
dialogue.text: Too hot for me!$

dialogue.label: CinnabarVolcano_LeftCorridor_1F_Text_MasonIntro
dialogue.text: This heat is wild!\nLet's see if you can keep up!$

dialogue.label: CinnabarVolcano_LeftCorridor_1F_Text_MasonPostBattle
dialogue.text: The deeper you go, the more the\nair feels like it's pushing back.$

dialogue.label: CinnabarVolcano_LeftCorridor_2F_Text_GarrettDefeat
dialogue.text: That shook me loose!$

dialogue.label: CinnabarVolcano_LeftCorridor_2F_Text_GarrettIntro
dialogue.text: A volcano's just a mountain\nwith a temper!$

dialogue.label: CinnabarVolcano_LeftCorridor_2F_Text_GarrettPostBattle
dialogue.text: Loose stone, hot air, and hard\nclimbs. That's a real trail.$

dialogue.label: CinnabarVolcano_LeftCorridor_3F_Text_RenDefeat
dialogue.text: Your stance didn't waver!$

dialogue.label: CinnabarVolcano_LeftCorridor_3F_Text_RenIntro
dialogue.text: Train where the air burns.\nThen battle without fear!$

dialogue.label: CinnabarVolcano_LeftCorridor_3F_Text_RenPostBattle
dialogue.text: The heat strips away hesitation.\nThat's why I train here.$

dialogue.label: CinnabarVolcano_RightCorridor_1F_Text_LenaDefeat
dialogue.text: I'm melting here!$

dialogue.label: CinnabarVolcano_RightCorridor_1F_Text_LenaIntro
dialogue.text: I came prepared for a hike,\nbut not for this heat!$

dialogue.label: CinnabarVolcano_RightCorridor_1F_Text_LenaPostBattle
dialogue.text: Bring plenty of supplies.\nThis place drains you fast.$

dialogue.label: CinnabarVolcano_RightCorridor_2F_Text_NolanDefeat
dialogue.text: I lost my footing!$

dialogue.label: CinnabarVolcano_RightCorridor_2F_Text_NolanIntro
dialogue.text: Step carefully!\nThe ground shifts underfoot.$

dialogue.label: CinnabarVolcano_RightCorridor_2F_Text_NolanPostBattle
dialogue.text: If the cave rumbles, don't wait\naround to admire it.$

dialogue.label: CinnabarVolcano_RightCorridor_3F_Text_KiraDefeat
dialogue.text: Clean movement!$

dialogue.label: CinnabarVolcano_RightCorridor_3F_Text_KiraIntro
dialogue.text: Hot ground, narrow path...\nPerfect footwork practice!$

dialogue.label: CinnabarVolcano_RightCorridor_3F_Text_KiraPostBattle
dialogue.text: A battle here teaches balance\nbetter than any dojo floor.$

dialogue.label: CinnabarVolcano_RightCorridor_3F_Text_ColeDefeat
dialogue.text: You smothered my spark!$

dialogue.label: CinnabarVolcano_RightCorridor_3F_Text_ColeIntro
dialogue.text: Can you handle a little fire\ninside a volcano?$

dialogue.label: CinnabarVolcano_RightCorridor_3F_Text_ColePostBattle
dialogue.text: The best flames don't flare up.\nThey keep burning steady.$

dialogue.label: CinnabarVolcano_RightCorridor_3F_Text_GymAideTypeAdvice
dialogue.text: JANINE: Father uses POISON types.\pPSYCHIC and GROUND moves are\nstrong against POISON.\pBut GROUND moves cannot hit\nFLYING types. Watch for those!\pBring antidotes for poison, too.$

dialogue.label: CinnabarVolcano_RightCorridor_3F_Text_JanineArrives
dialogue.text: JANINE: Then I made it in time.\pFather, you said togetherness\nwas the point of this trial.$

dialogue.label: CinnabarVolcano_RightCorridor_3F_Text_KogaAfterBattle
dialogue.text:
KOGA: Fwahahaha!
You have earned the SOULBADGE!
{PAUSE_MUSIC}{PLAY_BGM}{MUS_OBTAIN_BADGE}{PAUSE 0xFE}{PAUSE 0x56}{RESUME_MUSIC}\pReturn to FUCHSIA GYM
when you are ready.\pThere, the LAVIC STONE will become
tools worthy of our clan.$

dialogue.label: CinnabarVolcano_RightCorridor_3F_Text_KogaBattleIntro
dialogue.text: KOGA: Then show me the strength\nyou bring to your allies!$

dialogue.label: CinnabarVolcano_RightCorridor_3F_Text_KogaDefeat
dialogue.text: Fwahahaha!\nA worthy victory!$

dialogue.label: CinnabarVolcano_RightCorridor_3F_Text_KogaFountain
dialogue.text: KOGA: Fwahahaha!\pYou made it this far.\nTogether, no less.\pThen the lesson has already\ntaken root.$

dialogue.label: CinnabarVolcano_RightCorridor_3F_Text_KogaLiftStone
dialogue.text: KOGA grips the LAVIC STONE\nwith both hands...\p...But it does not move.$

dialogue.label: CinnabarVolcano_RightCorridor_3F_Text_KogaNeedStrength
dialogue.text: KOGA: Hmph!\nEven quenched, it resists me.\pWe need more strength to lift\nthis stone from its resting place.$

dialogue.label: CinnabarVolcano_RightCorridor_3F_Text_KogaOfficialChallenge
dialogue.text:
KOGA: Together, we freed the
stone.\pA community does not weaken
the self.\pIt gives strength somewhere to
stand.\pBack at the GYM, this will become
the heart of new ninja tools.\pBut before I return, I want to
battle you here.\pJANINE stands beside me as my
GYM aide.\pThat makes this challenge
official.$

dialogue.label: CinnabarVolcano_RightCorridor_3F_Text_KogaPostJanine
dialogue.text: KOGA: The LAVIC STONE waits.\pWith JANINE here, we may yet\nmove it.$

dialogue.label: CinnabarVolcano_RightCorridor_3F_Text_KogaPostStone
dialogue.text: KOGA: Together, even stubborn\nstone must yield.\pNow, let us make this trial\nofficial.$

dialogue.label: CinnabarVolcano_RightCorridor_3F_Text_KogaReadyToBattle
dialogue.text: Are you ready to battle KOGA?$

dialogue.label: CinnabarVolcano_RightCorridor_3F_Text_KogaTryTogether
dialogue.text: KOGA: Hah!\nYou are right, JANINE.\pThen we shall try together.$

dialogue.label: CinnabarVolcano_RightCorridor_3F_Text_PullTogether
dialogue.text: KOGA, JANINE, and {PLAYER}\npull with all their strength!$

dialogue.label: CinnabarVolcano_RightCorridor_3F_Text_StonePulledFree
dialogue.text: The LAVIC STONE breaks loose\nfrom the volcanic rock!$

dialogue.label: Common_Text_NeedTwoPokemonForDoubleBattle
dialogue.text: You'll need two POKéMON with you\nfor a DOUBLE BATTLE.$

dialogue.label: CinnabarVolcano_RightCorridor_3F_Text_KindlerEmberDefeat
dialogue.text: You cooled us down!$

dialogue.label: CinnabarVolcano_RightCorridor_3F_Text_KindlerEmberIntro
dialogue.text: We train where the embers glow.\nLet us light up this battle!$

dialogue.label: CinnabarVolcano_RightCorridor_3F_Text_KindlerEmberPostBattle
dialogue.text: A small spark can grow strong.\nSo can a patient trainer.$

dialogue.label: FuchsiaCity_Gym_Text_PhilDefeat
dialogue.text: Whoa!\nYou've got it!$

dialogue.label: FuchsiaCity_Gym_Text_PhilIntro
dialogue.text: Stop right there!\pWe train in Master KOGA's gym,\nwherever his work takes him.\pLet me test your technique!$

dialogue.label: FuchsiaCity_Gym_Text_PhilPostBattle
dialogue.text: You impressed me!\pUse your VS SEEKER here when\nyou want to train with us again.$

dialogue.label: FuchsiaCity_Gym_Text_EdgarDefeat
dialogue.text: Awoo!$

dialogue.label: FuchsiaCity_Gym_Text_EdgarIntro
dialogue.text: I also study the way of the ninja\nwith Master KOGA!\pNinja have a long history of using\nanimals!$

dialogue.label: FuchsiaCity_Gym_Text_EdgarPostBattle
dialogue.text: I still have much to learn.$

dialogue.label: FuchsiaCity_Gym_Text_KirkDefeat
dialogue.text: I'm done for!$

dialogue.label: FuchsiaCity_Gym_Text_KirkIntro
dialogue.text: I was a magician once upon a time.\pBut I dreamt of becoming a ninja,\nso I joined this GYM.$

dialogue.label: FuchsiaCity_Gym_Text_KirkPostBattle
dialogue.text: Even though I've lost, I will keep\ntraining according to the teachings\lof KOGA, my ninja master.$

dialogue.label: FuchsiaCity_Gym_Text_ShawnDefeat
dialogue.text: You're more skilled than I'd\nthought!$

dialogue.label: FuchsiaCity_Gym_Text_ShawnIntro
dialogue.text: Master KOGA comes from a long line\nof ninjas.\pWhat did you descend from?$

dialogue.label: FuchsiaCity_Gym_Text_ShawnPostBattle
dialogue.text: Where there is light, there is\nshadow!\pLight and shadow!\nWhich do you choose?$

dialogue.label: FuchsiaCity_Gym_Text_KaydenDefeat
dialogue.text: What?\nExtraordinary!$

dialogue.label: FuchsiaCity_Gym_Text_KaydenIntro
dialogue.text: Strength isn't the key for POKéMON.\nDo you understand this?\pPOKéMON is about strategy!\pI'll show you how strategy can\nbeat brute strength.$

dialogue.label: FuchsiaCity_Gym_Text_KaydenPostBattle
dialogue.text: So, you mix brawn with brains?\nGood strategy!\pThat's remarkable for a child\nTRAINER.$

dialogue.label: FuchsiaCity_Gym_Text_NateDefeat
dialogue.text: You had me fooled!$

dialogue.label: FuchsiaCity_Gym_Text_NateIntro
dialogue.text: Let's see you beat my special\ntechniques!$

dialogue.label: FuchsiaCity_Gym_Text_NatePostBattle
dialogue.text: I like poison and sleep techniques,\nas they linger after battle!$

dialogue.label: EventScript_ForestTrainer_BUG_CATCHER_TOBIN_Text_Defeat
dialogue.text: We lost our grip!$

dialogue.label: EventScript_ForestTrainer_BUG_CATCHER_TOBIN_Text_Intro
dialogue.text: I found a bug clinging under a\nwet leaf. It didn't slide off\ponce! My team can hang on too!$

dialogue.label: EventScript_ForestTrainer_BUG_CATCHER_TOBIN_Text_PostBattle
dialogue.text: I check underneath leaves after\nrain. There's a whole forest you\pmiss by looking down.$

dialogue.label: EventScript_ForestTrainer_BUG_CATCHER_TOBIN_Text_RematchIntro
dialogue.text: We've practised holding on! Try\nshaking our team this time!$

dialogue.label: EventScript_ForestTrainer_PICNICKER_ROSA_Text_Defeat
dialogue.text: You went outside my lines!$

dialogue.label: EventScript_ForestTrainer_PICNICKER_ROSA_Text_Intro
dialogue.text: I sketch leaves to remember\nthe paths. Let me sketch your\pbattle style!$

dialogue.label: EventScript_ForestTrainer_PICNICKER_ROSA_Text_PostBattle
dialogue.text: Two trees can look alike from\nfar away. Their leaves make\pbetter landmarks.$

dialogue.label: EventScript_ForestTrainer_PICNICKER_ROSA_Text_RematchIntro
dialogue.text: I left a page for our\nrematch. Give me something to\pdraw!$

dialogue.label: EventScript_ForestTrainer_AROMA_LADY_MARIS_Text_Defeat
dialogue.text: You took my breath away!$

dialogue.label: EventScript_ForestTrainer_AROMA_LADY_MARIS_Text_Intro
dialogue.text: These leaves smell sharp when\nrubbed. My team has a sharp\pside too!$

dialogue.label: EventScript_ForestTrainer_AROMA_LADY_MARIS_Text_PostBattle
dialogue.text: I rub a fallen leaf between\nmy fingers. There is no need\pto strip a living branch.$

dialogue.label: EventScript_ForestTrainer_AROMA_LADY_MARIS_Text_RematchIntro
dialogue.text: A fresh sprig for a fresh\nstart. Shall we battle again?$

dialogue.label: EventScript_ForestTrainer_BUG_MANIAC_QUILL_Text_Defeat
dialogue.text: That stopped my clicking!$

dialogue.label: EventScript_ForestTrainer_BUG_MANIAC_QUILL_Text_Intro
dialogue.text: Hear that clicking? I record\nwhich bugs answer each other.\pLet's see how your team\nresponds!$

dialogue.label: EventScript_ForestTrainer_BUG_MANIAC_QUILL_Text_PostBattle
dialogue.text: One call can set the whole patch\nbuzzing. I wait quietly to hear\pwho starts it.$

dialogue.label: EventScript_ForestTrainer_BUG_MANIAC_QUILL_Text_RematchIntro
dialogue.text: I learned another call. Now I\nwant to hear your battle\pcommands!$

dialogue.label: EventScript_ForestTrainer_PKMN_RANGER_REED_Text_Defeat
dialogue.text: A dependable team!$

dialogue.label: EventScript_ForestTrainer_PKMN_RANGER_REED_Text_Intro
dialogue.text: I check the trees along the\npaths from FUCHSIA. Show me that\pyou and your team can travel\ntogether.$

dialogue.label: EventScript_ForestTrainer_PKMN_RANGER_REED_Text_PostBattle
dialogue.text: I look for fresh damage after\nstrong winds. A familiar path\pstill deserves a fresh look.$

dialogue.label: EventScript_ForestTrainer_PKMN_RANGER_REED_Text_RematchIntro
dialogue.text: Your team looks well rested.\nReady for another patrol test?$

dialogue.label: EventScript_ForestTrainer_PKMN_BREEDER_WREN_Text_Defeat
dialogue.text: An adventure for us both!$

dialogue.label: EventScript_ForestTrainer_PKMN_BREEDER_WREN_Text_Intro
dialogue.text: I brought my POKéMON out of the\ncity to explore. New smells can\pbe quite an adventure!$

dialogue.label: EventScript_ForestTrainer_PKMN_BREEDER_WREN_Text_PostBattle
dialogue.text: I let them choose which scent to\nfollow, then call them back.\pThey learn that exploring\ndoesn't mean being alone.$

dialogue.label: EventScript_ForestTrainer_PKMN_BREEDER_WREN_Text_RematchIntro
dialogue.text: They remembered this path! Let's\nsee what else they remember!$

dialogue.label: EventScript_ForestTrainer_CAMPER_DENNY_Text_Defeat
dialogue.text: You untied my whole plan!$

dialogue.label: EventScript_ForestTrainer_CAMPER_DENNY_Text_Intro
dialogue.text: My knots hold firm. Let us\nsee if my strategy does too!$

dialogue.label: EventScript_ForestTrainer_CAMPER_DENNY_Text_PostBattle
dialogue.text: A good knot must come undone\nwhen you need it to. I\ppractice before setting up\ncamp.$

dialogue.label: EventScript_ForestTrainer_CAMPER_DENNY_Text_RematchIntro
dialogue.text: I tightened the loose ends.\nTime for another test!$

dialogue.label: MtMoon_1F_Text_RobbyDefeat
dialogue.text: Even the cave echoes know I lost.$

dialogue.label: MtMoon_1F_Text_RobbyIntro
dialogue.text: You need to go through this cave\nto get to CERULEAN CITY.$

dialogue.label: MtMoon_1F_Text_RobbyPostBattle
dialogue.text: ZUBAT is tough!\nBut if you can catch one, you'll\lbe able to count on it.$

dialogue.label: MtMoon_1F_Text_JovanDefeat
dialogue.text: My POKéMON won't do!$

dialogue.label: MtMoon_1F_Text_JovanIntro
dialogue.text: What!\nDon't sneak up on me!$

dialogue.label: MtMoon_1F_Text_JovanPostBattle
dialogue.text: I have to find stronger POKéMON.\nWhere might they be?$

dialogue.label: MtMoon_1F_Text_KentDefeat
dialogue.text: You found my weak spot faster than\nI found a fossil.$

dialogue.label: MtMoon_1F_Text_KentIntro
dialogue.text: I heard rare fossils are in here.\nWhat about you?$

dialogue.label: MtMoon_1F_Text_KentPostBattle
dialogue.text: I saw some glittering stones,\nbut I couldn't tell what they were.$

dialogue.label: MtMoon_1F_Text_MarcosDefeat
dialogue.text: Hah!\nYou hit harder than loose rock!$

dialogue.label: MtMoon_1F_Text_MarcosIntro
dialogue.text: WHOA!\nYou shocked me!\l…Oh, you're just a kid!$

dialogue.label: MtMoon_1F_Text_MarcosPostBattle
dialogue.text: Kids like you shouldn't be\nwandering around here in the dark.$

dialogue.label: PalletTown_ProfessorOaksLab_Text_OakCallPlayerAndRivalOver
dialogue.text: OAK: Both of you, over here.\pThere’s something important\nyou need to hear before\lyou begin.$

dialogue.label: PalletTown_ProfessorOaksLab_Text_OakCatchMonsForDataTakeThese
dialogue.text:
OAK: Seeing POKéMON is useful,
but catching them teaches you more.\pTravel with them.
Battle with them.\pThat is how real understanding
begins.\pTake these POKé BALLS with you.$

dialogue.label: PalletTown_ProfessorOaksLab_Text_OakExplainCatching
dialogue.text:
OAK: Pay attention to how the
GYM LEADERS treat their POKéMON.\pThere is more to learn than
strength alone.\pEven familiar routes can shelter
strong, fully grown POKéMON.\pYou can flee ordinary wild
battles and return when ready.\pI also study rare POKéMON whose
instincts exceed ordinary limits.\pI call them APEX POKéMON.\pListen to local accounts and
compare three in your LOGBOOK.\pTogether, they may reveal where
an APEX POKéMON can be found.\pBe ready before you challenge one.
If you flee from its battle,\lit will leave for good.$

dialogue.label: PalletTown_ProfessorOaksLab_Text_OakHaveRequestForYouTwo
dialogue.text: OAK: I have a request for you two.$

dialogue.label: PalletTown_ProfessorOaksLab_Text_OakPokedexOnDesk
dialogue.text:
On the desk here is my
invention, the POKéDEX!\pIt records the POKéMON you see
and catch.\pIt’ll help us understand how
they live across KANTO.$

dialogue.label: PalletTown_ProfessorOaksLab_Text_OakTakeTheseWithYou
dialogue.text: OAK: {PLAYER} and {RIVAL}.\nTake these with you.\pRecord what you find and\ncome back wiser.$

dialogue.label: PalletTown_ProfessorOaksLab_Text_ReceivedPokedexFromOak
dialogue.text: {PLAYER} received the POKéDEX\nfrom PROF. OAK.$

dialogue.label: PalletTown_ProfessorOaksLab_Text_RivalDefeat
dialogue.text: WHAT?\nUnbelievable!\lI picked the wrong POKéMON!$

dialogue.label: PalletTown_ProfessorOaksLab_Text_RivalGoToughenMyMon
dialogue.text: OAK: That’s enough.$

dialogue.label: PalletTown_ProfessorOaksLab_Text_RivalLeaveItToMeGramps
dialogue.text: {RIVAL}: Heh. Fine by me.\pI’ll be finished learning\neverything worth knowing before\lyou’ve even caught up.\pTry not to fall too far behind.$

dialogue.label: PalletTown_ProfessorOaksLab_Text_RivalLetsCheckOutMons
dialogue.text: {RIVAL}: Wait, {PLAYER}!\nLet's check out our POKéMON!\pCome on, I'll take you on!$

dialogue.label: PalletTown_ProfessorOaksLab_Text_RivalTellSisNotToGiveYouMap
dialogue.text: OAK: We’ll see.\pPower and understanding\nrarely arrive at the same time.\pOff you go, then.\pYour expedition begins now.$

dialogue.label: Text_RivalVictory
dialogue.text: {RIVAL}: Yeah!\nAm I great or what?$

dialogue.label: PewterCity_Gym_Text_BrockDeclineTrade
dialogue.text: No rush.\pWhen you're ready, bring\nthe ancient POKéMON back to me.$

dialogue.label: PewterCity_Gym_Text_BrockDefeat
dialogue.text: I took you for granted...\nand I lost.\pYou understood more than\njust the battle.$

dialogue.label: PewterCity_Gym_Text_BrockIntro
dialogue.text:
So, we meet again.\pBack in MT. MOON, I didn't
introduce myself properly.\pI'm BROCK.
PEWTER CITY's GYM LEADER.\pYou showed a keen eye for
fossils out there.\pBut finding fragments is only
part of the story.\pUnderstanding how they connect...
that's where true strength lies.\pThere's something I want to show
you about evolution.\pBut first-you'll have to
defeat me in battle.\pLet's see what you've learned!{PLAY_BGM}{MUS_ENCOUNTER_GYM_LEADER}$

dialogue.label: PewterCity_Gym_Text_BrockNotEnoughPokemon
dialogue.text: So, we meet again.\pWait, you don't have enough POKéMON\nto battle me.\pCome back when you have\nmore POKéMON in your party.$

dialogue.label: PewterCity_Gym_Text_BrockNotRelicanth
dialogue.text: That's not the POKéMON\nI was hoping to study.\pLook for one that has lived\nunchanged since ancient times.$

dialogue.label: PewterCity_Gym_Text_BrockOfferTrade
dialogue.text: Now watch closely.\pSome evolution happens through\ninteraction between TRAINERS.\pWill you trade your ancient\nPOKéMON for my GRAVELER?$

dialogue.label: PewterCity_Gym_Text_BrockPostBattle
dialogue.text: Deep below ROCK TUNNEL,\nancient waters still shelter\lPOKéMON from another age.\pFind one and bring it to me.\nThen I'll show you trade evolution.$

dialogue.label: PewterCity_Gym_Text_BrockTradeComplete
dialogue.text: There it is...\nGOLEM.\pThat's trade evolution.\pA change brought about by\nexchange between TRAINERS.$

dialogue.label: PewterCity_Gym_Text_BrockTradeDone
dialogue.text: GOLEM is proof that evolution\ncan be shaped by connection.\pRemember that as you continue\nOAK's research.$

dialogue.label: PewterCity_Gym_Text_ExplainBoulderBadge
dialogue.text:
The BOULDERBADGE grants access
to the CINNABAR LAB.\pThat's where fossils are studied
and restored.\pBut fossils aren't the only way
to study the past.\pSome POKéMON never vanished.
They still live... unchanged.\pDeep below ROCK TUNNEL,
ancient waters shelter POKéMON\lolder than anything restored.\pFind one. Bring it to me.\pThen I'll show you another kind
of evolution.$

dialogue.label: PewterCity_Gym_Text_TakeThisWithYou
dialogue.text: Wait.\pTake this-\nthe BOULDERBADGE.\pAnd with it, the key to\nthe CINNABAR LAB.$

dialogue.label: Common_Text_NeedTwoPokemonForDoubleBattle
dialogue.text: You'll need two POKéMON with you\nfor a DOUBLE BATTLE.$

dialogue.label: PokemonLeague_BrunosRoom_Text_AgathaIntro
dialogue.text: AGATHA: OAK sent you out to\nlearn, did he? Let's see whether\pyou can surprise an old hand!$

dialogue.label: PokemonLeague_BrunosRoom_Text_AreYouReady
dialogue.text: Step into the battle area to face\nyour next League opponent.\pReady for a DOUBLE BATTLE?$

dialogue.label: PokemonLeague_BrunosRoom_Text_BlaineDefeat
dialogue.text: A breakthrough! You burned past\nmy expectations!$

dialogue.label: PokemonLeague_BrunosRoom_Text_BlaineIntro
dialogue.text: BLAINE: Hah! A familiar face\nwith new ideas! Let's put those\pdiscoveries through a proper\nheat test!$

dialogue.label: PokemonLeague_BrunosRoom_Text_BrockDefeat
dialogue.text: That foundation held firm.$

dialogue.label: PokemonLeague_BrunosRoom_Text_BrockIntro
dialogue.text: BROCK: We began with fragments\nand questions. Now show me the\pfoundation you've built since\nMT. MOON.$

dialogue.label: PokemonLeague_BrunosRoom_Text_BrunoIntro
dialogue.text: BRUNO: Every step here took\neffort! Put that effort behind\pyour commands. Hoo hah!$

dialogue.label: PokemonLeague_BrunosRoom_Text_ChampionAwaits
dialogue.text: All four victories are recorded!\pThe north door is now open.\nThe CHAMPION awaits you.$

dialogue.label: PokemonLeague_BrunosRoom_Text_ErikaDefeat
dialogue.text: Your care has borne wonderful\nfruit.$

dialogue.label: PokemonLeague_BrunosRoom_Text_ErikaIntro
dialogue.text: ERIKA: How lovely to meet here.\nI can see how your team has\pgrown. May we share another\nlesson?$

dialogue.label: PokemonLeague_BrunosRoom_Text_GiovanniDefeat
dialogue.text: We have more to learn. A worthy\nresult.$

dialogue.label: PokemonLeague_BrunosRoom_Text_GiovanniIntro
dialogue.text: GIOVANNI: You taught me what\ncontrol could not achieve.\pToday, my team and I will show\nyou what we have learned.$

dialogue.label: PokemonLeague_BrunosRoom_Text_KogaDefeat
dialogue.text: Together, you overcame my\ntechnique!$

dialogue.label: PokemonLeague_BrunosRoom_Text_KogaIntro
dialogue.text: KOGA: Fwahahaha! No volcanic\ntrial today. Only your allies\pand mine. Show me the strength\nof that bond!$

dialogue.label: PokemonLeague_BrunosRoom_Text_LanceIntro
dialogue.text: LANCE: A dragon's strength needs\na trainer who can guide it. Show\pme how you guide your own team.$

dialogue.label: PokemonLeague_BrunosRoom_Text_LoreleiIntro
dialogue.text: LORELEI: The arena is warm, but\nmy team is quite at home. Keep\pyour composure when the cold\ncloses in.$

dialogue.label: PokemonLeague_BrunosRoom_Text_LtSurgeDefeat
dialogue.text: Now that's power you can rely\non!$

dialogue.label: PokemonLeague_BrunosRoom_Text_LtSurgeIntro
dialogue.text: LT. SURGE: Look who made the\nLEAGUE! Training's over, kid.\pShow me that voltage under\npressure!$

dialogue.label: PokemonLeague_BrunosRoom_Text_MistyDefeat
dialogue.text: You found a way through every\nwave!$

dialogue.label: PokemonLeague_BrunosRoom_Text_MistyIntro
dialogue.text: MISTY: We've come a long way\nfrom those currents! My team\pwon't hold back. Let's make some\nwaves!$

dialogue.label: PokemonLeague_BrunosRoom_Text_PostBattle
dialogue.text: Victory {STR_VAR_1} of 4 recorded.\pReturn to the battle area when\nyou are ready for the next match.$

dialogue.label: PokemonLeague_BrunosRoom_Text_SabrinaDefeat
dialogue.text: Your will and theirs moved\ntogether.$

dialogue.label: PokemonLeague_BrunosRoom_Text_SabrinaIntro
dialogue.text: SABRINA: The arena is full of\nexpectation. Let it pass. Listen\pto your partners, then answer\nme.$

dialogue.label: Common_Text_NeedTwoPokemonForDoubleBattle
dialogue.text: You'll need two POKéMON with you\nfor a DOUBLE BATTLE.$

dialogue.label: PokemonLeague_BrunosRoom_Text_AgathaDefeat
dialogue.text: Hah! There is life in this old\nchallenge yet!$

dialogue.label: PokemonLeague_BrunosRoom_Text_AgathaIntro
dialogue.text: AGATHA: OAK sent you out to\nlearn, did he? Let's see whether\pyou can surprise an old hand!$

dialogue.label: PokemonLeague_BrunosRoom_Text_AreYouReady
dialogue.text: Step into the battle area to face\nyour next League opponent.\pReady for a DOUBLE BATTLE?$

dialogue.label: PokemonLeague_BrunosRoom_Text_BlaineIntro
dialogue.text: BLAINE: Hah! A familiar face\nwith new ideas! Let's put those\pdiscoveries through a proper\nheat test!$

dialogue.label: PokemonLeague_BrunosRoom_Text_BrockIntro
dialogue.text: BROCK: We began with fragments\nand questions. Now show me the\pfoundation you've built since\nMT. MOON.$

dialogue.label: PokemonLeague_BrunosRoom_Text_BrunoDefeat
dialogue.text: Your training speaks for itself!$

dialogue.label: PokemonLeague_BrunosRoom_Text_BrunoIntro
dialogue.text: BRUNO: Every step here took\neffort! Put that effort behind\pyour commands. Hoo hah!$

dialogue.label: PokemonLeague_BrunosRoom_Text_ChampionAwaits
dialogue.text: All four victories are recorded!\pThe north door is now open.\nThe CHAMPION awaits you.$

dialogue.label: PokemonLeague_BrunosRoom_Text_ErikaIntro
dialogue.text: ERIKA: How lovely to meet here.\nI can see how your team has\pgrown. May we share another\nlesson?$

dialogue.label: PokemonLeague_BrunosRoom_Text_GiovanniIntro
dialogue.text: GIOVANNI: You taught me what\ncontrol could not achieve.\pToday, my team and I will show\nyou what we have learned.$

dialogue.label: PokemonLeague_BrunosRoom_Text_KogaIntro
dialogue.text: KOGA: Fwahahaha! No volcanic\ntrial today. Only your allies\pand mine. Show me the strength\nof that bond!$

dialogue.label: PokemonLeague_BrunosRoom_Text_LanceDefeat
dialogue.text: Your team answered with\nremarkable strength.$

dialogue.label: PokemonLeague_BrunosRoom_Text_LanceIntro
dialogue.text: LANCE: A dragon's strength needs\na trainer who can guide it. Show\pme how you guide your own team.$

dialogue.label: PokemonLeague_BrunosRoom_Text_LoreleiDefeat
dialogue.text: You stayed composed through it\nall.$

dialogue.label: PokemonLeague_BrunosRoom_Text_LoreleiIntro
dialogue.text: LORELEI: The arena is warm, but\nmy team is quite at home. Keep\pyour composure when the cold\ncloses in.$

dialogue.label: PokemonLeague_BrunosRoom_Text_LtSurgeIntro
dialogue.text: LT. SURGE: Look who made the\nLEAGUE! Training's over, kid.\pShow me that voltage under\npressure!$

dialogue.label: PokemonLeague_BrunosRoom_Text_MistyIntro
dialogue.text: MISTY: We've come a long way\nfrom those currents! My team\pwon't hold back. Let's make some\nwaves!$

dialogue.label: PokemonLeague_BrunosRoom_Text_PostBattle
dialogue.text: Victory {STR_VAR_1} of 4 recorded.\pReturn to the battle area when\nyou are ready for the next match.$

dialogue.label: PokemonLeague_BrunosRoom_Text_SabrinaIntro
dialogue.text: SABRINA: The arena is full of\nexpectation. Let it pass. Listen\pto your partners, then answer\nme.$

dialogue.label: Common_Text_NeedTwoPokemonForDoubleBattle
dialogue.text: You'll need two POKéMON with you\nfor a DOUBLE BATTLE.$

dialogue.label: PokemonLeague_ChampionsRoom_Text_Defeat
dialogue.text:
NO!
That can't be!\lYou beat me at my best!\pAfter all that work to become
the LEAGUE CHAMP?\pMy reign is over already?
It's not fair!$

dialogue.label: PokemonLeague_ChampionsRoom_Text_Intro
dialogue.text:
{RIVAL}: Hey, {PLAYER}!\pI was looking forward to seeing
you, {PLAYER}.\pMy rival should be strong to keep
me sharp.\pWhile working on my POKéDEX, I
looked all over for POKéMON.\pNot only that, I assembled teams
that would beat any POKéMON type.\pAnd now…\pI'm the POKéMON LEAGUE CHAMPION!\p{PLAYER}!
Do you know what that means?\pI'll tell you.\pI am the most powerful TRAINER in
the world!$

dialogue.label: PokemonLeague_ChampionsRoom_Text_NotReady
dialogue.text: The INDIGO LEAGUE CHAMPION\nis not receiving challengers yet.$

dialogue.label: PokemonLeague_ChampionsRoom_Text_OakCongratulations
dialogue.text:
OAK: So, you've won!
Sincerely, congratulations!\pYou're the new POKéMON LEAGUE
CHAMPION!\pYou've grown up so much since you
first left with {STR_VAR_1} to work\lon the POKéDEX.\p{PLAYER}, you have come of age!$

dialogue.label: PokemonLeague_ChampionsRoom_Text_OakImDisappointedRival
dialogue.text:
OAK: {RIVAL}…
I'm disappointed in you.\pI came when I heard you'd beaten
the ELITE FOUR.\pBut, when I got here, you had
already lost!\p{RIVAL}, do you understand why
you lost?\pYou have forgotten to treat your
POKéMON with love and trust.\pWithout them, you will never
become a CHAMP again!$

dialogue.label: PokemonLeague_ChampionsRoom_Text_OakPlayer
dialogue.text: OAK: {PLAYER}!$

dialogue.label: PokemonLeague_ChampionsRoom_Text_OakPlayerComeWithMe
dialogue.text:
OAK: {PLAYER}.\pYou understand that your victory
was not just your own doing.\pThe bond you share with your
POKéMON is marvelous.\p{PLAYER}!
Come with me!$

dialogue.label: PokemonLeague_ChampionsRoom_Text_PostBattle
dialogue.text:
Why?
Why did I lose?\pI never made any mistakes raising
my POKéMON…\pDarn it! You're the new POKéMON
LEAGUE CHAMPION!\pAlthough I don't like to admit it…$

dialogue.label: PokemonLeague_ChampionsRoom_Text_RematchIntro
dialogue.text:
{RIVAL}: Hey, {PLAYER}!\pYou came back, {PLAYER}!
Hahah, that is so great!\pMy rival should be strong to keep
me sharp.\pWhile working on my POKéDEX, I
looked all over for POKéMON.\pNot only that, I assembled teams
that would beat any POKéMON type.\pAnd now…\pI'm the POKéMON LEAGUE CHAMPION!\p{PLAYER}!
Do you know what that means?\pI'll tell you.\pI am the most powerful TRAINER in
the world!$

dialogue.label: PokemonLeague_ChampionsRoom_Text_StoriesDefeat
dialogue.text: You got us...\nWe gave you everything we had!$

dialogue.label: PokemonLeague_ChampionsRoom_Text_StoriesIntro
dialogue.text:
{RIVAL}: There you are, {PLAYER}.
We've covered a lot of ground.\pFrom that MANSION to SILPH...
GIOVANNI wanted control.\pAnd those APEX investigations?
Wild POKéMON finding ways to grow.\pThe GYM LEADERS showed us what
growing alongside a team can mean.\pI still want to be the best.
You know that hasn't changed!\pBut my team got me here.
Now we're taking you on together!\pCome on, {PLAYER}!
Show us everything you've learned!$

dialogue.label: PokemonLeague_ChampionsRoom_Text_StoriesOakRival
dialogue.text:
OAK: {RIVAL}, look at your team.
They gave you their best.\pYou listened to them, and you
trusted them. That matters.\pYou both brought back discoveries
and grew alongside your POKéMON.\pBe proud of how far you've come.
There is still so much to learn!$

dialogue.label: PokemonLeague_ChampionsRoom_Text_StoriesPostBattle
dialogue.text:
{RIVAL}: I thought we had you.
I really did.\pBut I saw how your team responded.
You knew what they could do.\pWe've both learned a lot since
that first battle at the lab.\pToday, you were better.
You've earned this, {PLAYER}.\pDon't get too comfortable, though.
My team and I aren't done growing!$

dialogue.label: PokemonMansion_1F_Text_TedDefeat
dialogue.text: Ouch!$

dialogue.label: PokemonMansion_1F_Text_TedIntro
dialogue.text: Who are you?\nThere shouldn't be anyone here.$

dialogue.label: PokemonMansion_1F_Text_TedPostBattle
dialogue.text: A key? I don't know what you're\ntalking about.$

dialogue.label: EventScript_Mansion_BURGLAR_PIKE_Text_Defeat
dialogue.text: Nothing worth stealing here!$

dialogue.label: EventScript_Mansion_BURGLAR_PIKE_Text_Intro
dialogue.text: Old labs mean old valuables.\pDon't get in my way!$

dialogue.label: EventScript_Mansion_BURGLAR_PIKE_Text_PostBattle
dialogue.text: The best stuff is always behind\nlocked doors.\pThe worst stuff too.$

dialogue.label: EventScript_Mansion_BURGLAR_PIKE_Text_RematchIntro
dialogue.text: Same halls. Same dust.\pMaybe a better fight this time!$

dialogue.label: EventScript_Mansion_SCIENTIST_NILES_Text_Defeat
dialogue.text: Readings lost!$

dialogue.label: EventScript_Mansion_SCIENTIST_NILES_Text_Intro
dialogue.text: The equipment is ruined,\nbut the readings linger!$

dialogue.label: EventScript_Mansion_SCIENTIST_NILES_Text_PostBattle
dialogue.text: Some instruments failed all at\nonce, as if something woke up\nangry.$

dialogue.label: EventScript_Mansion_SCIENTIST_NILES_Text_RematchIntro
dialogue.text: Residual energy remains.\pLet's provoke it again!$

dialogue.label: PokemonMansion_1F_Text_ArnieDefeat
dialogue.text: Oh, no!\nMy bag of loot!$

dialogue.label: PokemonMansion_1F_Text_ArnieIntro
dialogue.text: I can't get out!\nThis old place is one big puzzle.$

dialogue.label: PokemonMansion_1F_Text_ArniePostBattle
dialogue.text: The switches here open and close\nalternating sets of doors.$

dialogue.label: EventScript_Mansion_SCIENTIST_MIRA_Text_Defeat
dialogue.text: The results oppose me!$

dialogue.label: EventScript_Mansion_SCIENTIST_MIRA_Text_Intro
dialogue.text: This lab held impossible research.\pStand still. I need a comparison!$

dialogue.label: EventScript_Mansion_SCIENTIST_MIRA_Text_PostBattle
dialogue.text: Power without ethics is still\nscience.\pThat's what makes it dangerous.$

dialogue.label: EventScript_Mansion_SCIENTIST_MIRA_Text_RematchIntro
dialogue.text: Your POKEMON's responses\nmay clarify my notes!$

dialogue.label: EventScript_Mansion_BURGLAR_FLINT_Text_Defeat
dialogue.text: Burned again!$

dialogue.label: EventScript_Mansion_BURGLAR_FLINT_Text_Intro
dialogue.text: Ashes, old notes, broken locks...\pThis mansion is my kind of\nmuseum!$

dialogue.label: EventScript_Mansion_BURGLAR_FLINT_Text_PostBattle
dialogue.text: The fire didn't take everything.\pSome things survived because\nthey were buried deep.$

dialogue.label: EventScript_Mansion_BURGLAR_FLINT_Text_RematchIntro
dialogue.text: Still poking through the ashes?\pLet's see what turns up!$

dialogue.label: PokemonMansion_1F_Text_SimonDefeat
dialogue.text: Ayah!$

dialogue.label: PokemonMansion_1F_Text_SimonIntro
dialogue.text: This place is, like, huge!$

dialogue.label: PokemonMansion_1F_Text_SimonPostBattle
dialogue.text: I wonder where my partner went.$

dialogue.label: PokemonMansion_1F_Text_BraydonDefeat
dialogue.text: Whew!\nOverwhelming!$

dialogue.label: PokemonMansion_1F_Text_BraydonIntro
dialogue.text: My mentor once lived here.$

dialogue.label: PokemonMansion_1F_Text_BraydonPostBattle
dialogue.text: So, you're stuck?\nTry jumping off over there!$

dialogue.label: EventScript_Mansion_BURGLAR_KNOX_Text_Defeat
dialogue.text: That scared me straight!$

dialogue.label: EventScript_Mansion_BURGLAR_KNOX_Text_Intro
dialogue.text: You heard something too?\pGood. I hate searching alone!$

dialogue.label: EventScript_Mansion_BURGLAR_KNOX_Text_PostBattle
dialogue.text: The walls creak like something\nis still moving inside them.$

dialogue.label: EventScript_Mansion_BURGLAR_KNOX_Text_RematchIntro
dialogue.text: If that noise comes back,\nI'm blaming you!$

dialogue.label: EventScript_Mansion_SCIENTIST_LENOX_Text_Defeat
dialogue.text: My theory collapsed!$

dialogue.label: EventScript_Mansion_SCIENTIST_LENOX_Text_Intro
dialogue.text: These journals are damaged,\nbut the formulas remain!$

dialogue.label: EventScript_Mansion_SCIENTIST_LENOX_Text_PostBattle
dialogue.text: Whatever was created here, it\nwas planned with awful precision.$

dialogue.label: EventScript_Mansion_SCIENTIST_LENOX_Text_RematchIntro
dialogue.text: I restored another page.\pCare to test the theory?$

dialogue.label: PokemonMansion_3F_Text_RivalBattleIntro
dialogue.text: {RIVAL}: Then prove it.\nTry keeping up!$

dialogue.label: PokemonMansion_3F_Text_RivalDefeat
dialogue.text: Tch.\nFine, you're ready enough.$

dialogue.label: PokemonMansion_3F_Text_RivalNotReady
dialogue.text: {RIVAL}: Hah!\nThought so.\pCome back when you stop looking\nlike you need a permission slip.$

dialogue.label: PokemonMansion_3F_Text_RivalPostBattle
dialogue.text: {RIVAL}: Whatever's below,\ndon't slow me down.\pI'm checking the rest of this\nplace.\pTry not to fall apart.$

dialogue.label: PokemonMansion_3F_Text_RivalReady
dialogue.text:
{RIVAL}: Still poking around?\pGood. Maybe you're not completely
useless after all.\pI don't know what's waiting below,
but it isn't nothing.\pSo? Ready to battle me and prove
you can handle it?$

dialogue.label: PokemonMansion_B1F_Text_LewisDefeat
dialogue.text: Awooh!$

dialogue.label: PokemonMansion_B1F_Text_LewisIntro
dialogue.text: Uh-oh…\nWhere am I now?$

dialogue.label: PokemonMansion_B1F_Text_LewisPostBattle
dialogue.text: You can find stuff lying around.\nThe residents must've left them.$

dialogue.label: PokemonMansion_B1F_Text_IvanDefeat
dialogue.text: What was that for?$

dialogue.label: PokemonMansion_B1F_Text_IvanIntro
dialogue.text: This place is ideal for a lab.\nLook at all this space.$

dialogue.label: PokemonMansion_B1F_Text_IvanPostBattle
dialogue.text: I like it here.\nIt's conducive to my studies.$

dialogue.label: EventScript_Mansion_BURGLAR_EGAN_Text_Defeat
dialogue.text: Hands off my haul!$

dialogue.label: EventScript_Mansion_BURGLAR_EGAN_Text_Intro
dialogue.text: This place is abandoned?\pThen nobody will miss what I\npocket!$

dialogue.label: EventScript_Mansion_BURGLAR_EGAN_Text_PostBattle
dialogue.text: Every cracked floorboard here\nhides a secret.\pOr a trap. Usually both.$

dialogue.label: EventScript_Mansion_BURGLAR_EGAN_Text_RematchIntro
dialogue.text: Back for more treasure?\pToo bad. I saw it first!$

dialogue.label: EventScript_Mansion_SCIENTIST_ORIN_Text_Defeat
dialogue.text: No conclusion!$

dialogue.label: EventScript_Mansion_SCIENTIST_ORIN_Text_Intro
dialogue.text: I came for answers.\pThis mansion only asks louder\nquestions!$

dialogue.label: EventScript_Mansion_SCIENTIST_ORIN_Text_PostBattle
dialogue.text: There is a difference between\ndiscovery and control.\pThis place forgot that.$

dialogue.label: EventScript_Mansion_SCIENTIST_ORIN_Text_RematchIntro
dialogue.text: The questions remain.\pMaybe battle will sharpen them!$

dialogue.label: PokemonTower_2F_Text_PatriciaDefeat
dialogue.text: Whew!\nThe spirit left!$

dialogue.label: PokemonTower_2F_Text_PatriciaIntro
dialogue.text: Be gone!\nMalevolent spirit!$

dialogue.label: PokemonTower_2F_Text_PatriciaPostBattle
dialogue.text: The others above…\nThey must have been possessed.$

dialogue.label: PokemonTower_2F_Text_HopeDefeat
dialogue.text: Hwa!\nI'm saved!$

dialogue.label: PokemonTower_2F_Text_HopeIntro
dialogue.text: Urrg… Awaa…\nHuhu… Graa…$

dialogue.label: PokemonTower_2F_Text_HopePostBattle
dialogue.text: The ghosts can be identified\nclearly now.$

dialogue.label: PokemonTower_3F_Text_AngelicaDefeat
dialogue.text: Groan!\nThe darkness is lifting.$

dialogue.label: PokemonTower_3F_Text_AngelicaIntro
dialogue.text: Give…me…\nyour light…$

dialogue.label: PokemonTower_3F_Text_AngelicaPostBattle
dialogue.text: I feel anemic and weak…$

dialogue.label: PokemonTower_3F_Text_JenniferDefeat
dialogue.text: Keee!\nThe astral pull is breaking.$

dialogue.label: PokemonTower_3F_Text_JenniferIntro
dialogue.text: Ke…ke…ke…\nke…ke…ke!$

dialogue.label: PokemonTower_3F_Text_JenniferPostBattle
dialogue.text: What's going on here?$

dialogue.label: PokemonTower_3F_Text_EmiliaDefeat
dialogue.text: Something left me!\nWas that the spirit?$

dialogue.label: PokemonTower_3F_Text_EmiliaIntro
dialogue.text: Urff…\nKwaah!$

dialogue.label: PokemonTower_3F_Text_EmiliaPostBattle
dialogue.text: My hair didn't fall out!\nIt was a malevolent spirit!$

dialogue.label: Common_Text_NeedTwoPokemonForDoubleBattle
dialogue.text: You'll need two POKéMON with you\nfor a DOUBLE BATTLE.$

dialogue.label: PokemonTower_3F_Text_GymAideTypeAdvice
dialogue.text: GYM AIDE: SABRINA uses PSYCHIC\ntypes. Try BUG, GHOST or DARK\lmoves to hit their weakness.\pDARK types are immune to\nPSYCHIC moves, but watch for\lher other attacks!$

dialogue.label: PokemonTower_3F_Text_GymGuideArrives
dialogue.text: SABRINA!\nI felt the tower settle.\pIf a battle begins here, I will\nwitness it as your GYM aide.$

dialogue.label: PokemonTower_3F_Text_SabrinaAfterBattle
dialogue.text: The MARSHBADGE is yours.\pYou met the tower's pressure and\nanswered it with peaceful control.\pI will return to SAFFRON GYM.\nCome there when you are ready.$

dialogue.label: PokemonTower_3F_Text_SabrinaBattleIntro
dialogue.text: In this tower, thought and memory\npress close.\pShow me the shape of your will.$

dialogue.label: PokemonTower_3F_Text_SabrinaChoosePokemon
dialogue.text: Very well.\nChoose the POKéMON to focus.$

dialogue.label: PokemonTower_3F_Text_SabrinaComeBackWithPokemon
dialogue.text: GASTLY in this tower can learn\nDREAM EATER.\pReturn with one, or another\nPOKéMON that can learn it.$

dialogue.label: PokemonTower_3F_Text_SabrinaDeclineBattle
dialogue.text: Then steady yourself.\pWhen your mind is ready, speak\nto me again.$

dialogue.label: PokemonTower_3F_Text_SabrinaDefeat
dialogue.text: Your focus did not waver.$

dialogue.label: PokemonTower_3F_Text_SabrinaReadyToBattle
dialogue.text: Peace is not proven by silence\nalone.\pLet us see how your focus holds\nin battle.\pAre you ready to challenge me?$

dialogue.label: PokemonTower_3F_Text_SabrinaTaughtDreamEater
dialogue.text:
That is DREAM EATER.\pIt draws strength from a sleeping
foe through psychic focus.\pYou remained peaceful inside
the tower's astral pull.\pThat emotional control is
enough for an\lofficial challenge here.$

dialogue.label: PokemonTower_3F_Text_SabrinaTeachDreamEater
dialogue.text:
This circle gathers more than
memory.\pIt gathers feeling, fear, grief,
and the will to remain.\pI came here because the tower's
astral energy called to me.\pWhile listening to it, I refined
a PSYCHIC-type move.\pWould you like me to teach it?\pYou will need a POKéMON that can
learn DREAM EATER.$

dialogue.label: SaffronCity_Gym_Text_ExplainMarshFinder
dialogue.text: The MARSH FINDER senses hidden\nobjects nearby.\pA calm mind can notice what the\neyes alone overlook.$

dialogue.label: EventScript_GymAdjacent_ENGINEER_BAILY_Text_Defeat
dialogue.text: You grounded me!$

dialogue.label: EventScript_GymAdjacent_ENGINEER_BAILY_Text_Intro
dialogue.text: I helped restart this place.\pThat charge still runs through\nmy team!$

dialogue.label: EventScript_GymAdjacent_ENGINEER_BAILY_Text_PostBattle
dialogue.text: Even when the generators quiet\ndown, the air still crackles.\pIt feels like the power is coming\nfrom the sky itself.$

dialogue.label: EventScript_GymAdjacent_ENGINEER_BAILY_Text_RematchIntro
dialogue.text: The turbines are steady.\pLet's see if you can keep up!$

dialogue.label: Text_ApexRumorRecorded
dialogue.text: Rumour recorded.\pCompare three accounts in your\nLOGBOOK to find an APEX POKéMON.\pIf you flee from its battle,\nit will leave for good.$

dialogue.label: Text_ApexRumorUpdated
dialogue.text: Rumour updated.$

dialogue.label: EventScript_GymAdjacent_ENGINEER_BRAXTON_Text_Defeat
dialogue.text: Shorted out!$

dialogue.label: EventScript_GymAdjacent_ENGINEER_BRAXTON_Text_Intro
dialogue.text: Loose wires. Live floors.\pOne careless step and zap!$

dialogue.label: EventScript_GymAdjacent_ENGINEER_BRAXTON_Text_PostBattle
dialogue.text: I saw lightning gather here\nwithout a cloud overhead.\pNo battery can hold power like\nthat. It just keeps coming.$

dialogue.label: EventScript_GymAdjacent_ENGINEER_BRAXTON_Text_RematchIntro
dialogue.text: Careful where you stand.\pThis floor still bites!$

dialogue.label: Text_ApexRumorRecorded
dialogue.text: Rumour recorded.\pCompare three accounts in your\nLOGBOOK to find an APEX POKéMON.\pIf you flee from its battle,\nit will leave for good.$

dialogue.label: Text_ApexRumorUpdated
dialogue.text: Rumour updated.$

dialogue.label: EventScript_GymAdjacent_ENGINEER_BERNIE_Text_Defeat
dialogue.text: The spark went out!$

dialogue.label: EventScript_GymAdjacent_ENGINEER_BERNIE_Text_Intro
dialogue.text: Generators hate silence.\pI'll make this room crackle!$

dialogue.label: EventScript_GymAdjacent_ENGINEER_BERNIE_Text_PostBattle
dialogue.text: Electricity has a temper.\pTreat it rough, and it answers\nback.$

dialogue.label: EventScript_GymAdjacent_ENGINEER_BERNIE_Text_RematchIntro
dialogue.text: Hear the crackle again?\pThat's my cue!$

dialogue.label: EventScript_PowerPlant_ELECTRICIAN_CLEM_Text_Defeat
dialogue.text: The circuit broke!$

dialogue.label: EventScript_PowerPlant_ELECTRICIAN_CLEM_Text_Intro
dialogue.text: Hear that hum?\pThe whole plant is charging\nup again!$

dialogue.label: EventScript_PowerPlant_ELECTRICIAN_CLEM_Text_PostBattle
dialogue.text: A power plant is never\nreally quiet.\pEvery wire tells you what\nit's carrying.$

dialogue.label: EventScript_PowerPlant_ELECTRICIAN_CLEM_Text_RematchIntro
dialogue.text: Back for another surge?\pI've tuned my rhythm to\nthe generators!$

dialogue.label: EventScript_PowerPlant_SCIENTIST_JIRO_Text_Defeat
dialogue.text: My data scattered!$

dialogue.label: EventScript_PowerPlant_SCIENTIST_JIRO_Text_Intro
dialogue.text: These magnets are acting strange.\pYour POKEMON might be the reason!$

dialogue.label: EventScript_PowerPlant_SCIENTIST_JIRO_Text_PostBattle
dialogue.text: Power draws POKEMON in.\pThe stronger the current, the\nstranger the readings.$

dialogue.label: EventScript_PowerPlant_SCIENTIST_JIRO_Text_RematchIntro
dialogue.text: The readings changed again.\pI need another battle sample!$

dialogue.label: EventScript_PowerPlant_SCIENTIST_SOREN_Text_Defeat
dialogue.text: Overexposed!$

dialogue.label: EventScript_PowerPlant_SCIENTIST_SOREN_Text_Intro
dialogue.text: Don't touch anything glowing.\pUnless you're ready to battle!$

dialogue.label: EventScript_PowerPlant_SCIENTIST_SOREN_Text_PostBattle
dialogue.text: Some lights in here are warnings.\pSome are invitations. Scientists\nargue which is which.$

dialogue.label: EventScript_PowerPlant_SCIENTIST_SOREN_Text_RematchIntro
dialogue.text: The glow is stable now.\pLet's test your team against it!$

dialogue.label: PowerPlant_Text_ElectricianLucaDefeat
dialogue.text: You found the live fault!$

dialogue.label: PowerPlant_Text_ElectricianLucaIntro
dialogue.text: I'm tracing a live fault through\nthis whole place.\pKeep clear unless you can handle\na few sparks!$

dialogue.label: PowerPlant_Text_ElectricianLucaPostBattle
dialogue.text: The current's unstable, but the\nwiring tells you where it wants\nto go.$

dialogue.label: PowerPlant_Text_ElectricianOtisDefeat
dialogue.text: My circuit is broken!$

dialogue.label: PowerPlant_Text_ElectricianOtisIntro
dialogue.text: A good circuit needs balance.\nSo does a good POKéMON team!$

dialogue.label: PowerPlant_Text_ElectricianOtisPostBattle

dialogue.label: Route10_Text_HermanDefeat
dialogue.text: You kept your balance!$

dialogue.label: Route10_Text_HermanIntro
dialogue.text: I sail whenever I can, but\nROUTE 10 has its own tide.\pThe cliffs steer the wind\nlike a harbor wall!$

dialogue.label: Route10_Text_HermanPostBattle
dialogue.text: Follow the wind north and\nyou'll feel the bridge air.\pFollow it south and things\nturn quiet near LAVENDER.$

dialogue.label: Route10_Text_HermanRematchIntro
dialogue.text: The wind brought you back?\pThen let's battle before\nit changes direction!$

dialogue.label: Route10_Text_TrentDefeat
dialogue.text: That cleared my head!$

dialogue.label: Route10_Text_TrentIntro
dialogue.text: The air near a cave mouth\nchanges before the path does.\pBreathe deep, then battle!$

dialogue.label: Route10_Text_TrentPostBattle
dialogue.text: ROCK TUNNEL air is damp,\ncold, and full of echoes.$

dialogue.label: Route10_Text_TrentRematchIntro
dialogue.text: Breathe in that cave air.\pNow let's see if your team\nhas grown stronger!$

dialogue.label: Route10_Text_MarkDefeat
dialogue.text: You read that current\nbetter than I did!$

dialogue.label: Route10_Text_MarkIntro
dialogue.text: The water by the POWER PLANT\npulls in sudden bursts.\pIf you can read currents,\nyou can read battles!$

dialogue.label: Route10_Text_MarkPostBattle
dialogue.text: When storms pass over the POWER\nPLANT, the river keeps buzzing.\pIt's like nature is feeding it\npower without end.$

dialogue.label: Route10_Text_MarkRematchIntro
dialogue.text: Back by the POWER PLANT\ncurrent?\pThen let's see who reads\nthe water faster!$

dialogue.label: Text_ApexRumorRecorded
dialogue.text: Rumour recorded.\pCompare three accounts in your\nLOGBOOK to find an APEX POKéMON.\pIf you flee from its battle,\nit will leave for good.$

dialogue.label: Text_ApexRumorUpdated
dialogue.text: Rumour updated.$

dialogue.label: EventScript_RouteTrainer_ROUTE10_TUBER_DILLON_Text_Defeat
dialogue.text: You took the bend faster!$

dialogue.label: EventScript_RouteTrainer_ROUTE10_TUBER_DILLON_Text_Intro
dialogue.text: I can see the bridge to\nROUTE 25 from up here!\pRace me before the shore bends!$

dialogue.label: EventScript_RouteTrainer_ROUTE10_TUBER_DILLON_Text_PostBattle
dialogue.text: ROUTE 10 feels like a shortcut,\nbut it twists more than you think.$

dialogue.label: EventScript_RouteTrainer_ROUTE10_TUBER_DILLON_Text_RematchIntro
dialogue.text: Back near the bridge path?\pThen it's race time again!$

dialogue.label: EventScript_RouteTrainer_ROUTE10_SWIMMER_HALEY_Text_Defeat
dialogue.text: You stayed sharp!$

dialogue.label: EventScript_RouteTrainer_ROUTE10_SWIMMER_HALEY_Text_Intro
dialogue.text: The water beside ROCK TUNNEL\nis colder than it looks.\pA cold current makes you sharp!$

dialogue.label: EventScript_RouteTrainer_ROUTE10_SWIMMER_HALEY_Text_PostBattle
dialogue.text: The cave keeps the shade here.\nEven sunny days feel cool.$

dialogue.label: EventScript_RouteTrainer_ROUTE10_SWIMMER_HALEY_Text_RematchIntro
dialogue.text: Back for another cold swim?\pI'll make this battle sharp!$

dialogue.label: EventScript_RouteTrainer_ROUTE10_FISHERMAN_KYLE_Text_Defeat
dialogue.text: You reeled me in!$

dialogue.label: EventScript_RouteTrainer_ROUTE10_FISHERMAN_KYLE_Text_Intro
dialogue.text: I cast my line where the\nriver quiets near LAVENDER.\pQuiet water still has bite!$

dialogue.label: EventScript_RouteTrainer_ROUTE10_FISHERMAN_KYLE_Text_PostBattle
dialogue.text: The closer you get to LAVENDER,\nthe quieter the water feels.$

dialogue.label: EventScript_RouteTrainer_ROUTE10_FISHERMAN_KYLE_Text_RematchIntro
dialogue.text: Back by the quiet water?\pGood. My line's already set!$

dialogue.label: EventScript_RouteTrainer_ROUTE10_SWIMMER_SUSIE_Text_Defeat
dialogue.text: That woke me up!$

dialogue.label: EventScript_RouteTrainer_ROUTE10_SWIMMER_SUSIE_Text_Intro
dialogue.text: South of here, LAVENDER\ngets so still.\pI swim hard to shake off\nthat quiet!$

dialogue.label: EventScript_RouteTrainer_ROUTE10_SWIMMER_SUSIE_Text_PostBattle
dialogue.text: It's strange.\pThe water moves, but the road\nstill feels calm near LAVENDER.$

dialogue.label: EventScript_RouteTrainer_ROUTE10_SWIMMER_SUSIE_Text_RematchIntro
dialogue.text: Need to shake off the quiet?\pA battle will do it!$

dialogue.label: WatersEdge_EventScript_Route10TuberMika_Text_Defeat
dialogue.text: You splashed right past me!$

dialogue.label: WatersEdge_EventScript_Route10TuberMika_Text_Intro
dialogue.text: The bridge up north makes\nthis place feel secret.\pLike a beach hiding under\nall the cliffs!$

dialogue.label: WatersEdge_EventScript_Route10TuberMika_Text_PostBattle
dialogue.text: If you follow the water north,\nit feels like CERULEAN is\ljust around the bend.$

dialogue.label: WatersEdge_EventScript_Route10TuberMika_Text_RematchIntro
dialogue.text: You found the hidden beach\nfeeling again!\pLet's battle!$

dialogue.label: WatersEdge_EventScript_Route10FishermanPierce_Text_Defeat
dialogue.text: You felt the line twitch!$

dialogue.label: WatersEdge_EventScript_Route10FishermanPierce_Text_Intro
dialogue.text: The POWER PLANT hums through\nthe water if you listen.\pThe fish notice it before we do!$

dialogue.label: WatersEdge_EventScript_Route10FishermanPierce_Text_PostBattle
dialogue.text: Some days the current changes\nright when the plant surges.$

dialogue.label: WatersEdge_EventScript_Route10FishermanPierce_Text_RematchIntro
dialogue.text: Hear that hum again?\pThen the fish are moving,\nand so are we!$

dialogue.label: WatersEdge_EventScript_Route10SwimmerNola_Text_Defeat
dialogue.text: You beat my timing!$

dialogue.label: WatersEdge_EventScript_Route10SwimmerNola_Text_Intro
dialogue.text: I time my laps between the\nPOWER PLANT and ROCK TUNNEL.\pOne buzzes, one echoes!$

dialogue.label: WatersEdge_EventScript_Route10SwimmerNola_Text_PostBattle
dialogue.text: It's a good route for training.\pThe water never lets you keep\none rhythm for long.$

dialogue.label: WatersEdge_EventScript_Route10SwimmerNola_Text_RematchIntro
dialogue.text: I heard the echo and the hum.\pThat means it's rematch time!$

dialogue.label: WatersEdge_EventScript_Route10SailorArlen_Text_Defeat
dialogue.text: You held the channel!$

dialogue.label: WatersEdge_EventScript_Route10SailorArlen_Text_Intro
dialogue.text: A sailor can learn plenty\naway from the sea.\pROUTE 10's narrow waterway\nteaches control!$

dialogue.label: WatersEdge_EventScript_Route10SailorArlen_Text_PostBattle
dialogue.text: VERMILION has open harbor air.\pHere, the cliffs squeeze every\ngust into a command.$

dialogue.label: WatersEdge_EventScript_Route10SailorArlen_Text_RematchIntro
dialogue.text: Back in this narrow channel?\pGood. Tight water, tight battle!$

dialogue.label: EventScript_RouteTrainer_BUG_MANIAC_EVAN_Text_Defeat
dialogue.text: You scattered my swarm!$

dialogue.label: EventScript_RouteTrainer_BUG_MANIAC_EVAN_Text_Intro
dialogue.text: Bugs love the warm grass beside\nthe harbor road.\pI came to watch them, but a\nbattle works too!$

dialogue.label: EventScript_RouteTrainer_BUG_MANIAC_EVAN_Text_PostBattle
dialogue.text: VERMILION's wind warms the grass,\nand warm grass brings bugs.\pThat's fieldwork!$

dialogue.label: EventScript_RouteTrainer_BUG_MANIAC_EVAN_Text_RematchIntro
dialogue.text: The bugs are buzzing louder.\pThey know it's rematch time!$

dialogue.label: EventScript_RouteTrainer_ROUTE11_POKEMANIAC_CHAPLIN_Text_Defeat
dialogue.text: I would've won had you\nchallenged me before they shut\lthemselves away.$

dialogue.label: EventScript_RouteTrainer_ROUTE11_POKEMANIAC_CHAPLIN_Text_Intro
dialogue.text: I study MR. MIME, but they've\nall withdrawn into DIGLETT'S\pCAVE! Perhaps a battle will\nclear my head.$

dialogue.label: EventScript_RouteTrainer_ROUTE11_POKEMANIAC_CHAPLIN_Text_PostBattle
dialogue.text: The MR. MIME went into DIGLETT\nCAVE and erected barriers.\pIt's like they built their own\nlittle community and closed the\lworld out.$

dialogue.label: EventScript_RouteTrainer_ROUTE11_POKEMANIAC_CHAPLIN_Text_RematchIntro
dialogue.text: Still no sign of the wild MR.\nMIME. My own partner is eager to\psee you again, though!$

dialogue.label: Text_ApexRumorRecorded
dialogue.text: Rumour recorded.\pCompare three accounts in your\nLOGBOOK to find an APEX POKéMON.\pIf you flee from its battle,\nit will leave for good.$

dialogue.label: Text_ApexRumorUpdated
dialogue.text: Rumour updated.$

dialogue.label: EventScript_RouteTrainer_BUG_MANIAC_MARK_Text_Defeat
dialogue.text: You spotted my weak point!$

dialogue.label: EventScript_RouteTrainer_BUG_MANIAC_MARK_Text_Intro
dialogue.text: People hurry to the gate and\nmiss all the tiny movements.\pA true bug fan sees everything!$

dialogue.label: EventScript_RouteTrainer_BUG_MANIAC_MARK_Text_PostBattle
dialogue.text: The best things on ROUTE 11\nare small enough to hide\lunder one leaf.$

dialogue.label: EventScript_RouteTrainer_BUG_MANIAC_MARK_Text_RematchIntro
dialogue.text: You came back slowly enough\nto notice me this time.\pGood. Rematch!$

dialogue.label: EventScript_RouteTrainer_PKMN_RANGER_LOGAN_Text_Defeat
dialogue.text: Good control. Well done.$

dialogue.label: EventScript_RouteTrainer_PKMN_RANGER_LOGAN_Text_Intro
dialogue.text: ROUTE 11 links city traffic\nto wild cave habitat.\pI make sure travelers respect\nboth sides.$

dialogue.label: EventScript_RouteTrainer_PKMN_RANGER_LOGAN_Text_PostBattle
dialogue.text: The safest routes are the ones\nwhere people notice the wild\lplaces beside them.$

dialogue.label: EventScript_RouteTrainer_PKMN_RANGER_LOGAN_Text_RematchIntro
dialogue.text: You crossed without disturbing\nthe grass or cave mouth.\pThat earns a rematch.$

dialogue.label: EventScript_RouteTrainer_AROMA_LADY_BETH_Text_Defeat
dialogue.text: Strong roots, stronger trainer!$

dialogue.label: EventScript_RouteTrainer_AROMA_LADY_BETH_Text_Intro
dialogue.text: The DIGLETT stir the soil\nunder this route.\pThat makes the grass and flowers\ngrow with unusual strength.$

dialogue.label: EventScript_RouteTrainer_AROMA_LADY_BETH_Text_PostBattle
dialogue.text: If the ground trembles lightly,\nit may just be DIGLETT\lworking below.$

dialogue.label: EventScript_RouteTrainer_AROMA_LADY_BETH_Text_RematchIntro
dialogue.text: The soil is loose again today.\pMy POKéMON feel lively.\nShall we battle?$

dialogue.label: EventScript_RouteTrainer_ROUTE11_RUIN_MANIAC_MARCOS_Text_Defeat
dialogue.text: That shook my theory loose!$

dialogue.label: EventScript_RouteTrainer_ROUTE11_RUIN_MANIAC_MARCOS_Text_Intro
dialogue.text: DIGLETT'S CAVE cuts beneath\nKANTO like an old passage.\pI study the stones it pushes\nup to the surface!$

dialogue.label: EventScript_RouteTrainer_ROUTE11_RUIN_MANIAC_MARCOS_Text_PostBattle
dialogue.text: The stones near DIGLETT'S CAVE\ntell you where the tunnel\lhas widened over time.$

dialogue.label: EventScript_RouteTrainer_ROUTE11_RUIN_MANIAC_MARCOS_Text_RematchIntro
dialogue.text: Back to inspect the cave mouth?\pThen let's compare field notes\nthrough battle!$

dialogue.label: EventScript_RouteTrainer_PKMN_BREEDER_ALLISON_Text_Defeat
dialogue.text: You kept steadier than us!$

dialogue.label: EventScript_RouteTrainer_PKMN_BREEDER_ALLISON_Text_Intro
dialogue.text: POKéMON raised near DIGLETT'S\nCAVE get used to sudden rumbling.\pMine won't flinch easily!$

dialogue.label: EventScript_RouteTrainer_PKMN_BREEDER_ALLISON_Text_PostBattle
dialogue.text: A road can train temperament.\pNoise, wind, footsteps,\ntremors-it all matters.$

dialogue.label: EventScript_RouteTrainer_PKMN_BREEDER_ALLISON_Text_RematchIntro
dialogue.text: The ground rumbled twice today.\pMy team took it calmly.\nReady for a rematch?$

dialogue.label: EventScript_ForestTrainer_AROMA_LADY_LINA_Text_Defeat
dialogue.text: Even the breeze paused.$

dialogue.label: EventScript_ForestTrainer_AROMA_LADY_LINA_Text_Intro
dialogue.text: The flowers here smell faintly\nof sea air from VERMILION.\pLet me show you what they\nbring out in my POKéMON.$

dialogue.label: EventScript_ForestTrainer_AROMA_LADY_LINA_Text_PostBattle
dialogue.text: Plants near busy roads grow\ntougher than you expect.\pThey learn to live with noise.$

dialogue.label: EventScript_ForestTrainer_AROMA_LADY_LINA_Text_RematchIntro
dialogue.text: The breeze is carrying that\nsalt-sweet scent again.\pA rematch would suit it.$

dialogue.label: EventScript_ForestTrainer_PICNICKER_REMI_Text_Defeat
dialogue.text: You know the route now!$

dialogue.label: EventScript_ForestTrainer_PICNICKER_REMI_Text_Intro
dialogue.text: I scout the path between\nVERMILION and the eastern gate.\pIf you can cross it cleanly,\nshow me!$

dialogue.label: EventScript_ForestTrainer_PICNICKER_REMI_Text_PostBattle
dialogue.text: This road looks simple, but it\nfeeds into caves, gates, and\lthe long way to LAVENDER.$

dialogue.label: EventScript_ForestTrainer_PICNICKER_REMI_Text_RematchIntro
dialogue.text: Back from the east gate?\pGood. Let's test how much\nground you've covered.$

dialogue.label: Route12_Text_NedDefeat
dialogue.text: That was the big one!$

dialogue.label: Route12_Text_NedIntro
dialogue.text: The water gets quiet south\nof LAVENDER.\pQuiet water makes every tug\nfeel huge!$

dialogue.label: Route12_Text_NedPostBattle
dialogue.text: Some folks hurry over the bridge.\pFISHERMEN know this route is\nbetter when you wait.$

dialogue.label: Route12_Text_NedRematchIntro
dialogue.text: The water went quiet again.\pThat means either a bite...\nor a rematch!$

dialogue.label: Route12_Text_ChipDefeat
dialogue.text: You broke the line!$

dialogue.label: Route12_Text_ChipIntro
dialogue.text: On ROUTE 12, patience is\nas important as bait.\pLet's see if you can wait out\na battle too.$

dialogue.label: Route12_Text_ChipPostBattle
dialogue.text: The bridge shadows draw all sorts\nof POKéMON beneath them.$

dialogue.label: Route12_Text_ChipRematchIntro
dialogue.text: I waited by the same shadow.\pLooks like patience brought\nyou back.$

dialogue.label: Route12_Text_HankDefeat
dialogue.text: You read me clean!$

dialogue.label: Route12_Text_HankIntro
dialogue.text: Sportfishing means reading the\nwater, the wind, and your\lPOKéMON.\pCan you read a battle?$

dialogue.label: Route12_Text_HankPostBattle
dialogue.text: A bite can come from either side\nof the bridge.\pThat's why I keep looking around.$

dialogue.label: Route12_Text_HankRematchIntro
dialogue.text: I read the wind.\nI read the water.\pNow I'll read your rematch.$

dialogue.label: Route12_Text_AndrewDefeat
dialogue.text: You landed it!$

dialogue.label: Route12_Text_AndrewIntro
dialogue.text: The farther south you go,\nthe more the route opens up.\pLet's see what your team can\ncatch before ROUTE 13!$

dialogue.label: Route12_Text_AndrewPostBattle
dialogue.text: ROUTE 12 is long enough that\nthe water changes mood before\lyou reach the bottom.$

dialogue.label: Route12_Text_AndrewRematchIntro
dialogue.text: Back before ROUTE 13?\pGood timing.\nThe water just changed mood.$

dialogue.label: Route12_Text_GiaDefeat
dialogue.text: GIA: We lost the pace!$

dialogue.label: Route12_Text_GiaIntro
dialogue.text: GIA: JES, match my pace!\pThis bridge is our training lane,\nand we're not slowing down!$

dialogue.label: Route12_Text_GiaNotEnoughMons
dialogue.text: GIA: JES and I battle together.\pCome back when you have two\nPOKéMON ready.$

dialogue.label: Route12_Text_GiaPostBattle
dialogue.text: GIA: The route is narrow,\nbut it teaches teamwork.$

dialogue.label: Route12_Text_GiaRematchIntro
dialogue.text: GIA: JES, eyes forward!\pThe rematch starts on my count.$

dialogue.label: Route12_Text_JesDefeat
dialogue.text: JES: Our rhythm slipped!$

dialogue.label: Route12_Text_JesIntro
dialogue.text: JES: GIA and I train together\non this long bridge.\pIf our rhythm is right,\nwe can't lose!$

dialogue.label: Route12_Text_JesNotEnoughMons
