dialogue.text: JES: GIA and I battle as a pair.\pBring two POKéMON if you want\nto face us properly.$

dialogue.label: Route12_Text_JesPostBattle
dialogue.text: JES: Training beside the water\nhelps us keep pace together.$

dialogue.label: Route12_Text_JesRematchIntro
dialogue.text: JES: GIA, keep the bridge pace!\pThis time we'll stay in rhythm.$

dialogue.label: EventScript_RouteTrainer_ROUTE12_TUBER_DAVE_Text_Defeat
dialogue.text: You splashed ahead!$

dialogue.label: EventScript_RouteTrainer_ROUTE12_TUBER_DAVE_Text_Intro
dialogue.text: Everyone calls this the fishing\nroute, but I found a splash lane!\pRace me before the anglers notice!$

dialogue.label: EventScript_RouteTrainer_ROUTE12_TUBER_DAVE_Text_PostBattle
dialogue.text: The best part of ROUTE 12 is\nhow long it stays by the water.$

dialogue.label: EventScript_RouteTrainer_ROUTE12_TUBER_DAVE_Text_RematchIntro
dialogue.text: Back to my splash lane?\pThen we race-battle again!$

dialogue.label: EventScript_RouteTrainer_ROUTE12_SWIMMER_DAWN_Text_Defeat
dialogue.text: You held against the current!$

dialogue.label: EventScript_RouteTrainer_ROUTE12_SWIMMER_DAWN_Text_Intro
dialogue.text: The bridge cuts the wind,\nbut the water still pushes hard.\pI train where the current argues\nwith the posts!$

dialogue.label: EventScript_RouteTrainer_ROUTE12_SWIMMER_DAWN_Text_PostBattle
dialogue.text: Swimming beside a bridge teaches\nyou to notice every little pull.$

dialogue.label: EventScript_RouteTrainer_ROUTE12_SWIMMER_DAWN_Text_RematchIntro
dialogue.text: The current's arguing again.\pPerfect timing for a rematch!$

dialogue.label: WatersEdge_EventScript_Route12TuberLuca_Text_Defeat
dialogue.text: My splash barely reached you!$

dialogue.label: WatersEdge_EventScript_Route12TuberLuca_Text_Intro
dialogue.text: The grown-ups fish all day,\nbut I say the bridge is for\lsplashing too!$

dialogue.label: WatersEdge_EventScript_Route12TuberLuca_Text_PostBattle
dialogue.text: If you stand still too long here,\nsomeone starts fishing beside you.$

dialogue.label: WatersEdge_EventScript_Route12TuberLuca_Text_RematchIntro
dialogue.text: Back to splash by the bridge?\pThen let's battle!$

dialogue.label: WatersEdge_EventScript_Route12TuberPia_Text_Defeat
dialogue.text: I counted that as a loss!$

dialogue.label: WatersEdge_EventScript_Route12TuberPia_Text_Intro
dialogue.text: I counted every bridge post\nfrom LAVENDER down here.\pThen I got bored and battled!$

dialogue.label: WatersEdge_EventScript_Route12TuberPia_Text_PostBattle
dialogue.text: ROUTE 12 is so long that even\ncounting bridge posts feels like\la journey.$

dialogue.label: WatersEdge_EventScript_Route12TuberPia_Text_RematchIntro
dialogue.text: I lost count again.\pA rematch sounds more fun!$

dialogue.label: WatersEdge_EventScript_Route12FishermanEbb_Text_Defeat
dialogue.text: Soft water, hard loss.$

dialogue.label: WatersEdge_EventScript_Route12FishermanEbb_Text_Intro
dialogue.text: I fish where LAVENDER's quiet\nsettles onto the water.\pEven the splashes sound softer.$

dialogue.label: WatersEdge_EventScript_Route12FishermanEbb_Text_PostBattle
dialogue.text: Some FISHERMEN like chatter.\pI like listening for the float\nto dip.$

dialogue.label: WatersEdge_EventScript_Route12FishermanEbb_Text_RematchIntro
dialogue.text: Back to the quiet water?\pKeep your voice low and battle!$

dialogue.label: WatersEdge_EventScript_Route12FishermanReed_Text_Defeat
dialogue.text: You pulled me from cover!$

dialogue.label: WatersEdge_EventScript_Route12FishermanReed_Text_Intro
dialogue.text: Down here, the bridge shadows\nmake perfect hiding spots.\pFor fish and for battles!$

dialogue.label: WatersEdge_EventScript_Route12FishermanReed_Text_PostBattle
dialogue.text: The longer the bridge,\nthe more shadows underneath.\pThat means more places to cast.$

dialogue.label: WatersEdge_EventScript_Route12FishermanReed_Text_RematchIntro
dialogue.text: Back under the bridge shadows?\pLet's see what bites first.$

dialogue.label: WatersEdge_EventScript_Route12SwimmerCora_Text_Defeat
dialogue.text: You read the current!$

dialogue.label: WatersEdge_EventScript_Route12SwimmerCora_Text_Intro
dialogue.text: The anglers watch the surface.\pI train below it, where the\ncurrent really moves.$

dialogue.label: WatersEdge_EventScript_Route12SwimmerCora_Text_PostBattle
dialogue.text: Don't judge this route from the\nbridge alone.\pThe water has its own road.$

dialogue.label: WatersEdge_EventScript_Route12SwimmerCora_Text_RematchIntro
dialogue.text: Back to test the current?\pDive into this rematch!$

dialogue.label: WatersEdge_EventScript_Route12SwimmerMaris_Text_Defeat
dialogue.text: Clean turn!$

dialogue.label: WatersEdge_EventScript_Route12SwimmerMaris_Text_Intro
dialogue.text: I swim laps between the bridge\nposts.\pMiss one turn and the current\nlaughs at you!$

dialogue.label: WatersEdge_EventScript_Route12SwimmerMaris_Text_PostBattle
dialogue.text: The bridge makes a perfect lane\nif you know how to use it.$

dialogue.label: WatersEdge_EventScript_Route12SwimmerMaris_Text_RematchIntro
dialogue.text: Back between the posts?\pThen keep your turns sharp!$

dialogue.label: WatersEdge_EventScript_Route12SailorBriggs_Text_Defeat
dialogue.text: You steered through my defence!$

dialogue.label: WatersEdge_EventScript_Route12SailorBriggs_Text_Intro
dialogue.text: A sailor can read open water.\pROUTE 12 teaches the opposite:\ntight water, tight turns!$

dialogue.label: WatersEdge_EventScript_Route12SailorBriggs_Text_PostBattle
dialogue.text: VERMILION HARBOR feels wide\nafter you train here awhile.$

dialogue.label: WatersEdge_EventScript_Route12SailorBriggs_Text_RematchIntro
dialogue.text: Back in the narrow channel?\pGood. Hold your course!$

dialogue.label: WatersEdge_EventScript_Route12TriathleteVera_Text_Defeat
dialogue.text: You kept the pace!$

dialogue.label: WatersEdge_EventScript_Route12TriathleteVera_Text_Intro
dialogue.text: Route training means adapting:\nbridge, water, bridge again.\pShow me your pace!$

dialogue.label: WatersEdge_EventScript_Route12TriathleteVera_Text_PostBattle
dialogue.text: ROUTE 12 is endurance training\ndisguised as a shortcut south.$

dialogue.label: WatersEdge_EventScript_Route12TriathleteVera_Text_RematchIntro
dialogue.text: Back for another long-route\npace test?$

dialogue.label: Route13_Text_SebastianDefeat
dialogue.text: The crosswind carried you instead!$

dialogue.label: Route13_Text_SebastianIntro
dialogue.text: The wind off SILENCE BRIDGE makes\nmy bird POKéMON restless.\pThey want a battle!$

dialogue.label: Route13_Text_SebastianPostBattle
dialogue.text: Bird POKéMON love this route.\pThe rough ground keeps people slow,\nbut the sky stays wide open.$

dialogue.label: Route13_Text_SebastianRematchIntro
dialogue.text: The wind's up again.\pMy bird POKéMON remember how you\nhandled it last time!$

dialogue.label: Route13_Text_SheilaDefeat
dialogue.text: You kept a better pace!$

dialogue.label: Route13_Text_SheilaIntro
dialogue.text: Loose stones, broken grass,\nawkward turns...\pPerfect endurance training!$

dialogue.label: Route13_Text_SheilaPostBattle
dialogue.text: ROUTE 13 punishes sloppy footwork.\pIf your stride is uneven, your\nbattle rhythm goes with it.$

dialogue.label: Route13_Text_SheilaRematchIntro
dialogue.text: Back for another rough-ground run?\pGood. My team's pace has improved!$

dialogue.label: EventScript_RouteTrainer_ROUTE13_HIKER_ALAN_Text_Defeat
dialogue.text: You stayed steady!$

dialogue.label: EventScript_RouteTrainer_ROUTE13_HIKER_ALAN_Text_Intro
dialogue.text: The rocks here are smaller than\nmountain stone, but just as mean.\pWatch your footing!$

dialogue.label: EventScript_RouteTrainer_ROUTE13_HIKER_ALAN_Text_PostBattle
dialogue.text: A HIKER can learn plenty here.\pThe bridge is flat, but this road\nmakes every step count.$

dialogue.label: EventScript_RouteTrainer_ROUTE13_HIKER_ALAN_Text_RematchIntro
dialogue.text: Back over the broken ground?\pThen let's see if your stance\nhas improved!$

dialogue.label: Route13_Text_PerryDefeat
dialogue.text: You cut through the wind!$

dialogue.label: Route13_Text_PerryIntro
dialogue.text: This bend catches every gust from\nthe bridge.\pMy birds know how to ride it!$

dialogue.label: Route13_Text_PerryPostBattle
dialogue.text: A bird keeper learns to read the\nair before giving a command.\pROUTE 13 changes by the minute.$

dialogue.label: Route13_Text_PerryRematchIntro
dialogue.text: I studied the gusts since our\nlast battle.\pThis time, we'll ride them better!$

dialogue.label: Route13_Text_JaredDefeat
dialogue.text: Tch!\nMy wheels slipped!$

dialogue.label: Route13_Text_JaredIntro
dialogue.text: These ruts are rough on tires.\pIf you can handle them, you can\nhandle a battle!$

dialogue.label: Route13_Text_JaredPostBattle
dialogue.text: ROUTE 13's no smooth ride.\pThat's why I like it.$

dialogue.label: Route13_Text_JaredRematchIntro
dialogue.text: I learned these ruts better.\pTry keeping up this time!$

dialogue.label: EventScript_RouteTrainer_ROUTE13_SCOUT_JOHNSON_Text_Defeat
dialogue.text: You picked the better line!$

dialogue.label: EventScript_RouteTrainer_ROUTE13_SCOUT_JOHNSON_Text_Intro
dialogue.text: A SCOUT checks the safest line\nthrough rough country.\pBattle me before you choose yours!$

dialogue.label: EventScript_RouteTrainer_ROUTE13_SCOUT_JOHNSON_Text_PostBattle
dialogue.text: North is SILENCE BRIDGE.\pSouth, the road gets rough again.\nA good SCOUT marks both.$

dialogue.label: EventScript_RouteTrainer_ROUTE13_SCOUT_JOHNSON_Text_RematchIntro
dialogue.text: You found your way back through\nthe rough grass.\pGood. Now prove you learned it!$

dialogue.label: EventScript_RouteTrainer_ROUTE13_BIKER_KOJI_Text_Defeat
dialogue.text: Skidded out!$

dialogue.label: EventScript_RouteTrainer_ROUTE13_BIKER_KOJI_Text_Intro
dialogue.text: This track is all ruts and grit.\pThat's perfect for a BIKER who\nwants better control!$

dialogue.label: EventScript_RouteTrainer_ROUTE13_BIKER_KOJI_Text_PostBattle
dialogue.text: Smooth roads make lazy riders.\pROUTE 13 keeps me honest.$

dialogue.label: EventScript_RouteTrainer_ROUTE13_BIKER_KOJI_Text_RematchIntro
dialogue.text: I took the rough line twice today.\pMy tires and my team are ready!$

dialogue.label: EventScript_RouteTrainer_ROUTE13_TRIATHLETE_MISSY_Text_Defeat
dialogue.text: You had the stronger finish!$

dialogue.label: EventScript_RouteTrainer_ROUTE13_TRIATHLETE_MISSY_Text_Intro
dialogue.text: I pace myself between bridge\nplanks and broken ground.\pCan your POKéMON keep rhythm?$

dialogue.label: EventScript_RouteTrainer_ROUTE13_TRIATHLETE_MISSY_Text_PostBattle
dialogue.text: Endurance is about adapting.\pOn ROUTE 13, the ground changes\nbefore your breathing does.$

dialogue.label: EventScript_RouteTrainer_ROUTE13_TRIATHLETE_MISSY_Text_RematchIntro
dialogue.text: I tightened my pace on the bend.\pLet's see if your team can match\nit again!$

dialogue.label: Route14_Text_GeraldDefeat
dialogue.text: Wipeout!\nYou found the clean line.$

dialogue.label: Route14_Text_GeraldIntro
dialogue.text: We ride out here because the road\nstays wild.\pNo clean lanes, no easy turns!$

dialogue.label: Route14_Text_GeraldPostBattle
dialogue.text: ROUTE 14 bites back if you get\ncareless.\pThat's what makes it worth riding.$

dialogue.label: Route14_Text_GeraldRematchIntro
dialogue.text: I've learned every rut between\nhere and FUCHSIA.\pTry taking my line now!$

dialogue.label: Route14_Text_DonaldDefeat
dialogue.text: Your call was clearer!$

dialogue.label: Route14_Text_DonaldIntro
dialogue.text: I follow bird calls between\nROUTE 13 and FUCHSIA.\pThis stretch has the best echoes!$

dialogue.label: Route14_Text_DonaldPostBattle
dialogue.text: The trees break up the wind here.\pBird POKéMON learn quick turns\nbetween the gusts.$

dialogue.label: Route14_Text_DonaldRematchIntro
dialogue.text: The calls are echoing again.\pThat means my birds are ready\nfor a rematch!$

dialogue.label: Route14_Text_IsaacDefeat
dialogue.text: Tch!\nYou didn't shake loose!$

dialogue.label: Route14_Text_IsaacIntro
dialogue.text: This road's rough enough to rattle\nyour teeth.\pLet's see if it rattles your team!$

dialogue.label: Route14_Text_IsaacPostBattle
dialogue.text: I like roads that fight back.\pSmooth pavement makes everyone\nthink they're tough.$

dialogue.label: Route14_Text_IsaacRematchIntro
dialogue.text: You came back over this rough road?\pFine. Let's see if you still hold\nsteady!$

dialogue.label: Route14_Text_CarterDefeat
dialogue.text: Not enough lift!$

dialogue.label: Route14_Text_CarterIntro
dialogue.text: The rough road opens into big sky\nout here.\pMy bird POKéMON can feel it!$

dialogue.label: Route14_Text_CarterPostBattle
dialogue.text: Bird keepers like open roads.\pYou can watch the ground and the\nsky at the same time.$

dialogue.label: Route14_Text_CarterRematchIntro
dialogue.text: My birds read the open road\nbetter now.\pLet's see if you do too!$

dialogue.label: EventScript_RouteTrainer_ROUTE14_TRIATHLETE_LOLA_Text_Defeat
dialogue.text: My stride fell apart!$

dialogue.label: EventScript_RouteTrainer_ROUTE14_TRIATHLETE_LOLA_Text_Intro
dialogue.text: This road keeps changing underfoot.\pThat's the best way to train a\nsteady stride!$

dialogue.label: EventScript_RouteTrainer_ROUTE14_TRIATHLETE_LOLA_Text_PostBattle
dialogue.text: ROUTE 14 is tougher than it looks.\pIf your feet drift, your commands\ndrift with them.$

dialogue.label: EventScript_RouteTrainer_ROUTE14_TRIATHLETE_LOLA_Text_RematchIntro
dialogue.text: Back for another uneven run?\pGood. My rhythm is sharper now!$

dialogue.label: EventScript_RouteTrainer_ROUTE14_SCOUT_DESTIN_Text_Defeat
dialogue.text: You read the path better!$

dialogue.label: EventScript_RouteTrainer_ROUTE14_SCOUT_DESTIN_Text_Intro
dialogue.text: A SCOUT marks where the grass\nbreaks and where the path bends.\pBattle me before you pass!$

dialogue.label: EventScript_RouteTrainer_ROUTE14_SCOUT_DESTIN_Text_PostBattle
dialogue.text: This road funnels travelers toward\nFUCHSIA.\pA good SCOUT watches who arrives\ntired and who arrives ready.$

dialogue.label: EventScript_RouteTrainer_ROUTE14_SCOUT_DESTIN_Text_RematchIntro
dialogue.text: You found my marker again.\pThat deserves another battle!$

dialogue.label: EventScript_RouteTrainer_ROUTE14_HIKER_BRICE_Text_Defeat
dialogue.text: You stepped cleaner!$

dialogue.label: EventScript_RouteTrainer_ROUTE14_HIKER_BRICE_Text_Intro
dialogue.text: A HIKER doesn't need a mountain\nto test his boots.\pThis rough road will do!$

dialogue.label: EventScript_RouteTrainer_ROUTE14_HIKER_BRICE_Text_PostBattle
dialogue.text: ROUTE 14 is good training.\pThe stones are low, but they still\nmake you pay attention.$

dialogue.label: EventScript_RouteTrainer_ROUTE14_HIKER_BRICE_Text_RematchIntro
dialogue.text: My boots know this road now.\pLet's see if your POKéMON know it\nas well!$

dialogue.label: EventScript_RouteTrainer_ROUTE14_TRIATHLETE_IRENE_Text_Defeat
dialogue.text: You had the better kick!$

dialogue.label: EventScript_RouteTrainer_ROUTE14_TRIATHLETE_IRENE_Text_Intro
dialogue.text: I use the long straightaways for\nspeed and the rough patches for\lcontrol.\pNow I need battle practice!$

dialogue.label: EventScript_RouteTrainer_ROUTE14_TRIATHLETE_IRENE_Text_PostBattle
dialogue.text: ROUTE 14 is a good endurance road.\pIt never lets you settle into one\neasy rhythm.$

dialogue.label: EventScript_RouteTrainer_ROUTE14_TRIATHLETE_IRENE_Text_RematchIntro
dialogue.text: I ran the straightaway twice today.\pLet's see if that extra pace shows!$

dialogue.label: Route15_Text_EdwinDefeat
dialogue.text: They spotted you, but couldn't\nstop you!$

dialogue.label: Route15_Text_EdwinIntro
dialogue.text: Bird POKéMON love watching the\nroad open toward FUCHSIA.\pMine spotted you first!$

dialogue.label: Route15_Text_EdwinPostBattle
dialogue.text: The closer you get to FUCHSIA,\nthe more the sky feels busy.\pBirds, travelers, trainers...\neveryone's moving.$

dialogue.label: Route15_Text_EdwinRematchIntro
dialogue.text: My birds spotted you again.\pThey remember the way you battled!$

dialogue.label: Route15_Text_OliviaDefeat
dialogue.text: You broke my rhythm!$

dialogue.label: Route15_Text_OliviaIntro
dialogue.text: I train where the road gets busy,\nthen quiet, then busy again.\pThat rhythm is perfect!$

dialogue.label: Route15_Text_OliviaPostBattle
dialogue.text: A TRIATHLETE has to adapt.\pROUTE 15 gives you road, grass,\nand city edge all at once.$

dialogue.label: Route15_Text_OliviaRematchIntro
dialogue.text: I found a better rhythm on this\nroad.\pLet's see if you can break it\nagain!$

dialogue.label: Route15_Text_AlexDefeat
dialogue.text: You know them well enough!$

dialogue.label: Route15_Text_AlexIntro
dialogue.text: Coming from FUCHSIA?\nThen you should know rough roads.\pShow me!$

dialogue.label: Route15_Text_AlexPostBattle
dialogue.text: BIKERS don't need smooth streets.\pGive us gravel, ruts, and room\nto move.$

dialogue.label: Route15_Text_AlexRematchIntro
dialogue.text: You still know how to handle this\nroad?\pProve it again!$

dialogue.label: Route15_Text_GraceDefeat
dialogue.text: You had the faster finish!$

dialogue.label: Route15_Text_GraceIntro
dialogue.text: I use this long road for finishing\nsprints.\pDon't blink when I take off!$

dialogue.label: Route15_Text_GracePostBattle
dialogue.text: The final run into FUCHSIA feels\ngreat when your breathing is\lsteady.$

dialogue.label: Route15_Text_GraceRematchIntro
dialogue.text: Back for another finishing sprint?\pGood. I saved my best pace for\nyou!$

dialogue.label: Route15_Text_MyaDefeat
dialogue.text: MYA: RON, watch your footing!\nThis route punishes drift.$

dialogue.label: Route15_Text_MyaIntro
dialogue.text: MYA: This road toughens balance\nand timing.\pHelp me train my little brother?$

dialogue.label: Route15_Text_MyaNotEnoughMons
dialogue.text: MYA: Do you want to challenge us?\nYou'll need two POKéMON, though.$

dialogue.label: Route15_Text_MyaPostBattle
dialogue.text: MYA: We'll keep using ROUTE 15.\pIf RON can handle this road,\nhe can handle anything.$

dialogue.label: Route15_Text_MyaRematchIntro
dialogue.text: MYA: RON's footing improved.\pHelp me test him on this road\nagain?$

dialogue.label: Route15_Text_RonDefeat
dialogue.text: RON: Oh, no...\nI slipped again!$

dialogue.label: Route15_Text_RonIntro
dialogue.text: RON: My sister says this road\nbuilds character.\pI think it builds sore feet.$

dialogue.label: Route15_Text_RonNotEnoughMons
dialogue.text: RON: Did you want to battle with\nmy sister and me?\pYou need two POKéMON, then.$

dialogue.label: Route15_Text_RonPostBattle
dialogue.text: RON: FUCHSIA is so close.\pMaybe if I run there fast enough,\ntraining will be over.$

dialogue.label: Route15_Text_RonRematchIntro
dialogue.text: RON: My sister says I'm better\nat rough-road battles now.\pPlease don't prove her wrong...$

dialogue.label: EventScript_RouteTrainer_ROUTE15_SCOUT_CORDELL_Text_Defeat
dialogue.text: You found it!$

dialogue.label: EventScript_RouteTrainer_ROUTE15_SCOUT_CORDELL_Text_Intro
dialogue.text: The gate to FUCHSIA is close,\nbut the rough grass still matters.\pA SCOUT checks the last stretch!$

dialogue.label: EventScript_RouteTrainer_ROUTE15_SCOUT_CORDELL_Text_PostBattle
dialogue.text: People relax when a city is close.\pThat's when they miss loose stones,\nbent grass, and hidden turns.$

dialogue.label: EventScript_RouteTrainer_ROUTE15_SCOUT_CORDELL_Text_RematchIntro
dialogue.text: Back on the last stretch?\pThen show me you remember the\nsafe line!$

dialogue.label: Route15_Text_KindraDefeat
dialogue.text: You checked it better!$

dialogue.label: Route15_Text_KindraIntro
dialogue.text: FUCHSIA is close, but don't rush\nthe last stretch.\pA SCOUT checks the rough grass\nbefore stepping through!$

dialogue.label: Route15_Text_KindraPostBattle
dialogue.text: Between the forest path, the road,\nand FUCHSIA's gate, ROUTE 15 has\lmore choices than it first shows.$

dialogue.label: Route15_Text_KindraRematchIntro
dialogue.text: I marked a better line through\nthe grass.\pWant to test it with a rematch?$

dialogue.label: EventScript_RouteTrainer_ROUTE15_HIKER_CLARK_Text_Defeat
dialogue.text: You outpaced me!$

dialogue.label: EventScript_RouteTrainer_ROUTE15_HIKER_CLARK_Text_Intro
dialogue.text: A road doesn't need a mountain\nto work your legs.\pROUTE 15 has enough rough ground\nfor me!$

dialogue.label: EventScript_RouteTrainer_ROUTE15_HIKER_CLARK_Text_PostBattle
dialogue.text: A HIKER notices where the land\nchanges.\pNear FUCHSIA, the road starts to\nfeel softer but no less tricky.$

dialogue.label: EventScript_RouteTrainer_ROUTE15_HIKER_CLARK_Text_RematchIntro
dialogue.text: I've walked this road again.\pMy boots and my POKéMON are\nsettled in now!$

dialogue.label: EventScript_RouteTrainer_ROUTE15_HIKER_TRENT_Text_Defeat
dialogue.text: Solid footing!$

dialogue.label: EventScript_RouteTrainer_ROUTE15_HIKER_TRENT_Text_Intro
dialogue.text: The stones here sit low, but they\nstill twist an ankle.\pStep carefully, then battle hard!$

dialogue.label: EventScript_RouteTrainer_ROUTE15_HIKER_TRENT_Text_PostBattle
dialogue.text: ROUTE 15 is a reminder that rough\nterrain isn't always tall terrain.\pSometimes it's right underfoot.$

dialogue.label: EventScript_RouteTrainer_ROUTE15_HIKER_TRENT_Text_RematchIntro
dialogue.text: You came back over the low stones.\pGood. Let's see if your team\nkept its footing!$

dialogue.label: EventScript_RouteTrainer_ROUTE15_BIKER_LUKAS_Text_Defeat
dialogue.text: You took the inside line!$

dialogue.label: EventScript_RouteTrainer_ROUTE15_BIKER_LUKAS_Text_Intro
dialogue.text: This road gets tight near FUCHSIA.\pA BIKER has to make every turn\ncount!$

dialogue.label: EventScript_RouteTrainer_ROUTE15_BIKER_LUKAS_Text_PostBattle
dialogue.text: ROUTE 15 teaches control.\pToo much speed and you're in the\ngrass before you know it.$

dialogue.label: EventScript_RouteTrainer_ROUTE15_BIKER_LUKAS_Text_RematchIntro
dialogue.text: I tightened my turns since last\ntime.\pLet's see if you can keep up!$

dialogue.label: Route15_Text_ChesterDefeat
dialogue.text: They were right to be alert!$

dialogue.label: Route15_Text_ChesterIntro
dialogue.text: My birds get jumpy near the\nforest edge.\pSomething about this route keeps\nthem alert!$

dialogue.label: Route15_Text_ChesterPostBattle
dialogue.text: Bird keepers listen for changes.\pOn ROUTE 15, the wind sounds\ndifferent near the trees.$

dialogue.label: Route15_Text_ChesterRematchIntro
dialogue.text: My birds heard your steps before\nI did.\pThey're ready this time!$

dialogue.label: EventScript_RouteTrainer_ROUTE15_BIRD_KEEPER_MITCH_Text_Defeat
dialogue.text: Sharp eyes weren't enough!$

dialogue.label: EventScript_RouteTrainer_ROUTE15_BIRD_KEEPER_MITCH_Text_Intro
dialogue.text: My bird POKéMON watch travelers\narrive from FUCHSIA.\pThey picked you out!$

dialogue.label: EventScript_RouteTrainer_ROUTE15_BIRD_KEEPER_MITCH_Text_PostBattle
dialogue.text: Bird POKéMON like this route.\pThe forest edge gives cover, and\nthe road gives them sightlines.$

dialogue.label: EventScript_RouteTrainer_ROUTE15_BIRD_KEEPER_MITCH_Text_RematchIntro
dialogue.text: My birds picked you out again.\pThey know a strong TRAINER when\nthey see one!$

dialogue.label: EventScript_RouteTrainer_ROUTE15_BIRD_KEEPER_MARLON_Text_Defeat
dialogue.text: You ruled the sky!$

dialogue.label: EventScript_RouteTrainer_ROUTE15_BIRD_KEEPER_MARLON_Text_Intro
dialogue.text: The sky opens just enough here\nfor my birds to stretch out.\pLet's battle under it!$

dialogue.label: EventScript_RouteTrainer_ROUTE15_BIRD_KEEPER_MARLON_Text_PostBattle
dialogue.text: The trees make the air twist.\pA good bird keeper teaches quick\nturns before high climbs.$

dialogue.label: EventScript_RouteTrainer_ROUTE15_BIRD_KEEPER_MARLON_Text_RematchIntro
dialogue.text: The sky's clear again.\pMy birds want another go!$

dialogue.label: Route16_Text_LaoDefeat
dialogue.text: Tch.\nYou kept your line.$

dialogue.label: Route16_Text_LaoIntro
dialogue.text: CYCLING ROAD starts here.\pYou either control the slope,\nor the slope controls you.$

dialogue.label: Route16_Text_LaoPostBattle
dialogue.text: CELADON's polished streets end\nfast out here.\pThat's why we hang around.\nThe road has a rougher pulse.$

dialogue.label: Route16_Text_LaoRematchIntro
dialogue.text: Back at the top of CYCLING\nROAD?\pLet's see if you control the\nslope better this time.$

dialogue.label: Route16_Text_CamronDefeat
dialogue.text: That warmed me up too much!$

dialogue.label: Route16_Text_CamronIntro
dialogue.text: I warm up before the downhill\nrun.\pA battle gets the blood moving.$

dialogue.label: Route16_Text_CamronPostBattle
dialogue.text: A tough team helps when the\nroad is crowded.\pEveryone wants space before\nthe slope takes over.$

dialogue.label: Route16_Text_CamronRematchIntro
dialogue.text: I warmed up for the downhill\nrun again.\pA rematch should finish the job!$

dialogue.label: Route16_Text_LukeDefeat
dialogue.text: You didn't wobble!$

dialogue.label: Route16_Text_LukeIntro
dialogue.text: At the top of the slope,\neveryone acts brave.\pLet's see if you are.$

dialogue.label: Route16_Text_LukePostBattle
dialogue.text: The road south pulls at you.\pFirst lesson: don't fight the\nslope. Steer through it.$

dialogue.label: Route16_Text_LukeRematchIntro
dialogue.text: Still brave at the top of the\nslope?\pGood. Prove it again!$

dialogue.label: Route16_Text_RubenDefeat
dialogue.text: You rode right through!$

dialogue.label: Route16_Text_RubenIntro
dialogue.text: West of CELADON, the air\nchanges.\pSmells like rubber, grass,\nand trouble.$

dialogue.label: Route16_Text_RubenPostBattle
dialogue.text: ROUTE 16 is a staging line.\pOnce you roll south, CYCLING\nROAD takes over.$

dialogue.label: Route16_Text_RubenRematchIntro
dialogue.text: Smell that?\pRubber, grass, and another\nbattle on ROUTE 16.$

dialogue.label: Route16_Text_JedDefeat
dialogue.text: JED: That was a proper battle!$

dialogue.label: Route16_Text_JedIntro
dialogue.text: JED: LEA and I are watching\ntrainers choose between CELADON\land the slope.\pShow us a proper battle!$

dialogue.label: Route16_Text_JedNotEnoughMons
dialogue.text: JED: This is a DOUBLE BATTLE.\pBring two POKéMON, then show us\nyour teamwork.$

dialogue.label: Route16_Text_JedPostBattle
dialogue.text: JED: CELADON makes for a fine\ndate, but this view is better.\pYou can feel KANTO stretching\nout from here.$

dialogue.label: Route16_Text_JedRematchIntro
dialogue.text: JED: Back to choose between\nCELADON and the slope?\pShow LEA and me another proper\nbattle first!$

dialogue.label: Route16_Text_LeaDefeat
dialogue.text: LEA: That echoed down the road!$

dialogue.label: Route16_Text_LeaIntro
dialogue.text: LEA: The city noise fades right\nhere.\pLet's make some battle noise\ninstead!$

dialogue.label: Route16_Text_LeaNotEnoughMons
dialogue.text: LEA: We need a pair against\na pair.\pCome back with two POKéMON,\nokay?$

dialogue.label: Route16_Text_LeaPostBattle
dialogue.text: LEA: Trainers come from CELADON\nwith clean shoes.\pThey leave ROUTE 16 ready for\ndust and downhill speed.$

dialogue.label: Route16_Text_LeaRematchIntro
dialogue.text: LEA: The city got quiet again.\pLet's make ROUTE 16 echo with\nanother battle!$

dialogue.label: EventScript_RouteTrainer_ROUTE16_LASS_JULIA_Text_Defeat
dialogue.text: You didn't slow down at all!$

dialogue.label: EventScript_RouteTrainer_ROUTE16_LASS_JULIA_Text_Intro
dialogue.text: CELADON is right there, but\neveryone speeds off toward\lCYCLING ROAD.\pSlow down and battle me first!$

dialogue.label: EventScript_RouteTrainer_ROUTE16_LASS_JULIA_Text_PostBattle
dialogue.text: ROUTE 16 feels like a doorway.\pOne side is city streets, the\nother is rushing downhill.$

dialogue.label: EventScript_RouteTrainer_ROUTE16_LASS_JULIA_Text_RematchIntro
dialogue.text: Back at the edge of CELADON?\pGood. I saved another battle\nbefore you hit the slope!$

dialogue.label: EventScript_RouteTrainer_ROUTE16_SCOUT_ARIANA_Text_Defeat
dialogue.text: Your team is ready for the slope!$

dialogue.label: EventScript_RouteTrainer_ROUTE16_SCOUT_ARIANA_Text_Intro
dialogue.text: A good rider checks the ground\nbefore a long ride.\pLet's check your team, too!$

dialogue.label: EventScript_RouteTrainer_ROUTE16_SCOUT_ARIANA_Text_PostBattle
dialogue.text: The best place to rest is before\nthe road gets steep.\pAfter that, your wheels make\nmost of the choices.$

dialogue.label: EventScript_RouteTrainer_ROUTE16_SCOUT_ARIANA_Text_RematchIntro
dialogue.text: Still training at the top of\nCYCLING ROAD?\pThen I'll check your team again!$

dialogue.label: Route17_Text_VirgilDefeat
dialogue.text: Clean pass!$

dialogue.label: Route17_Text_VirgilIntro
dialogue.text: Heading down toward FUCHSIA?\pThen you need road sense as much\nas speed.$

dialogue.label: Route17_Text_VirgilPostBattle
dialogue.text: The best rides are the ones\nwhere you never panic.\pROUTE 17 rewards calm hands.$

dialogue.label: Route17_Text_VirgilRematchIntro
dialogue.text: Heading down toward FUCHSIA\nagain?\pThen prove your road sense again.$

dialogue.label: Route17_Text_IsaiahDefeat
dialogue.text: Whoo!\nYou held steady!$

dialogue.label: Route17_Text_IsaiahIntro
dialogue.text: Holding steady on this road\ntakes muscle.\pLet's see how strong your stance\nis!$

dialogue.label: Route17_Text_IsaiahPostBattle
dialogue.text: I train here because the road\nnever lets you coast forever.\pEven stopping is a workout.$

dialogue.label: Route17_Text_IsaiahRematchIntro
dialogue.text: Still holding steady on this\ndownhill road?\pShow me that stance again!$

dialogue.label: Route17_Text_RaulDefeat
dialogue.text: I lost my grip!$

dialogue.label: Route17_Text_RaulIntro
dialogue.text: People drop all kinds of things\nwhen the slope gets fast.\pBattle me before you check the\nroadside!$

dialogue.label: Route17_Text_RaulPostBattle
dialogue.text: You can find good stuff lying\naround on CYCLING ROAD.\pThe trick is stopping safely\nbefore you pick it up.$

dialogue.label: Route17_Text_RaulRematchIntro
dialogue.text: Back to search the roadside?\pBattle me before you check what\nthe slope shook loose.$

dialogue.label: Route17_Text_NikolasDefeat
dialogue.text: Grounded out!$

dialogue.label: Route17_Text_NikolasIntro
dialogue.text: A sharp spark keeps riders awake\non the long downhill.\pLet VOLTORB jolt you!$

dialogue.label: Route17_Text_NikolasPostBattle
dialogue.text: I caught VOLTORB before the\nPOWER PLANT reopened. It likes\pthis road's constant motion as\nmuch as I do.$

dialogue.label: Route17_Text_NikolasRematchIntro
dialogue.text: VOLTORB's charged from all this\nmotion.\pReady for another jolt?$

dialogue.label: Route17_Text_JamalDefeat
dialogue.text: Whew!\nGood workout!$

dialogue.label: Route17_Text_JamalIntro
dialogue.text: This road is my exercise track.\pA battle halfway down keeps the\nlegs honest!$

dialogue.label: Route17_Text_JamalPostBattle
dialogue.text: Going downhill sounds easy until\nyou have to keep control.\pThat's where the workout hides.$

dialogue.label: Route17_Text_JamalRematchIntro
dialogue.text: Back for another halfway-down\nworkout?\pGood. My legs were getting lazy!$

dialogue.label: Route17_Text_JaxonDefeat
dialogue.text: Smooth handling!$

dialogue.label: Route17_Text_JaxonIntro
dialogue.text: Nice BIKE!\pHow's it handle when the road\nstarts dragging you south?$

dialogue.label: Route17_Text_JaxonPostBattle
dialogue.text: The slope makes it hard to steer.\pIf your hands get tense, the\nwhole ride gets worse.$

dialogue.label: Route17_Text_JaxonRematchIntro
dialogue.text: Still riding that BIKE?\pShow me how it handles in a\nrematch!$

dialogue.label: EventScript_RouteTrainer_ROUTE17_LASS_KAY_Text_Defeat
dialogue.text: You flew past me!$

dialogue.label: EventScript_RouteTrainer_ROUTE17_LASS_KAY_Text_Intro
dialogue.text: I came out from CELADON to watch\nthe bikes fly past.\pWatching made me want a battle!$

dialogue.label: EventScript_RouteTrainer_ROUTE17_LASS_KAY_Text_PostBattle
dialogue.text: CYCLING ROAD looks intimidating,\nbut everyone finds a pace.\pEven watching has a rhythm.$

dialogue.label: EventScript_RouteTrainer_ROUTE17_LASS_KAY_Text_RematchIntro
dialogue.text: Back on the fast road?\pGood. I was hoping to see your\nteam fly past again!$

dialogue.label: EventScript_RouteTrainer_ROUTE17_SCOUT_LEAH_Text_Defeat
dialogue.text: You made good use of the stop!$

dialogue.label: EventScript_RouteTrainer_ROUTE17_SCOUT_LEAH_Text_Intro
dialogue.text: A good rider marks places to\npause on a long route.\pThis one has room for a battle!$

dialogue.label: EventScript_RouteTrainer_ROUTE17_SCOUT_LEAH_Text_PostBattle
dialogue.text: ROUTE 17 is long, but it is not\nempty.\pGood rest points turn a hard road\ninto a manageable one.$

dialogue.label: EventScript_RouteTrainer_ROUTE17_SCOUT_LEAH_Text_RematchIntro
dialogue.text: Back at my marked rest point?\pThen you're rested enough for\nanother battle!$

dialogue.label: Route17_EventScript_Milo_Text_Defeat
dialogue.text: You passed me!$

dialogue.label: Route17_EventScript_Milo_Text_Intro
dialogue.text: I ride beside the BIKERS until\nmy legs ache. My team still has\penergy for you!$

dialogue.label: Route17_EventScript_Milo_Text_PostBattle
dialogue.text: This route is long enough for a\nrace and narrow enough for a\nbattle.$

dialogue.label: Route17_EventScript_Milo_Text_RematchIntro
dialogue.text: Chain checked, tyres ready. One\nbattle before my next ride!$

dialogue.label: Route17_EventScript_Tess_Text_Defeat
dialogue.text: Lost count!$

dialogue.label: Route17_EventScript_Tess_Text_Intro
dialogue.text: I count BIKERS as they pass.\pYou're trainer number too many\nnot to challenge!$

dialogue.label: Route17_EventScript_Tess_Text_PostBattle
dialogue.text: The best part of CYCLING ROAD\nis watching everyone find their\nown pace.$

dialogue.label: Route17_EventScript_Tess_Text_RematchIntro
dialogue.text: I counted you coming back.\pThat means I get another battle!$

dialogue.label: Route17_EventScript_June_Text_Defeat
dialogue.text: There goes my rhythm!$

dialogue.label: Route17_EventScript_June_Text_Intro
dialogue.text: My food is strapped to the bike,\nbut the wind keeps pulling at\pthe bag! Let's stop for a match.$

dialogue.label: Route17_EventScript_June_Text_PostBattle
dialogue.text: I eat before the last climb. An\nempty stomach makes for heavy\ppedals.$

dialogue.label: Route17_EventScript_June_Text_RematchIntro
dialogue.text: Back on the windy stretch?\pGood. My lunch can wait for\none more battle!$

dialogue.label: Route17_EventScript_Miles_Text_Defeat
dialogue.text: You drowned out my wheels!$

dialogue.label: Route17_EventScript_Miles_Text_Intro
dialogue.text: I mark the middle stretch by\nhow loud the wheels get.\pYou're right on time for battle!$

dialogue.label: Route17_EventScript_Miles_Text_PostBattle
dialogue.text: Halfway down, riders either\nsettle in or lose focus.\pI battle the ones who still\nlook sharp.$

dialogue.label: Route17_EventScript_Miles_Text_RematchIntro
dialogue.text: Heard your wheels coming.\pLet's make the middle stretch\nloud again!$

dialogue.label: Route17_EventScript_Wade_Text_Defeat
dialogue.text: You took the bend!$

dialogue.label: Route17_EventScript_Wade_Text_Intro
dialogue.text: I guard this bend because people\ntake it too fast.\pBattle me, then brake harder!$

dialogue.label: Route17_EventScript_Wade_Text_PostBattle
dialogue.text: The bend teaches patience.\pRush it and the road chooses\nyour line for you.$

dialogue.label: Route17_EventScript_Wade_Text_RematchIntro
dialogue.text: Back at the bend?\pGood. Brake, battle, then roll.$

dialogue.label: Route17_EventScript_Orson_Text_Defeat
dialogue.text: Solid braking!$

dialogue.label: Route17_EventScript_Orson_Text_Intro
dialogue.text: The lower slope gets faster\nthan people expect.\pIf you can stop for battle,\nyou're doing fine.$

dialogue.label: Route17_EventScript_Orson_Text_PostBattle
dialogue.text: Anyone can roll downhill.\pA good rider chooses exactly\nwhere to stop.$

dialogue.label: Route17_EventScript_Orson_Text_RematchIntro
dialogue.text: Managed to stop on the lower\nslope again?\pThen you can stop for a rematch.$

dialogue.label: Route17_EventScript_Vaughn_Text_Defeat
dialogue.text: Clean enough!$

dialogue.label: Route17_EventScript_Vaughn_Text_Intro
dialogue.text: The road gets narrow here.\pThat means we settle things\nquick and clean.$

dialogue.label: Route17_EventScript_Vaughn_Text_PostBattle
dialogue.text: A long road needs clear lanes.\pWithout them, everyone eats dust.$

dialogue.label: Route17_EventScript_Vaughn_Text_RematchIntro
dialogue.text: Back in my lane?\pThen we settle it quick and\nclean again.$

dialogue.label: Route17_EventScript_Mina_Text_Defeat
dialogue.text: You kept up!$

dialogue.label: Route17_EventScript_Mina_Text_Intro
dialogue.text: Near the bottom, everyone stops\npedalling. That's when I put on\pa final burst!$

dialogue.label: Route17_EventScript_Mina_Text_PostBattle
dialogue.text: FUCHSIA feels close from here,\nbut ROUTE 17 still has teeth.$

dialogue.label: Route17_EventScript_Mina_Text_RematchIntro
dialogue.text: You came back to the lower road?\pThen don't relax yet. Race me!$

dialogue.label: Route17_EventScript_Nico_Text_Defeat
dialogue.text: Outpaced!$

dialogue.label: Route17_EventScript_Nico_Text_Intro
dialogue.text: Running and swimming can wait.\nToday I'm working on my cycling!\pTry to match our cadence!$

dialogue.label: Route17_EventScript_Nico_Text_PostBattle
dialogue.text: I keep my pedals turning evenly\nover the rough patches. A steady\peffort gets me farther.$

dialogue.label: Route17_EventScript_Nico_Text_RematchIntro
dialogue.text: I've ridden the downhill stretch\nagain. Let's test my team's\pfinish!$

dialogue.label: Route17_EventScript_Erin_Text_Defeat
dialogue.text: You saved plenty!$

dialogue.label: Route17_EventScript_Erin_Text_Intro
dialogue.text: I picked a rest spot near the\nbottom of CYCLING ROAD.\pIf you still have energy, battle\nme before ROUTE 18!$

dialogue.label: Route17_EventScript_Erin_Text_PostBattle
dialogue.text: By this point, everyone starts\nthinking about FUCHSIA.\pI like making them pause one\nlast time.$

dialogue.label: Route17_EventScript_Erin_Text_RematchIntro
dialogue.text: Back near the end of the slope?\pGood. Let's see if you saved\nenough energy for me!$

dialogue.label: EventScript_RouteTrainer_ROUTE17_TRIATHLETE_DAX_Text_Defeat
dialogue.text: You kept pace!$

dialogue.label: EventScript_RouteTrainer_ROUTE17_TRIATHLETE_DAX_Text_Intro
dialogue.text: I practise keeping my wheels on\na clean line. My POKéMON train\pfor precise moves too!$

dialogue.label: EventScript_RouteTrainer_ROUTE17_TRIATHLETE_DAX_Text_PostBattle
dialogue.text: A TRIATHLETE learns fast legs are\nuseless without calm hands.$

dialogue.label: EventScript_RouteTrainer_ROUTE17_TRIATHLETE_DAX_Text_RematchIntro
dialogue.text: Another downhill ride is done.\nTime to test that steady\pcadence!$

dialogue.label: EventScript_RouteTrainer_ROUTE17_TRIATHLETE_NINA_Text_Defeat
dialogue.text: Fast finish!$

dialogue.label: EventScript_RouteTrainer_ROUTE17_TRIATHLETE_NINA_Text_Intro
dialogue.text: I time every lap from CELADON\nto FUCHSIA.\pLet's see your split!$

dialogue.label: EventScript_RouteTrainer_ROUTE17_TRIATHLETE_NINA_Text_PostBattle
dialogue.text: The road changes under your\nwheels.\pThat's what makes it training.$

dialogue.label: EventScript_RouteTrainer_ROUTE17_TRIATHLETE_NINA_Text_RematchIntro
dialogue.text: A new riding time to beat! Can\nmy team finish as strongly?$

dialogue.label: Route18_Text_JacobDefeat
dialogue.text: Road's yours!$

dialogue.label: Route18_Text_JacobIntro
dialogue.text: You want through to FUCHSIA?\pShow me you can handle the last\nstretch of the road.$

dialogue.label: Route18_Text_JacobPostBattle
dialogue.text: The downhill rush from CELADON\nends here by FUCHSIA.\pAfter this, the pace finally\nbelongs to your feet again.$

dialogue.label: Route18_Text_JacobRematchIntro
dialogue.text: Passing through to FUCHSIA again?\pThen show me you still handle\nthe last stretch.$

dialogue.label: Route18_Text_RamiroDefeat
dialogue.text: Your nerve held longer!$

dialogue.label: Route18_Text_RamiroIntro
dialogue.text: Cyclists barrel down from the\nnorth, so hold your line.\pSame goes for battling.$

dialogue.label: Route18_Text_RamiroPostBattle
dialogue.text: This little road catches all the\nmomentum from the slope.\pStand careless and it knocks\nyou sideways.$

dialogue.label: Route18_Text_RamiroRematchIntro
dialogue.text: Hold your line again.\pThe road is short, so this battle\nhas to be sharp!$

dialogue.label: Route18_Text_WiltonDefeat
dialogue.text: Still running hot!$

dialogue.label: Route18_Text_WiltonIntro
dialogue.text: CYCLING ROAD throws everyone\nout here with hot wheels.\pLet's see if your team cooled\ndown yet!$

dialogue.label: Route18_Text_WiltonPostBattle
dialogue.text: FUCHSIA gets quiet fast, but\nROUTE 18 still has the pulse\lof CYCLING ROAD.$

dialogue.label: Route18_Text_WiltonRematchIntro
dialogue.text: Back where CYCLING ROAD throws\neveryone out?\pLet's see if your team is still\nrunning hot!$

dialogue.label: Route18_Text_LenaDefeat
dialogue.text: You were quick too!$

dialogue.label: Route18_Text_LenaIntro
dialogue.text: I came out from FUCHSIA to watch\nthe cyclists race by.\pA battle is even more exciting!$

dialogue.label: Route18_Text_LenaPostBattle
dialogue.text: The city feels close here, even\nwith the trees around us.\pYou can hear FUCHSIA in the\nquiet between bikes.$

dialogue.label: Route18_Text_LenaRematchIntro
dialogue.text: Back from FUCHSIA already?\pGood. I wanted another battle\nwith the road rushing by!$

dialogue.label: Route18_Text_PaxtonDefeat
dialogue.text: Lesson learned!$

dialogue.label: Route18_Text_PaxtonIntro
dialogue.text: A short road still teaches you\nplenty if you pay attention.\pLesson one: battle before you\nrelax.$

dialogue.label: Route18_Text_PaxtonPostBattle
dialogue.text: I like training where town paths\nand open road meet.\pYou get careful trainers and\nreckless riders in one place.$

dialogue.label: Route18_Text_PaxtonRematchIntro
dialogue.text: Ready for lesson two?\pA short road can still teach\nyou twice.$

dialogue.label: Route18_Text_RinaDefeat
dialogue.text: Momentum gone!$

dialogue.label: Route18_Text_RinaIntro
dialogue.text: I packed light.\pROUTE 18 is all momentum,\nso you don't want loose bags!$

dialogue.label: Route18_Text_RinaPostBattle
dialogue.text: You can feel the whole road\npointing toward FUCHSIA.$

dialogue.label: Route18_Text_RinaRematchIntro
dialogue.text: Still packed light?\pThen you're ready for another\nmomentum battle!$

dialogue.label: Route19_Text_RichardDefeat
dialogue.text: Now I'm really warmed up!$

dialogue.label: Route19_Text_RichardIntro
dialogue.text: I warm up on the FUCHSIA shore\nbefore taking on the current.\pA battle should do it!$

dialogue.label: Route19_Text_RichardPostBattle
dialogue.text: ROUTE 19 looks calm from land,\nbut the water pulls hard once\lyou're out in it.$

dialogue.label: Route19_Text_RichardRematchIntro
dialogue.text: Back at the FUCHSIA shore?\pGood. I could use another warm-up\nbefore facing the current.$

dialogue.label: Route19_Text_TonyDefeat
dialogue.text: Caught in the undertow!$

dialogue.label: Route19_Text_TonyIntro
dialogue.text: The sea between FUCHSIA and\nSEAFOAM is never still.\pGood. Neither am I!$

dialogue.label: Route19_Text_TonyPostBattle
dialogue.text: Every wave here seems to push\nyou toward SEAFOAM.\pYou have to decide for yourself\nwhether to follow it.$

dialogue.label: Route19_Text_TonyRematchIntro
dialogue.text: The waves are pushing south,\nand you're back for more.\pLet's see who drifts first!$

dialogue.label: Route19_Text_MatthewDefeat
dialogue.text: That wake spun me round!$

dialogue.label: Route19_Text_MatthewIntro
dialogue.text: I love swimming south from\nFUCHSIA.\pThe whole sea opens up once\nthe shore disappears.$

dialogue.label: Route19_Text_MatthewPostBattle
dialogue.text: The ferry cuts a clean line\nthrough here.\pI try to stay out of its wake.$

dialogue.label: Route19_Text_MatthewRematchIntro
dialogue.text: The sea is open again!\pLet's battle before the ferry wake\nthrows off my rhythm.$

dialogue.label: Route19_Text_DavidDefeat
dialogue.text: Sent drifting!$

dialogue.label: Route19_Text_DavidIntro
dialogue.text: I tried diving near the rocks,\nbut the current shoved me back.\pBattling on the surface is safer.$

dialogue.label: Route19_Text_DavidPostBattle
dialogue.text: If you want fish-shaped POKéMON,\nbring a ROD.\pIf you want trouble, just splash\naround out here.$

dialogue.label: Route19_Text_DavidRematchIntro
dialogue.text: Still staying on the surface?\pSmart. The rocks and currents\nare rougher than they look.$

dialogue.label: Route19_Text_AliceDefeat
dialogue.text: Splashed out!$

dialogue.label: Route19_Text_AliceIntro
dialogue.text: Swimming's great!\nFerry spray in your face isn't!$

dialogue.label: Route19_Text_AlicePostBattle
dialogue.text: The route is shorter by ship,\nbut swimming lets you feel the\lsea change under you.$

dialogue.label: Route19_Text_AliceRematchIntro
dialogue.text: Swimming's great!\pGetting sprayed by the ferry\ntwice is less great!$

dialogue.label: Route19_Text_ConnieDefeat
dialogue.text: Now I'm exhausted…$

dialogue.label: Route19_Text_ConnieIntro
dialogue.text: I swam down from FUCHSIA with\nmy friends.\pI'm tired, but not done!$

dialogue.label: Route19_Text_ConniePostBattle
dialogue.text: The shore feels far away once\nyou're surrounded by waves.\pThat's why I never swim this\nroute alone.$

dialogue.label: Route19_Text_ConnieRematchIntro
dialogue.text: I saved enough energy for one\nmore battle.\pAfter that, I'm floating back\ntoward FUCHSIA.$

dialogue.label: Route19_Text_LiaDefeat
dialogue.text: LIA: The sea got away from us!$

dialogue.label: Route19_Text_LiaIntro
dialogue.text: LIA: I'm keeping an eye on LUC.\nROUTE 19's current is strong.\pBut battling together will help\nhim learn the sea!$

dialogue.label: Route19_Text_LiaNotEnoughMons
dialogue.text: LIA: We only battle together.\pDon't you have two POKéMON?$

dialogue.label: Route19_Text_LiaPostBattle
dialogue.text: LIA: LUC is braver when he can\nsee FUCHSIA behind us.\pNext time, maybe he'll lead us\ntoward SEAFOAM.$

dialogue.label: Route19_Text_LiaRematchIntro
dialogue.text: LIA: LUC is reading the waves\nbetter now.\pBattle us again and you'll see!$

dialogue.label: Route19_Text_LucDefeat
dialogue.text: LUC: We got swept back!$

dialogue.label: Route19_Text_LucIntro
dialogue.text: LUC: My big sis says the current\nis easier if we move together.\pOur POKéMON do that too!$

dialogue.label: Route19_Text_LucNotEnoughMons
dialogue.text: LUC: I battle with LIA!\pDon't you have two POKéMON?$

dialogue.label: Route19_Text_LucPostBattle
dialogue.text: LUC: I want to swim all the way\nto SEAFOAM someday.\pLIA says I have to read the\nwaves first.$

dialogue.label: Route19_Text_LucRematchIntro
dialogue.text: LUC: I watched the current like\nLIA told me!\pNow I can battle better too!$

dialogue.label: Route2_Text_GarretDefeat
dialogue.text: You spotted my strategy!$

dialogue.label: Route2_Text_GarretIntro
dialogue.text: BUG POKéMON drift out from\nVIRIDIAN FOREST onto this road.\pI watch the grass for movement!$

dialogue.label: Route2_Text_GarretPostBattle
dialogue.text: ROUTE 2 is perfect for bug study.\pForest shade on one side,\nopen grass on the other.$

dialogue.label: Route2_Text_GarretRematchIntro
dialogue.text: I've watched the grass since our\nlast battle.\pThis time, my bugs will move first!$

dialogue.label: Route2_Text_JonahDefeat
dialogue.text: My bugs lost their footing!$

dialogue.label: Route2_Text_JonahIntro
dialogue.text: The forest entrance is close. If\nyou can handle my bugs, you can\phandle the path ahead!$

dialogue.label: Route2_Text_JonahPostBattle
dialogue.text: The trees make ROUTE 2 feel calm,\nbut the grass is always busy.$

dialogue.label: Route2_Text_JonahRematchIntro
dialogue.text: You've crossed beneath those\ntrees before. Let's see if my\pbugs can still slow you down!$

dialogue.label: Route2_Text_ShaneDefeat
dialogue.text: You know the trail well!$

dialogue.label: Route2_Text_ShaneIntro
dialogue.text: I set camp where the road bends\nbetween VIRIDIAN and PEWTER.\pEvery traveler passes this shade!$

dialogue.label: Route2_Text_ShanePostBattle
dialogue.text: A shaded route keeps your team\nfresh.\pThat's why I like camping here.$

dialogue.label: Route2_Text_ShaneRematchIntro
dialogue.text: Back through ROUTE 2?\pThen let's see what the forest road\nhas taught you!$

dialogue.label: Route2_Text_NancyDefeat
dialogue.text: That was a lively picnic!$

dialogue.label: Route2_Text_NancyIntro
dialogue.text: I picked this spot for lunch.\pYou can hear the forest without\nstepping under the trees.$

dialogue.label: Route2_Text_NancyPostBattle
dialogue.text: ROUTE 2 is long, but the forest\nbreaks it into little resting spots.$

dialogue.label: Route2_Text_NancyRematchIntro
dialogue.text: I've had another picnic and another\ntraining session.\pReady for both?$

dialogue.label: Route2_Text_OrinDefeat
dialogue.text: They cooled off too fast!$

dialogue.label: Route2_Text_OrinIntro
dialogue.text: The best bugs are just outside\nthe forest, where they warm up\lin the grass!$

dialogue.label: Route2_Text_OrinPostBattle
dialogue.text: Morning light hits the route before\nit reaches the deep forest.\pBUG POKéMON notice that.$

dialogue.label: Route2_Text_OrinRematchIntro
dialogue.text: The sun warmed up my whole team\ntoday.\pReady for another forest-edge\nbattle?$

dialogue.label: Route2_Text_RowanDefeat
dialogue.text: You kept your bearings!$

dialogue.label: Route2_Text_RowanIntro
dialogue.text: A good forest route gives you\ncover, quiet, and a clear path.\pLet me test your trail sense!$

dialogue.label: Route2_Text_RowanPostBattle
dialogue.text: Keep one eye on the grass and one\neye on the treeline.\pThat's forest-route travel.$

dialogue.label: Route2_Text_RowanRematchIntro
dialogue.text: You found the path once already.\pNow let's see if you can read\nthe trail under pressure!$

dialogue.label: Route2_Text_LyraDefeat
dialogue.text: I need a snack break!$

dialogue.label: Route2_Text_LyraIntro
dialogue.text: I brought snacks for the forest\nedge.\pBattles make them taste better!$

dialogue.label: Route2_Text_LyraPostBattle
dialogue.text: The forest entrance is a good place\nto rest before heading north.$

dialogue.label: Route2_Text_LyraRematchIntro
dialogue.text: I packed extra snacks this time.\pA rematch on ROUTE 2 deserves\nproper supplies!$

dialogue.label: Route2_Text_MiloDefeat
dialogue.text: That's worth recording!$

dialogue.label: Route2_Text_MiloIntro
dialogue.text: POKéMON behave differently where\nwoods meet open road.\pI'm studying that boundary.$

dialogue.label: Route2_Text_MiloPostBattle
dialogue.text: Forest POKéMON are less shy near\nROUTE 2 once they know the path is\lsafe.$

dialogue.label: Route2_Text_MiloRematchIntro
dialogue.text: Your team changed my notes on\nforest-edge behavior.\pLet's gather another sample!$

dialogue.label: Route2_Text_EllisDefeat
dialogue.text: My secret spot failed me!$

dialogue.label: Route2_Text_EllisIntro
dialogue.text: Inside the forest is obvious.\pThe real bug secrets are here,\nright at the edge!$

dialogue.label: Route2_Text_EllisPostBattle
dialogue.text: Bugs cross from bark to grass and\nback again.\pThat's why I watch the edge.$

dialogue.label: Route2_Text_EllisRematchIntro
dialogue.text: I found a new secret at the edge.\pThis one is called: don't lose\nthe rematch!$

dialogue.label: Route2_Text_IvyDefeat
dialogue.text: You travel with care.$

dialogue.label: Route2_Text_IvyIntro
dialogue.text: I patrol ROUTE 2 because it links\nVIRIDIAN, PEWTER, and the forest.\pShow me you can travel safely!$

dialogue.label: Route2_Text_IvyPostBattle
dialogue.text: A route this useful needs looking\nafter.\pForest paths can change quickly.$

dialogue.label: Route2_Text_IvyRematchIntro
dialogue.text: Good to see you travelling ROUTE 2\nagain.\pShow me your team is still ready\nfor changing paths!$

dialogue.label: Route20_Text_MelissaDefeat
dialogue.text: Too cold!$

dialogue.label: Route20_Text_MelissaIntro
dialogue.text: CINNABAR's volcano warms the sea\nwest of here.\pBut around SEAFOAM? Brrr!$

dialogue.label: Route20_Text_MelissaPostBattle
dialogue.text: CINNABAR and SEAFOAM feel like\nopposites on one route.\pWarm rock to the west, cold cave\nwater in the middle.$

dialogue.label: Route20_Text_MelissaRematchIntro
dialogue.text: Warm CINNABAR, cold SEAFOAM,\nand one more battle between them!$

dialogue.label: Route20_Text_NoraDefeat
dialogue.text: Lost the shine!$

dialogue.label: Route20_Text_NoraIntro
dialogue.text: The water here polishes stones\nand shells until they shine.\pMy POKéMON battle just as bright!$

dialogue.label: Route20_Text_NoraPostBattle
dialogue.text: CLOYSTER like the cold currents\naround SEAFOAM.\pNo wonder pearls feel at home\nnear this island.$

dialogue.label: Route20_Text_NoraRematchIntro
dialogue.text: The water's still shining today.\pLet's see if my battle can shine\nbrighter than last time!$

dialogue.label: Route20_Text_DeanDefeat
dialogue.text: Form broke!$

dialogue.label: Route20_Text_DeanIntro
dialogue.text: Check out my open-water form!\pNo pool lane can teach you what\nRoute 20 does.$

dialogue.label: Route20_Text_DeanPostBattle
dialogue.text: I should train my POKéMON to\nhandle cross-currents too.$

dialogue.label: Route20_Text_DeanRematchIntro
dialogue.text: My open-water form is sharper\nthan before.\pRoute 20 keeps improving me!$

dialogue.label: Route20_Text_BarryDefeat
dialogue.text: Splashed flat!$

dialogue.label: Route20_Text_BarryIntro
dialogue.text: The water gets restless around\nSEAFOAM.\pIf you can battle here, you can\nkeep steady anywhere!$

dialogue.label: Route20_Text_BarryPostBattle
dialogue.text: The channel runs from CINNABAR\nto the open water by FUCHSIA.\pThat's a lot of sea to cross.$

dialogue.label: Route20_Text_BarryRematchIntro
dialogue.text: Back in SEAFOAM water?\pGood. Let's see if you can keep\nsteady twice!$

dialogue.label: Route20_Text_ShirleyDefeat
dialogue.text: Current got me!$

dialogue.label: Route20_Text_ShirleyIntro
dialogue.text: SEAFOAM looks peaceful until\nyou try swimming around it.\pThe current has teeth!$

dialogue.label: Route20_Text_ShirleyPostBattle
dialogue.text: There are caves under SEAFOAM.\pYou can feel the cold water\nmoving through them.$

dialogue.label: Route20_Text_ShirleyRematchIntro
dialogue.text: The current still has teeth.\pSo do I!$

dialogue.label: Route20_Text_TylerDefeat
dialogue.text: Drifted too far!$

dialogue.label: Route20_Text_TylerIntro
dialogue.text: I like floating where the waves\nsplit around SEAFOAM.\pBattle me before I drift off!$

dialogue.label: Route20_Text_TylerPostBattle
dialogue.text: Fish POKéMON gather where the\ncurrents slow.\pEverything else has to work to\nhold its place.$

dialogue.label: Route20_Text_TylerRematchIntro
dialogue.text: Back around SEAFOAM?\pLet's see if I can hold my line\nbetter this time!$

dialogue.label: Route20_Text_DarrinDefeat
dialogue.text: Ouch!\nTorpedoed!$

dialogue.label: Route20_Text_DarrinIntro
dialogue.text: The water near SEAFOAM bites back.\nThat's why I like it!\pLet's see if you bite back too.$

dialogue.label: Route20_Text_DarrinPostBattle
dialogue.text: If you can hold a course here,\nyou can swim almost anywhere.$

dialogue.label: Route20_Text_DarrinRematchIntro
dialogue.text: The water near SEAFOAM still\nbites back.\pSo let's bite back harder!$

dialogue.label: Route20_Text_RogerDefeat
dialogue.text: Overboard!$

dialogue.label: Route20_Text_RogerIntro
dialogue.text: I keep watch where the ferry\nroute meets the swimmers.\pThat means I watch battles too!$

dialogue.label: Route20_Text_RogerPostBattle
dialogue.text: SEAFOAM is a landmark, but the\nwater around it is the real map.$

dialogue.label: Route20_Text_RogerRematchIntro
dialogue.text: The ferry lane is clear.\pThat leaves plenty of room for\nour rematch!$

dialogue.label: Route20_Text_MissyDefeat
dialogue.text: Missed the turn!$

dialogue.label: Route20_Text_MissyIntro
dialogue.text: Swim, bike, run.\pThis channel is my open-water\ntraining course, and SEAFOAM is\nmy turn marker!$

dialogue.label: Route20_Text_MissyPostBattle
dialogue.text: SEAFOAM makes a perfect turning\npoint for a triathlon route.$

dialogue.label: Route20_Text_MissyRematchIntro
dialogue.text: One lap around SEAFOAM wasn't\nenough.\pA rematch is part of training!$

dialogue.label: Route20_Text_MarinerDefeat
dialogue.text: Agh!$

dialogue.label: Route20_Text_MarinerIntro
dialogue.text: I heard SEAFOAM got fractured\nwhen the cold arrived all at\lonce and reshaped the caves.$

dialogue.label: Route20_Text_MarinerPostBattle
dialogue.text:
You broke me into pieces too!\pSEAFOAM was split by a sudden
freeze. The caves still hold\lthat cold.\pThe two entrances meet in the
cavern below. A deeper stairway\lleads to an icy lake.\pTake your CASCADE BOARD if you
want to cross that water.$

dialogue.label: Route20_Text_MarinerRematchIntro
dialogue.text: Currents change before you notice.\pLet's see if your battle course\nhas changed too!$

dialogue.label: Text_ApexRumorRecorded
dialogue.text: Rumour recorded.\pCompare three accounts in your\nLOGBOOK to find an APEX POKéMON.\pIf you flee from its battle,\nit will leave for good.$

dialogue.label: Text_ApexRumorUpdated
dialogue.text: Rumour updated.$

dialogue.label: Route20_Text_LuisDefeat
dialogue.text: The cold got into my strategy!$

dialogue.label: Route20_Text_LuisIntro
dialogue.text: SEAFOAM's cold current keeps\ntrying to push me back.\pA battle ought to warm us up!$

dialogue.label: Route20_Text_LuisPostBattle
dialogue.text: The current here is rough, but\nit teaches you how to keep your\nline in open water.$

dialogue.label: Route20_Text_LuisRematchIntro
dialogue.text: Back in the cold current?\pGood. I could use another\nwarm-up battle!$

dialogue.label: Route20_Text_IreneDefeat
dialogue.text: I missed my stroke!$

dialogue.label: Route20_Text_IreneIntro
dialogue.text: The sea is rough enough to make\nevery stroke count.\pThat's perfect training for me!$

dialogue.label: Route20_Text_IrenePostBattle
dialogue.text: A triathlon route around SEAFOAM\ndoesn't forgive lazy turns.\pThe island tells you exactly\nwhere your stamina ends.$

dialogue.label: Route20_Text_IreneRematchIntro
dialogue.text: SEAFOAM is still my turn marker.\pTry to keep pace this time!$

dialogue.label: EventScript_RouteTrainer_TUBER_AMIRA_Text_Defeat
dialogue.text: Splashed again!$

dialogue.label: EventScript_RouteTrainer_TUBER_AMIRA_Text_Intro
dialogue.text: The grown-ups swim far out,\nbut I like the SEAFOAM shore.\pIt's still my battle spot!$

dialogue.label: EventScript_RouteTrainer_TUBER_AMIRA_Text_PostBattle
dialogue.text: The water is colder here than\nnear FUCHSIA.\pI can feel SEAFOAM breathing\nunder the waves.$

dialogue.label: EventScript_RouteTrainer_TUBER_AMIRA_Text_RematchIntro
dialogue.text: Back near SEAFOAM?\pThen my shore training gets\nanother test!$

dialogue.label: EventScript_RouteTrainer_TUBER_NOAH_Text_Defeat
dialogue.text: My timing slipped!$

dialogue.label: EventScript_RouteTrainer_TUBER_NOAH_Text_Intro
dialogue.text: I counted the ferry waves!\pIf I can time them, I can time\na battle too!$

dialogue.label: EventScript_RouteTrainer_TUBER_NOAH_Text_PostBattle
dialogue.text: Big swimmers go all the way to\nCINNABAR.\pI'm practising one wave at a\ntime.$

dialogue.label: EventScript_RouteTrainer_TUBER_NOAH_Text_RematchIntro
dialogue.text: The ferry made more waves!\pLet's battle before they settle.$

dialogue.label: Route20_Text_GorebyssTradeDone
dialogue.text: NIA: How is GOREBYSS doing?\pIt's amazing what a simple\ntrade can do for CLAMPERL!$

dialogue.label: Route20_Text_GorebyssTradeIntro
dialogue.text: NIA: You beat our team!\pI have another CLAMPERL holding\na DEEP SEA SCALE.\pTrade me a CLAMPERL, and mine\nwill become GOREBYSS for you!$

dialogue.label: Route20_Text_GorebyssTradeThanks
dialogue.text: NIA: There it is! GOREBYSS!\pThanks for the CLAMPERL.\nI'll take good care of it!$

dialogue.label: Route20_Text_HuntailTradeDone
dialogue.text: FINN: How is HUNTAIL doing?\pIt's amazing what a simple\ntrade can do for CLAMPERL!$

dialogue.label: Route20_Text_HuntailTradeIntro
dialogue.text: FINN: You beat our team!\pI have another CLAMPERL holding\na DEEP SEA TOOTH.\pTrade me a CLAMPERL, and mine\nwill become HUNTAIL for you!$

dialogue.label: Route20_Text_HuntailTradeThanks
dialogue.text: FINN: There it is! HUNTAIL!\pThanks for the CLAMPERL.\nI'll take good care of it!$

dialogue.label: Route20_Text_NiaFinnDefeat
dialogue.text: Our two paths met their match!$

dialogue.label: Route20_Text_NiaFinnIntro
dialogue.text: Our CLAMPERL took different paths.\nSee how they battle together!$

dialogue.label: Route20_Text_NiaFinnNotEnoughMons
dialogue.text: Bring two ready POKéMON\nso we can battle as a pair!$

dialogue.label: Trade_Text_DoYouHaveMonWantToTradeForMon
dialogue.text: Hi!\nDo you have a {STR_VAR_1}?\pWant to trade it for my\n{STR_VAR_2}?$

dialogue.label: Trade_Text_ThatsTooBad
dialogue.text: That's too bad.$

dialogue.label: Trade_Text_ThisIsNoMon
dialogue.text: …This is no {STR_VAR_1}.\pIf you get one, trade it with me.$

dialogue.label: Route21_North_Text_RonaldDefeat
dialogue.text: Line snapped!$

dialogue.label: Route21_North_Text_RonaldIntro
dialogue.text: Fish gather where PALLET's quiet\nwater starts to deepen.\pKeep still, or battle me!$

dialogue.label: Route21_North_Text_RonaldPostBattle
dialogue.text: Most people rush south toward\nCINNABAR.\pI like the north end. It rewards\npatience.$

dialogue.label: Route21_North_Text_RonaldRematchIntro
dialogue.text: The north water is quiet again.\pLet's see if the battle bites\nbefore the fish do!$

dialogue.label: Route21_North_Text_WadeDefeat
dialogue.text: My timing missed the wake!$

dialogue.label: Route21_North_Text_WadeIntro
dialogue.text: The ferry stirs up the water\nwhen it leaves PALLET.\pThat's when I cast my line!$

dialogue.label: Route21_North_Text_WadePostBattle
dialogue.text: A little wake can bring fish up\nfrom deeper water.\pThe trick is knowing when the\nsea is about to move.$

dialogue.label: Route21_North_Text_WadeRematchIntro
dialogue.text: The ferry wake brought the fish\nup again.\pMaybe it brought you back for a\nrematch too!$

dialogue.label: Route21_North_Text_SpencerDefeat
dialogue.text: Swept south!$

dialogue.label: Route21_North_Text_SpencerIntro
dialogue.text: ROUTE 21 starts gentle, then\nkeeps pulling south.\pI'll match that current!$

dialogue.label: Route21_North_Text_SpencerPostBattle
dialogue.text: From here you can still imagine\nPALLET behind you.\pA few strokes later, it's only\nyou and the water.$

dialogue.label: Route21_North_Text_SpencerRematchIntro
dialogue.text: Still swimming south from PALLET?\pGood. Let's see if the current\nmade you stronger!$

dialogue.label: Route21_North_Text_AnyaDefeat
dialogue.text: The tide turned!$

dialogue.label: Route21_North_Text_AnyaIntro
dialogue.text: This stretch links PALLET's quiet\nshore to the open southern sea.\pLet's see how you handle the\nfirst pull of the route.$

dialogue.label: Route21_North_Text_AnyaPostBattle
dialogue.text: The north water feels gentler,\nbut it still leads to CINNABAR.\pEvery current here knows where\nit's going.$

dialogue.label: Route21_North_Text_AnyaRematchIntro
dialogue.text: Back on ROUTE 21?\pLet's see if the current has made\nyou stronger!$

dialogue.label: Route21_North_Text_IanDefeat
dialogue.text: IAN: We got pulled apart!$

dialogue.label: Route21_North_Text_IanIntro
dialogue.text: IAN: LIL keeps us steady when\nthe route starts pulling south.\pI'll show you how we battle!$

dialogue.label: Route21_North_Text_IanNotEnoughMons
dialogue.text: IAN: LIL and I battle together.\pBring two POKéMON before you\nchallenge us, okay?$

dialogue.label: Route21_North_Text_IanPostBattle
dialogue.text: IAN: PALLET feels far away once\nyou're in the middle of Route 21.\pThat's why we practise together.$

dialogue.label: Route21_North_Text_IanRematchIntro
dialogue.text: IAN: LIL says we're steadier now.\pI want to prove it in a rematch!$

dialogue.label: Route21_North_Text_LilDefeat
dialogue.text: LIL: The current won that one!$

dialogue.label: Route21_North_Text_LilIntro
dialogue.text: LIL: We're practising the swim\nfrom PALLET.\pIAN says we have to battle as a\nteam too.$

dialogue.label: Route21_North_Text_LilNotEnoughMons
dialogue.text: LIL: We only battle together.\pBring two POKéMON, won't you?$

dialogue.label: Route21_North_Text_LilPostBattle
dialogue.text: LIL: The sea feels less scary\nwhen IAN swims beside me.$

dialogue.label: Route21_North_Text_LilRematchIntro
dialogue.text: LIL: IAN and I practised staying\ntogether in the current.\pLet's try another battle!$

dialogue.label: EventScript_RouteTrainer_TUBER_ALEXIS_Text_Defeat
dialogue.text: You tipped my float!$

dialogue.label: EventScript_RouteTrainer_TUBER_ALEXIS_Text_Intro
dialogue.text: I came down from PALLET to play\nwhere the water starts getting\ldeep.\pI'm not scared of ROUTE 21!$

dialogue.label: EventScript_RouteTrainer_TUBER_ALEXIS_Text_PostBattle
dialogue.text: The grown-ups swim farther south,\nbut I like staying near PALLET.\pThis part of ROUTE 21 is big\nenough for me.$

dialogue.label: EventScript_RouteTrainer_TUBER_ALEXIS_Text_RematchIntro
dialogue.text: Back where PALLET's beach turns\ninto a real sea route?\pThen I want another battle!$

dialogue.label: Route21_South_Text_ClaudeDefeat
dialogue.text: There goes the bite!$

dialogue.label: Route21_South_Text_ClaudeIntro
dialogue.text: Hey, don't scare away the fish!\pThe CINNABAR current makes them\nbite in strange patterns.$

dialogue.label: Route21_South_Text_ClaudePostBattle
dialogue.text: The water rolls differently near\nCINNABAR.\pFish know it. Fishermen are still\ntrying to learn.$

dialogue.label: Route21_South_Text_ClaudeRematchIntro
dialogue.text: The CINNABAR current is strange\ntoday.\pIf the fish won't bite, maybe\nyou'll battle!$

dialogue.label: Route21_South_Text_NolanDefeat
dialogue.text: Hook slipped!$

dialogue.label: Route21_South_Text_NolanIntro
dialogue.text: Keep me company till I get a hit.\pOr better yet, battle me while\nthe line is quiet.$

dialogue.label: Route21_South_Text_NolanPostBattle
dialogue.text: Oh wait!\nI got a bite! Yeah!\pRoute 21 makes you wait, but it\ndoesn't forget you.$

dialogue.label: Route21_South_Text_NolanRematchIntro
dialogue.text: Still waiting on a big catch.\pA rematch will keep the line from\nfeeling too quiet.$

dialogue.label: Route21_South_Text_JackDefeat
dialogue.text: Dragged under!$

dialogue.label: Route21_South_Text_JackIntro
dialogue.text: I caught my POKéMON in the long\nwater north of CINNABAR.\pThey know this route's rhythm!$

dialogue.label: Route21_South_Text_JackPostBattle
dialogue.text: Route 21 changes as you go south.\pThe water near CINNABAR feels\nwarmer and heavier.$

dialogue.label: Route21_South_Text_JackRematchIntro
dialogue.text: My POKéMON know this whole\nstretch north of CINNABAR now.\pReady to test them again?$

dialogue.label: Route21_South_Text_NicoleDefeat
dialogue.text: I lost my rhythm in the current.$

dialogue.label: Route21_South_Text_NicoleIntro
dialogue.text: CINNABAR's warm water meets the\ncooler sea here.\pThat's my favorite training spot,\nand my favorite battle spot!$

dialogue.label: Route21_South_Text_NicolePostBattle
dialogue.text: The island changes the current.\nYou can feel it before you see it.\pThat's how you know CINNABAR is\nclose.$

dialogue.label: Route21_South_Text_NicoleRematchIntro
dialogue.text: The water's different every time.\pSo is my battling!$

dialogue.label: Route21_South_Text_JeromeDefeat
dialogue.text: Lost my pace!$

dialogue.label: Route21_South_Text_JeromeIntro
dialogue.text: I'm timing my swim from PALLET\nall the way to CINNABAR.\pBattle me without breaking pace!$

dialogue.label: Route21_South_Text_JeromePostBattle
dialogue.text: This route is long enough to\nturn confidence into fatigue.\pThat's why I train here.$

dialogue.label: Route21_South_Text_JeromeRematchIntro
dialogue.text: PALLET to CINNABAR is a long\ntraining line.\pA rematch keeps the pace honest!$

dialogue.label: Route21_South_Text_RolandDefeat
dialogue.text: The breeze dropped!$

dialogue.label: Route21_South_Text_RolandIntro
dialogue.text: Feel that sea breeze?\pCINNABAR is close enough to\nchange the air!$

dialogue.label: Route21_South_Text_RolandPostBattle
dialogue.text: The sun hits different near\nvolcanic rock.\pNo wonder swimmers slow down\nbefore CINNABAR.$

dialogue.label: Route21_South_Text_RolandRematchIntro
dialogue.text: CINNABAR's breeze is blowing\nstrong again.\pLet's ride it into a rematch!$

dialogue.label: Route22_Text_JeffDefeat
dialogue.text: Lost my footing!$

dialogue.label: Route22_Text_JeffIntro
dialogue.text: I camp on ROUTE 22 because the\nroad feels wilder than VIRIDIAN.\pLet's see how you handle rough\nground!$

dialogue.label: Route22_Text_JeffPostBattle
dialogue.text: This route is the first place west\nof VIRIDIAN that feels properly\lrugged.\pThat's why SCOUTS learn a lot\nhere.$

dialogue.label: Route22_Text_JeffRematchIntro
dialogue.text: Back from the city road?\pGood. ROUTE 22 should test your\nfooting again!$

dialogue.label: Route22_Text_AliciaDefeat
dialogue.text: You noticed my opening!$

dialogue.label: Route22_Text_AliciaIntro
dialogue.text: The LEAGUE gate makes this road\nfeel serious.\pA SCOUT still has to notice the\nsmall paths too!$

dialogue.label: Route22_Text_AliciaPostBattle
dialogue.text: People stare north toward the\nLEAGUE, but ROUTE 22 spreads out\lbefore that.\pThere's always more than one way\nto cross rough terrain.$

dialogue.label: Route22_Text_AliciaRematchIntro
dialogue.text: I checked the rocks, grass, and\ngate road again.\pNow I want to check your team!$

dialogue.label: Route22_Text_JarenDefeat
dialogue.text: I took that corner too sharply!$

dialogue.label: Route22_Text_JarenIntro
dialogue.text: This broken-up road is perfect\nfor hard turns.\pLet's see if your battle style\ncan corner like that!$

dialogue.label: Route22_Text_JarenPostBattle
dialogue.text: Flat roads make lazy riders.\pROUTE 22 keeps your hands tight\nand your eyes open.$

dialogue.label: Route22_Text_JarenRematchIntro
dialogue.text: I know every bend between\nVIRIDIAN and the LEAGUE gate.\pTry keeping up again!$

dialogue.label: Route22_Text_RobertDefeat
dialogue.text: My wings dipped!$

dialogue.label: Route22_Text_RobertIntro
dialogue.text: Birds ride the wind coming down\nfrom the LEAGUE cliffs.\pMy team trains in that air!$

dialogue.label: Route22_Text_RobertPostBattle
dialogue.text: The closer you get to the LEAGUE,\nthe stronger the wind feels.\pBird POKéMON love a road that\nmakes them work.$

dialogue.label: Route22_Text_RobertRematchIntro
dialogue.text: The wind changed since last time.\pLet's see if our battle changes\nwith it!$

dialogue.label: Route22_Text_JeremyDefeat
dialogue.text: Rolled downhill!$

dialogue.label: Route22_Text_JeremyIntro
dialogue.text: You can feel the land rising\ntoward the LEAGUE gate.\pA HIKER notices every slope!$

dialogue.label: Route22_Text_JeremyPostBattle
dialogue.text: ROUTE 22 is rough, but not wild\nwithout purpose.\pIt prepares your legs before the\nLEAGUE road gets serious.$

dialogue.label: Route22_Text_JeremyRematchIntro
dialogue.text: Back on the west road?\pThen let's climb into another\nbattle!$

dialogue.label: Route22_Text_TriathleteFLandDefeat
dialogue.text: I need to pace myself!$

dialogue.label: Route22_Text_TriathleteFLandIntro
dialogue.text: I run from VIRIDIAN to the\nLEAGUE gate and back.\pRough terrain builds endurance!$

dialogue.label: Route22_Text_TriathleteFLandPostBattle
dialogue.text: Strong legs, steady breath,\nand a good partner POKéMON.\pThat's how you cross rough\nterrain.$

dialogue.label: Route22_Text_TriathleteFLandRematchIntro
dialogue.text: Another run, another rematch.\pLet's see whose pace holds on\nROUTE 22!$

dialogue.label: Route23_Text_WayneDefeat
dialogue.text: Your footing held.$

dialogue.label: Route23_Text_WayneIntro
dialogue.text: Every step north of here weighs\nmore than the last.\pShow me your legs can carry your\nBADGES.$

dialogue.label: Route23_Text_WaynePostBattle
dialogue.text: ROUTE 23 is not here to hurry you.\pIt gives you time to understand\nwhat you have earned.$

dialogue.label: Route23_Text_WayneRematchIntro
dialogue.text: Back on the final road?\pThen climb with purpose again.$

dialogue.label: Route23_Text_ChesterDefeat
dialogue.text: The silence won.$

dialogue.label: Route23_Text_ChesterIntro
dialogue.text: Birds go quiet near VICTORY ROAD.\pEven they know this place asks\nfor respect.$

dialogue.label: Route23_Text_ChesterPostBattle
dialogue.text: A loud trainer stands out here.\pA prepared trainer listens first.$

dialogue.label: Route23_Text_ChesterRematchIntro
dialogue.text: The air is still again.\pMy birds are ready to test your\nresolve.$

dialogue.label: Route23_Text_ErnestDefeat
dialogue.text: You meant it.$

dialogue.label: Route23_Text_ErnestIntro
dialogue.text: No showing off on this road.\pIf you battle on ROUTE 23, battle\nlike you mean it.$

dialogue.label: Route23_Text_ErnestPostBattle
dialogue.text: The LEAGUE gate changes people.\pEven rough trainers learn to keep\ntheir voice down here.$

dialogue.label: Route23_Text_ErnestRematchIntro
dialogue.text: You came back with the same steady\nlook.\pGood. Let's battle again.$

dialogue.label: Route23_Text_ZeekDefeat
dialogue.text: Focus held.$

dialogue.label: Route23_Text_ZeekIntro
dialogue.text: The road narrows your thoughts\nuntil only the next step matters.\pBattle me with that focus.$

dialogue.label: Route23_Text_ZeekPostBattle
dialogue.text: I used to think strength was all\nnoise.\pROUTE 23 taught me it can be\nquiet too.$

dialogue.label: Route23_Text_ZeekRematchIntro
dialogue.text: Same road. Same pressure.\pLet's see if your focus still\nholds.$

dialogue.label: Route23_Text_CoreyDefeat
dialogue.text: You belong.$

dialogue.label: Route23_Text_CoreyIntro
dialogue.text: People pass the guards and start\nwalking like champions already.\pThis road checks that attitude.$

dialogue.label: Route23_Text_CoreyPostBattle
dialogue.text: The BADGES open the path.\pThey don't carry you up it.\nThat's still on you.$

dialogue.label: Route23_Text_CoreyRematchIntro
dialogue.text: Still walking like you belong?\pGood. Prove it again.$

dialogue.label: Route23_Text_MalikDefeat
dialogue.text: Nothing left but respect.$

dialogue.label: Route23_Text_MalikIntro
dialogue.text: The last stretch before VICTORY\nROAD strips away excuses.\pLet's see what's left.$

dialogue.label: Route23_Text_MalikPostBattle
dialogue.text: If you can keep moving after every\nguard, every climb, every battle...\pthen VICTORY ROAD will know your\nname.$

dialogue.label: Route23_Text_MalikRematchIntro
dialogue.text: No excuses this time either.\pJust the road, your POKéMON,\nand mine.$

dialogue.label: Route23_Text_EvanZoeDefeat
dialogue.text: We'll take that lesson to the\nLEAGUE!$

dialogue.label: Route23_Text_EvanZoeIntro
dialogue.text: We are training for the LEAGUE.\nCan you handle both of us?$

dialogue.label: Route23_Text_EvanZoeNotEnoughMons
dialogue.text: Bring two ready POKéMON\nso we can battle as a pair!$

dialogue.label: Route23_Text_EvanZoePostBattle
dialogue.text: A good partner spots things\nyou might miss on your own.$

dialogue.label: Route23_Text_AceTrainerFNoraDefeat
dialogue.text: A lesson worth learning!$

dialogue.label: Route23_Text_AceTrainerFNoraIntro
dialogue.text: The LEAGUE is our goal.\nEvery battle brings us closer!$

dialogue.label: Route23_Text_AceTrainerFNoraPostBattle
dialogue.text: I keep track of every loss.\nThere is always more to learn.$

dialogue.label: Route23_Text_AceTrainerFVeraDefeat
dialogue.text: You found a way through!$

dialogue.label: Route23_Text_AceTrainerFVeraIntro
dialogue.text: A strong team needs variety.\nLet me show you what I mean!$

dialogue.label: Route23_Text_AceTrainerFVeraPostBattle
dialogue.text: Different strengths make\na team worth relying on.$

dialogue.label: Route23_Text_AceTrainerFLenaDefeat
dialogue.text: That was a proper challenge!$

dialogue.label: Route23_Text_AceTrainerFLenaIntro
dialogue.text: I train for tough opponents.\nYou look like a good test!$

dialogue.label: Route23_Text_AceTrainerFLenaPostBattle
dialogue.text: A challenge shows you where\nyour training needs more work.$

dialogue.label: Route23_Text_RivalConversation
dialogue.text:
{RIVAL}: All eight BADGES, huh?
Let me see those!\pEvery GYM taught us something.
Sometimes after a few losses!\pI used to just shout orders.
Now I pay attention to my team.\pRemember SLICK, my AIPOM?
We trained in FUCHSIA FOREST.\pOne level with DOUBLE HIT, and
SLICK became an APEX AMBIPOM!\pHOTSHOT got a METAL COAT from
the lab on CINNABAR ISLAND.\pOne trade later, my SCYTHER
came back as SCIZOR!\pBut you know I'm still aiming
for the top, {PLAYER}!\pLet's see what you and your
POKéMON learned. Here we go!$

dialogue.label: Route23_Text_RivalDefeat
dialogue.text: You've earned those BADGES!$

dialogue.label: Route23_Text_RivalPostBattle
dialogue.text:
{RIVAL}: You trusted your team
to pull that off. I could tell.\pWe've come a long way since
that first battle at the lab.\pGet through VICTORY ROAD.
I'll see you at the LEAGUE!$

dialogue.label: Route24_Text_CaleBridgeRematchIntro
dialogue.text: Back for another run across\nNUGGET BRIDGE?\pGood. I'll test your rhythm\nagain.$

dialogue.label: Route24_Text_CaleDefeat
dialogue.text: Clean catch!$

dialogue.label: Route24_Text_CaleIntro
dialogue.text: Welcome to NUGGET BRIDGE!\pFive TRAINERS stand between you\nand the prize at the end.\pI'll cast the first line.\nReady?$

dialogue.label: Route24_Text_CalePostBattle
dialogue.text: The bridge challenge starts calm,\nbut each step north adds pressure.\pKeep moving and don't let the\nwater distract you.$

dialogue.label: Route24_Text_NadiaDefeat
dialogue.text: Still nervous!$

dialogue.label: Route24_Text_NadiaIntro
dialogue.text: The bridge looks huge when you're\nsmall.\pThat's why I battle here. It makes\nme feel brave!$

dialogue.label: Route24_Text_NadiaPostBattle
dialogue.text: CERULEAN is right there, but this\nbridge feels like its own place.\pEverybody gets a little tougher\nby the far side.$

dialogue.label: Route24_Text_NadiaRematchIntro
dialogue.text: I crossed the bridge once already!\pNow I can battle you without\ngetting nervous.$

dialogue.label: Route24_Text_KindraDefeat
dialogue.text: Bridge checked!$

dialogue.label: Route24_Text_KindraIntro
dialogue.text: A good SCOUT checks every plank\nbefore crossing.\pA great SCOUT checks every\nTRAINER too!$

dialogue.label: Route24_Text_KindraPostBattle
dialogue.text: ROUTE 24 links CERULEAN to the\npaths beyond the cape.\pIt is short, but everyone remembers\ncrossing it.$

dialogue.label: Route24_Text_KindraRematchIntro
dialogue.text: I've checked the whole bridge\nagain.\pYou're still the most interesting\npart of it!$

dialogue.label: Route24_Text_BeckyDefeat
dialogue.text: You beat my bridge time!$

dialogue.label: Route24_Text_BeckyIntro
dialogue.text: I run bridge laps when the water\nis bright.\pA quick battle keeps my pace sharp!$

dialogue.label: Route24_Text_BeckyPostBattle
dialogue.text: The bridge is perfect training.\pFlat planks, sea air, and just\nenough room to sprint.$

dialogue.label: Route24_Text_BeckyRematchIntro
dialogue.text: Another lap, another battle.\pLet's see whose pace holds longer!$

dialogue.label: Route24_Text_NellDefeat
dialogue.text: That made a splash!$

dialogue.label: Route24_Text_NellIntro
