dialogue.text: I swim beneath the bridge and hear\nevery battle overhead.\pLet's see if yours sounds strong\nup close!$

dialogue.label: Route24_Text_NellPostBattle
dialogue.text: NUGGET BRIDGE belongs to the\nTRAINERS above and the water below.\pYou handled both sides well.$

dialogue.label: Route24_Text_NellRematchIntro
dialogue.text: The water carried your footsteps\nback to me.\pThat means rematch time!$

dialogue.label: Route25_Text_TessDefeat
dialogue.text: Healthy growth!$

dialogue.label: Route25_Text_TessIntro
dialogue.text: The cape has open air, soft grass,\nand plenty of passing TRAINERS.\pThat's excellent social training\nfor young POKéMON.$

dialogue.label: Route25_Text_TessPostBattle
dialogue.text: A busy route can be gentle too.\pROUTE 25 teaches POKéMON to stay\ncalm around strangers.$

dialogue.label: Route25_Text_TessRematchIntro
dialogue.text: My POKéMON know the cape path\nbetter now.\pLet's show you how they've grown!$

dialogue.label: Route25_Text_MiraDefeat
dialogue.text: Wide awake now!$

dialogue.label: Route25_Text_MiraIntro
dialogue.text: I bring my POKéMON here because\nthe bridge breeze keeps them alert.\pLet's see if yours are alert too!$

dialogue.label: Route25_Text_MiraPostBattle
dialogue.text: ROUTE 25 is good for confidence.\pEvery battle here feels like a\nstep toward the cape.$

dialogue.label: Route25_Text_MiraRematchIntro
dialogue.text: The breeze is back, and so are you.\pPerfect conditions for a rematch!$

dialogue.label: Route25_Text_FishermanTommyDefeat
dialogue.text: The current got me!$

dialogue.label: Route25_Text_FishermanTommyIntro
dialogue.text: A bridge over good water?\nThat's an invitation to cast!$

dialogue.label: Route25_Text_FishermanTommyPostBattle
dialogue.text: Fish gather where the shore changes\nshape.\pA sandy bank like this is worth\nchecking twice.$

dialogue.label: Route25_Text_FishermanTommyRematchIntro
dialogue.text: Back for another cast?\nLet's see what bites!$

dialogue.label: Route25_Text_FishermanTylorDefeat
dialogue.text: The tide favoured you!$

dialogue.label: Route25_Text_FishermanTylorIntro
dialogue.text: The sea breeze reaches all the way\nup here now.$

dialogue.label: Route25_Text_FishermanTylorPostBattle
dialogue.text: This bridge turned my quiet spot\ninto a proper route.\pCan't complain when the bites are\nthis good.$

dialogue.label: Route25_Text_FishermanTylorRematchIntro
dialogue.text: The tide's turned.\nThis one's mine!$

dialogue.label: Route25_Text_TriathleteMLandDefeat
dialogue.text: You won that interval!$

dialogue.label: Route25_Text_TriathleteMLandIntro
dialogue.text: This bridge is perfect for interval\ntraining! Keep up!$

dialogue.label: Route25_Text_TriathleteMLandPostBattle
dialogue.text: The best part of a long run is\nfeeling the wind over the water.$

dialogue.label: Route25_Text_TriathleteMLandRematchIntro
dialogue.text: Back on the long bridge?\pGood. I've been timing my laps\nfor this rematch!$

dialogue.label: Route25_Text_TriathleteFLandDefeat
dialogue.text: You found another gear!$

dialogue.label: Route25_Text_TriathleteFLandIntro
dialogue.text: No slowing down on the bridge!\nBattle at full stride!$

dialogue.label: Route25_Text_TriathleteFLandPostBattle
dialogue.text: A straight path, sea air, and a\ngood battle. That's training.$

dialogue.label: Route25_Text_TriathleteFLandRematchIntro
dialogue.text: You made it back across the span!\pLet's see if you still have speed\nleft for me.$

dialogue.label: Route25_Text_DaliaDefeat
dialogue.text: Scattered petals!$

dialogue.label: Route25_Text_DaliaIntro
dialogue.text: The flowers here lean toward the\nsea breeze.\pEven plants seem curious about\nwhere this route leads.$

dialogue.label: Route25_Text_DaliaPostBattle
dialogue.text: A cape garden grows differently.\pSalt air, bright water, and steady\nfootsteps all leave a mark.$

dialogue.label: Route25_Text_DaliaRematchIntro
dialogue.text: The flowers are leaning again.\pThey must have noticed you coming\nback for a rematch.$

dialogue.label: Route25_Text_JoanaDefeat
dialogue.text: Lovely and strong!$

dialogue.label: Route25_Text_JoanaIntro
dialogue.text: I came for the flowers, but stayed\nfor the view.\pA battle with the cape behind us\nsounds lovely!$

dialogue.label: Route25_Text_JoanaPostBattle
dialogue.text: From here you can feel CERULEAN\nbehind you and the open routes\nahead.$

dialogue.label: Route25_Text_JoanaRematchIntro
dialogue.text: The view is lovely again.\pLet's make the battle just as\nmemorable.$

dialogue.label: Route25_Text_FlintBridgeRematchIntro
dialogue.text: The current shifted again.\pLet's see if your battle rhythm\nshifted too!$

dialogue.label: Route25_Text_FlintDefeat
dialogue.text: That cast went wide!$

dialogue.label: Route25_Text_FlintIntro
dialogue.text: The cape water changes depth fast.\pA FISHERMAN learns to read those\nshifts before casting.$

dialogue.label: Route25_Text_FlintPostBattle
dialogue.text: ROUTE 25 looks peaceful, but the\nwater keeps changing under it.\pThat's why the fishing stays good.$

dialogue.label: Route25_Text_DanaDefeat
dialogue.text: You saw through it!$

dialogue.label: Route25_Text_DanaIntro
dialogue.text: The posts under this bridge give\nfish places to hide.\pA smart FISHERMAN checks every\nshadow.$

dialogue.label: Route25_Text_DanaPostBattle
dialogue.text: People look across bridges.\nFISHERMEN look underneath them.$

dialogue.label: Route25_Text_DanaRematchIntro
dialogue.text: Same bridge, new shadows.\pLet's see what kind of battle\nhides here today.$

dialogue.label: Route25_Text_JustinDefeat
dialogue.text: You read the path!$

dialogue.label: Route25_Text_JustinIntro
dialogue.text: A SCOUT should know when a short\npath becomes a long journey.\pThis bridge did that to ROUTE 25.$

dialogue.label: Route25_Text_JustinPostBattle
dialogue.text: ROUTE 25 used to feel like an end.\pNow it feels like a crossing.$

dialogue.label: Route25_Text_JustinRematchIntro
dialogue.text: Still checking the long route?\pGood. A SCOUT respects a path\nthat changed.$

dialogue.label: Route25_Text_GwenDefeat
dialogue.text: Well rested!$

dialogue.label: Route25_Text_GwenIntro
dialogue.text: I mark rest spots for TRAINERS\ncrossing from CERULEAN to ROUTE 10.\pThis one is also good for battles!$

dialogue.label: Route25_Text_GwenPostBattle
dialogue.text: Long connections need quiet places\nwhere TRAINERS can reset their\npace.$

dialogue.label: Route25_Text_GwenRematchIntro
dialogue.text: You found my rest spot again.\pThat means you're ready for\nanother battle.$

dialogue.label: Route25_Text_ValerieDefeat
dialogue.text: No surprise there!$

dialogue.label: Route25_Text_ValerieIntro
dialogue.text: The cape path twists just enough\nto hide what comes next.\pA SCOUT learns to enjoy that.$

dialogue.label: Route25_Text_ValeriePostBattle
dialogue.text: A route with turns invites you to\nslow down and look closely.$

dialogue.label: Route25_Text_ValerieRematchIntro
dialogue.text: You came back around the twist.\pLet's see what changed since your\nlast pass.$

dialogue.label: Route25_Text_RileyDefeat
dialogue.text: You didn't miss a step!$

dialogue.label: Route25_Text_RileyIntro
dialogue.text: I patrol the grass near the bridge\nbecause people rush through it.\pRush past me and you'll miss the\nbattle!$

dialogue.label: Route25_Text_RileyPostBattle
dialogue.text: Fast routes still have details.\pA hidden item, a patch of grass,\na TRAINER waiting sideways.$

dialogue.label: Route25_Text_RileyRematchIntro
dialogue.text: You didn't rush past this time.\pGood. Let's make the rematch\ncount.$

dialogue.label: Route25_Text_BlakeDefeat
dialogue.text: Freshly beaten!$

dialogue.label: Route25_Text_BlakeIntro
dialogue.text: The breeze carries flower scents\nfarther over water.\pThat's why ROUTE 25 feels so fresh.$

dialogue.label: Route25_Text_BlakePostBattle
dialogue.text: Flowers near the shore grow hardy.\pThey bend often, but they don't\nbreak easily.$

dialogue.label: Route25_Text_BlakeRematchIntro
dialogue.text: The air is fresh again.\pLet's see if your battling feels\nfresh too.$

dialogue.label: Route25_Text_BethanyDefeat
dialogue.text: Clear as a bell!$

dialogue.label: Route25_Text_BethanyIntro
dialogue.text: This far from town, POKéMON learn\nto listen to their TRAINER.\pToo much wind and water otherwise!$

dialogue.label: Route25_Text_BethanyPostBattle
dialogue.text: Good raising is a conversation.\pROUTE 25 gives POKéMON plenty\nto respond to.$

dialogue.label: Route25_Text_BethanyRematchIntro
dialogue.text: My POKéMON have been listening\nbetter every day.\pLet me hear how yours answer!$

dialogue.label: Route25_Text_TriathleteReedDefeat
dialogue.text: You ran rings around us!$

dialogue.label: Route25_Text_TriathleteReedIntro
dialogue.text: A long bridge makes a great track!\nCare for a training break?$

dialogue.label: Route25_Text_TriathleteReedPostBattle
dialogue.text: We pace ourselves on the long run.\nThere is room to pass beside us!$

dialogue.label: Route25_Text_TriathleteReedRematchIntro
dialogue.text: Another lap, another battle!$

dialogue.label: Route25_Text_TriathleteLilaDefeat
dialogue.text: Time to catch our breath!$

dialogue.label: Route25_Text_TriathleteLilaIntro
dialogue.text: Sea air, steady feet, strong team!\nLet us show you our pace!$

dialogue.label: Route25_Text_TriathleteLilaPostBattle
dialogue.text: My POKéMON set the pace.\nI just try to keep up!$

dialogue.label: Route25_Text_TriathleteLilaRematchIntro
dialogue.text: Ready for another training break?$

dialogue.label: Route3_Text_GregDefeat
dialogue.text: You found your footing!$

dialogue.label: Route3_Text_GregIntro
dialogue.text: The trail gets rockier from here.\nStep carefully!$

dialogue.label: Route3_Text_GregPostBattle
dialogue.text: MT. MOON is rougher than this.\nBring sturdy POKéMON.$

dialogue.label: Route3_Text_GregRematchIntro
dialogue.text: Back on the rocky trail?\pGood. Let's see if your footing\nhas gotten even stronger!$

dialogue.label: EventScript_RouteTrainer_YOUNGSTER_JOSH_Text_Defeat
dialogue.text: I slipped up!$

dialogue.label: EventScript_RouteTrainer_YOUNGSTER_JOSH_Text_Intro
dialogue.text: MT. MOON is ahead, so I'm training\non every rocky patch I can find!\pBattle me!$

dialogue.label: EventScript_RouteTrainer_YOUNGSTER_JOSH_Text_PostBattle
dialogue.text: The closer you get to MT. MOON,\nthe tougher the road feels.$

dialogue.label: EventScript_RouteTrainer_YOUNGSTER_JOSH_Text_RematchIntro
dialogue.text: I trained on the rocks again!\pThis time, I won't lose my footing!$

dialogue.label: EventScript_RouteTrainer_LASS_ROBIN_Text_Defeat
dialogue.text: You didn't stumble at all!$

dialogue.label: EventScript_RouteTrainer_LASS_ROBIN_Text_Intro
dialogue.text: The road to MT. MOON makes\neveryone hurry.\pSlow down and battle me first!$

dialogue.label: EventScript_RouteTrainer_LASS_ROBIN_Text_PostBattle
dialogue.text: The mountain looks close from here,\nbut ROUTE 3 still tests your pace.$

dialogue.label: EventScript_RouteTrainer_LASS_ROBIN_Text_RematchIntro
dialogue.text: Still rushing toward MT. MOON?\pThen I'll stop you for one more\nbattle!$

dialogue.label: Route3_Text_YoungsterMiaDefeat
dialogue.text: I need more practice!$

dialogue.label: Route3_Text_YoungsterMiaIntro
dialogue.text: Josh and I came out to train!\nWant to battle me too?$

dialogue.label: Route3_Text_YoungsterMiaPostBattle
dialogue.text: We take turns picking\nwhere to explore next.$

dialogue.label: Route3_Text_YoungsterMiaRematchIntro
dialogue.text: Josh says I've improved my\ntiming. Help me prove it!$

dialogue.label: EventScript_RouteTrainer_YOUNGSTER_TIMMY_Text_Defeat
dialogue.text: I still stumbled!$

dialogue.label: EventScript_RouteTrainer_YOUNGSTER_TIMMY_Text_Intro
dialogue.text: I tripped on a GEODUDE earlier,\nbut I'm not going home!\pROUTE 4 made me tougher!$

dialogue.label: EventScript_RouteTrainer_YOUNGSTER_TIMMY_Text_PostBattle
dialogue.text: The rocks here are rough, but they\nmake you pay attention.$

dialogue.label: EventScript_RouteTrainer_YOUNGSTER_TIMMY_Text_RematchIntro
dialogue.text: I watched my step this time!\pNow watch out for my POKéMON!$

dialogue.label: EventScript_RouteTrainer_LASS_CRISSY_Text_Defeat
dialogue.text: After all that searching!$

dialogue.label: EventScript_RouteTrainer_LASS_CRISSY_Text_Intro
dialogue.text: I came to MT. MOON looking for\nmushroom POKéMON.\pThey like damp corners, but I like\nbattles too!$

dialogue.label: EventScript_RouteTrainer_LASS_CRISSY_Text_PostBattle
dialogue.text: Mushroom POKéMON hide well.\pThe trick is watching where the\nmountain stays cool and damp.$

dialogue.label: EventScript_RouteTrainer_LASS_CRISSY_Text_RematchIntro
dialogue.text: I checked the mountain again.\pNo mushrooms this time, so you're\nmy best find!$

dialogue.label: EventScript_RouteTrainer_CAMPER_RICKY_Text_Defeat
dialogue.text: That belongs in my field notes!$

dialogue.label: EventScript_RouteTrainer_CAMPER_RICKY_Text_Intro
dialogue.text: I came out of MT. MOON covered\nin dust and questions.\pLet's see what your team uncovered!$

dialogue.label: EventScript_RouteTrainer_CAMPER_RICKY_Text_PostBattle
dialogue.text: Fossils, stones, old tunnels...\nROUTE 4 is where the mountain's\lstories spill into daylight.$

dialogue.label: EventScript_RouteTrainer_CAMPER_RICKY_Text_RematchIntro
dialogue.text: Back from the mountain again?\pGood. Every pass through MT. MOON\nreveals something new!$

dialogue.label: EventScript_RouteTrainer_PICNICKER_CAITLIN_Text_Defeat
dialogue.text: You made the exit look easy!$

dialogue.label: EventScript_RouteTrainer_PICNICKER_CAITLIN_Text_Intro
dialogue.text: The road opens up after MT. MOON,\nbut don't relax too soon.\pA good SCOUT checks the exit too!$

dialogue.label: EventScript_RouteTrainer_PICNICKER_CAITLIN_Text_PostBattle
dialogue.text: After a cave, open sky feels huge.\pThat's when tired TRAINERS make\nmistakes.$

dialogue.label: EventScript_RouteTrainer_PICNICKER_CAITLIN_Text_RematchIntro
dialogue.text: Coming from CERULEAN or MT. MOON?\pEither way, I'll check how ready\nyou are!$

dialogue.label: Route4_Text_YoungsterEllaDefeat
dialogue.text: You caught me off guard!$

dialogue.label: Route4_Text_YoungsterEllaIntro
dialogue.text: Timmy spotted you first,\nbut I want a battle too!$

dialogue.label: Route4_Text_YoungsterEllaPostBattle
dialogue.text: My POKéMON and I are getting\nbraver with every battle.$

dialogue.label: Route4_Text_YoungsterEllaRematchIntro
dialogue.text: My team is braver on this rocky\nroad now. Let's try again!$

dialogue.label: EventScript_RouteTrainer_BUG_CATCHER_VANCE_Text_Defeat
dialogue.text: They got startled after all!$

dialogue.label: EventScript_RouteTrainer_BUG_CATCHER_VANCE_Text_Intro
dialogue.text: The grass here is close to the\ncity, but bugs still love it.\pI'll prove they belong here!$

dialogue.label: EventScript_RouteTrainer_BUG_CATCHER_VANCE_Text_PostBattle
dialogue.text: Even near SAFFRON, wild POKéMON\nfind little places to live.$

dialogue.label: EventScript_RouteTrainer_BUG_CATCHER_VANCE_Text_RematchIntro
dialogue.text: My bugs got used to the city\nnoise.\pNow they're ready for you!$

dialogue.label: EventScript_RouteTrainer_PKMN_RANGER_KATELYN_Text_Defeat
dialogue.text: Careful and strong. Good.$

dialogue.label: EventScript_RouteTrainer_PKMN_RANGER_KATELYN_Text_Intro
dialogue.text: I watch ROUTE 5 because city\ntravelers and wild POKéMON share\lthe same narrow path.\pShow me you can pass through\nwith care!$

dialogue.label: EventScript_RouteTrainer_PKMN_RANGER_KATELYN_Text_PostBattle
dialogue.text: The DAY CARE, the tunnel, the\ncity gate...\pBusy places need gentle footsteps.$

dialogue.label: EventScript_RouteTrainer_PKMN_RANGER_KATELYN_Text_RematchIntro
dialogue.text: You returned without trampling\nthe grass.\pGood. Now let's see your battle\ndiscipline!$

dialogue.label: EventScript_RouteTrainer_PICNICKER_HEIDI_Text_Defeat
dialogue.text: You picked the winning path!$

dialogue.label: EventScript_RouteTrainer_PICNICKER_HEIDI_Text_Intro
dialogue.text: I like this road because it gives\nyou choices.\pCERULEAN, SAFFRON, or the tunnel-\nwhich way are you heading?$

dialogue.label: EventScript_RouteTrainer_PICNICKER_HEIDI_Text_PostBattle
dialogue.text: A good route is more than a line.\nIt's a set of choices.$

dialogue.label: EventScript_RouteTrainer_PICNICKER_HEIDI_Text_RematchIntro
dialogue.text: You chose to come back here?\pThen I choose another battle!$

dialogue.label: EventScript_RouteTrainer_AROMA_LADY_VIOLET_Text_Defeat
dialogue.text: Your team bloomed beautifully!$

dialogue.label: EventScript_RouteTrainer_AROMA_LADY_VIOLET_Text_Intro
dialogue.text: The flowers here soften the road\nbetween CERULEAN and SAFFRON.\pA fragrant battle, perhaps?$

dialogue.label: EventScript_RouteTrainer_AROMA_LADY_VIOLET_Text_PostBattle
dialogue.text: ROUTE 5's little flowers survive\nbecause people leave them be.$

dialogue.label: EventScript_RouteTrainer_AROMA_LADY_VIOLET_Text_RematchIntro
dialogue.text: The scent has changed since our\nlast battle.\pSo have we, I hope.$

dialogue.label: EventScript_ForestTrainer_BUG_CATCHER_FINN_Text_Defeat
dialogue.text: They grew faster than me!$

dialogue.label: EventScript_ForestTrainer_BUG_CATCHER_FINN_Text_Intro
dialogue.text: BUG POKéMON gather near the\nDAY CARE's quiet grass.\pI came to watch them grow!$

dialogue.label: EventScript_ForestTrainer_BUG_CATCHER_FINN_Text_PostBattle
dialogue.text: Small POKéMON teach patience.\pYou notice more when you stop\nrushing between cities.$

dialogue.label: EventScript_ForestTrainer_BUG_CATCHER_FINN_Text_RematchIntro
dialogue.text: The bugs around the DAY CARE\nseem livelier today.\pLet's see if I am too!$

dialogue.label: EventScript_ForestTrainer_CAMPER_OSCAR_Text_Defeat
dialogue.text: You stayed sharper than me!$

dialogue.label: EventScript_ForestTrainer_CAMPER_OSCAR_Text_Intro
dialogue.text: I camp here because ROUTE 5 is\nquiet for a road near SAFFRON.\pA calm route makes a sharp team!$

dialogue.label: EventScript_ForestTrainer_CAMPER_OSCAR_Text_PostBattle
dialogue.text: Between CERULEAN and SAFFRON,\nthis place gives TRAINERS room\lto breathe.$

dialogue.label: EventScript_ForestTrainer_CAMPER_OSCAR_Text_RematchIntro
dialogue.text: Back from the city roads?\pGood. Let's see if ROUTE 5's\nquiet helped your focus!$

dialogue.label: EventScript_ForestTrainer_PICNICKER_MAE_Text_Defeat
dialogue.text: My lunch break lost momentum!$

dialogue.label: EventScript_ForestTrainer_PICNICKER_MAE_Text_Intro
dialogue.text: I brought lunch for the walk to\nthe UNDERGROUND PATH.\pWant a battle before I head down?$

dialogue.label: EventScript_ForestTrainer_PICNICKER_MAE_Text_PostBattle
dialogue.text: The UNDERGROUND PATH makes KANTO\nfeel smaller.\pYou pop up somewhere new before\nyou know it.$

dialogue.label: EventScript_ForestTrainer_PICNICKER_MAE_Text_RematchIntro
dialogue.text: I packed extra this time.\pA tunnel trip and a rematch both\nneed supplies!$

dialogue.label: EventScript_ForestTrainer_PKMN_BREEDER_NIA_Text_Defeat
dialogue.text: That's healthy growth!$

dialogue.label: EventScript_ForestTrainer_PKMN_BREEDER_NIA_Text_Intro
dialogue.text: The DAY CARE teaches you that\nPOKéMON grow in their own time.\pLet's see how your team has grown!$

dialogue.label: EventScript_ForestTrainer_PKMN_BREEDER_NIA_Text_PostBattle
dialogue.text: Some POKéMON need training.\nSome need time.\pGood TRAINERS learn both.$

dialogue.label: EventScript_ForestTrainer_PKMN_BREEDER_NIA_Text_RematchIntro
dialogue.text: I checked on the DAY CARE again.\pNow I want to check on your\nteam's growth too!$

dialogue.label: EventScript_ForestTrainer_BUG_MANIAC_HOLLIS_Text_Defeat
dialogue.text: My theory needs work!$

dialogue.label: EventScript_ForestTrainer_BUG_MANIAC_HOLLIS_Text_Intro
dialogue.text: Everyone talks about the DAY CARE,\nbut I watch the bugs nearby.\pBreeding, molting, changing-\nit's all connected!$

dialogue.label: EventScript_ForestTrainer_BUG_MANIAC_HOLLIS_Text_PostBattle
dialogue.text: Eggs, cocoons, evolution...\pROUTE 5 is a quiet place for\nbig changes.$

dialogue.label: EventScript_ForestTrainer_BUG_MANIAC_HOLLIS_Text_RematchIntro
dialogue.text: I found another pattern in the\ngrass by the DAY CARE.\pA rematch should test it!$

dialogue.label: EventScript_ForestTrainer_BUG_MANIAC_JACKSON_Text_Defeat
dialogue.text: I misread the vibrations!$

dialogue.label: EventScript_ForestTrainer_BUG_MANIAC_JACKSON_Text_Intro
dialogue.text: The UNDERGROUND PATH shakes the\nsoil more than people think.\pBUG POKéMON feel those tiny\nvibrations!$

dialogue.label: EventScript_ForestTrainer_BUG_MANIAC_JACKSON_Text_PostBattle
dialogue.text: Routes aren't only what you see.\pSometimes the important movement\nis under your feet.$

dialogue.label: EventScript_ForestTrainer_BUG_MANIAC_JACKSON_Text_RematchIntro
dialogue.text: I felt footsteps below the route.\pWas that you coming back for a\nrematch?$

dialogue.label: EventScript_GymAdjacent_PSYCHIC_PRESTON_Text_Defeat
dialogue.text: My focus scattered!$

dialogue.label: EventScript_GymAdjacent_PSYCHIC_PRESTON_Text_Intro
dialogue.text: Close to SAFFRON,\nyou can feel thoughts\ngetting louder.$

dialogue.label: EventScript_GymAdjacent_PSYCHIC_PRESTON_Text_PostBattle
dialogue.text: SAFFRON's PSYCHICS\ntrain the mind before\nthe POKEMON.$

dialogue.label: EventScript_GymAdjacent_PSYCHIC_PRESTON_Text_RematchIntro
dialogue.text: Let's quiet the noise\nwith another battle.$

dialogue.label: EventScript_RouteTrainer_TUBER_DAN_Text_Defeat
dialogue.text: Splashdown!$

dialogue.label: EventScript_RouteTrainer_TUBER_DAN_Text_Intro
dialogue.text: I can see VERMILION from here,\nbut I don't want to wait for\lthe beach.\pLet's battle right here!$

dialogue.label: EventScript_RouteTrainer_TUBER_DAN_Text_PostBattle
dialogue.text: This route is like a countdown.\pEvery step south gets you closer\nto VERMILION's water.$

dialogue.label: EventScript_RouteTrainer_TUBER_DAN_Text_RematchIntro
dialogue.text: Still between SAFFRON and the\nharbour?\pGood! I need another practice\nbattle before swimming.$

dialogue.label: EventScript_RouteTrainer_TUBER_IRIS_Text_Defeat
dialogue.text: I got sand in my strategy!$

dialogue.label: EventScript_RouteTrainer_TUBER_IRIS_Text_Intro
dialogue.text: I was going to VERMILION for\nthe beach, but this sand is\lgood enough for a warm-up!$

dialogue.label: EventScript_RouteTrainer_TUBER_IRIS_Text_PostBattle
dialogue.text: ROUTE 6 smells like the sea when\nthe wind comes from VERMILION.\pThat's how I know I'm close!$

dialogue.label: EventScript_RouteTrainer_TUBER_IRIS_Text_RematchIntro
dialogue.text: You came back before I reached\nthe beach?\pThen we'll warm up again!$

dialogue.label: EventScript_RouteTrainer_FISHERMAN_CAROL_Text_Defeat
dialogue.text: You didn't take the bait!$

dialogue.label: EventScript_RouteTrainer_FISHERMAN_CAROL_Text_Intro
dialogue.text: People hurry to the UNDERGROUND\nPATH and forget to watch the\lwater beside them.\pThat's where the good bites are!$

dialogue.label: EventScript_RouteTrainer_FISHERMAN_CAROL_Text_PostBattle
dialogue.text: A quiet shore beside a busy road\nis perfect for fishing.\pThe footsteps keep the fish\ncurious.$

dialogue.label: EventScript_RouteTrainer_FISHERMAN_CAROL_Text_RematchIntro
dialogue.text: The water's different today.\pMaybe the battle will be too!$

dialogue.label: EventScript_WatersEdge_SAILOR_TYRON_Text_Defeat
dialogue.text: You caught the wind first!$

dialogue.label: EventScript_WatersEdge_SAILOR_TYRON_Text_Intro
dialogue.text: VERMILION's harbour wind reaches\nall the way up this road.\pA SAILOR can feel a battle in\nthe breeze!$

dialogue.label: EventScript_WatersEdge_SAILOR_TYRON_Text_PostBattle
dialogue.text: Land routes have currents too.\pWatch how TRAINERS flow between\nthe city and the sea.$

dialogue.label: EventScript_WatersEdge_SAILOR_TYRON_Text_RematchIntro
dialogue.text: Back from SAFFRON or VERMILION?\pEither way, ROUTE 6 owes us\nanother battle!$

dialogue.label: EventScript_GymAdjacent_PSYCHIC_LUCIAN_Text_Defeat
dialogue.text: That future slipped\naway.$

dialogue.label: EventScript_GymAdjacent_PSYCHIC_LUCIAN_Text_Intro
dialogue.text: The path to SAFFRON\nsharpens every sense.$

dialogue.label: EventScript_GymAdjacent_PSYCHIC_LUCIAN_Text_PostBattle
dialogue.text: Power like this belongs\naround SAFFRON. The city\nhums with it.$

dialogue.label: EventScript_GymAdjacent_PSYCHIC_LUCIAN_Text_RematchIntro
dialogue.text: I foresaw another\nbattle here.$

dialogue.label: EventScript_RouteTrainer_YOUNGSTER_CHAD_Text_Defeat
dialogue.text: Whoa, that's city-level strong!$

dialogue.label: EventScript_RouteTrainer_YOUNGSTER_CHAD_Text_Intro
dialogue.text: I train here because CELADON's\nright there and SAFFRON's right\lthere too!\pTwo cities means twice the battles!$

dialogue.label: EventScript_RouteTrainer_YOUNGSTER_CHAD_Text_PostBattle
dialogue.text: I want to battle TRAINERS from\nboth cities.\pThat way I'll get strong twice\nas fast!$

dialogue.label: EventScript_RouteTrainer_YOUNGSTER_CHAD_Text_RematchIntro
dialogue.text: You came back from one city or\nthe other, right?\pThen show me what you learned!$

dialogue.label: EventScript_GymAdjacent_PSYCHIC_CAMERON_Text_Defeat
dialogue.text: Your focus held firm.$

dialogue.label: EventScript_GymAdjacent_PSYCHIC_CAMERON_Text_Intro
dialogue.text: SAFFRON's thoughts press outward,\neven here on ROUTE 7.\pCan you keep your focus at the\ncity's edge?$

dialogue.label: EventScript_GymAdjacent_PSYCHIC_CAMERON_Text_PostBattle
dialogue.text: Between CELADON's calm and\nSAFFRON's noise, ROUTE 7 is a\lthin place for concentration.$

dialogue.label: EventScript_GymAdjacent_PSYCHIC_CAMERON_Text_RematchIntro
dialogue.text: I felt you return before I saw\nyou.\pLet's test that pressure again.$

dialogue.label: Route7_EventScript_TrendsetterClaire_Defeat
dialogue.text: You gave me a bright idea!$

dialogue.label: Route7_EventScript_TrendsetterClaire_Intro
dialogue.text: A new look, a new team!\nCare for a quick battle?$

dialogue.label: Route7_EventScript_TrendsetterClaire_Post
dialogue.text: Shopping can wait.\nThat battle gave me an idea!$

dialogue.label: Route7_EventScript_TrendsetterElio_Defeat
dialogue.text: You set today's trend!$

dialogue.label: Route7_EventScript_TrendsetterElio_Intro
dialogue.text: Celadon sets the trends.\nMy team sets the pace!$

dialogue.label: Route7_EventScript_TrendsetterElio_Post
dialogue.text: Great style means finding\nwhat works for you.$

dialogue.label: Route7_Text_YoungsterRubyDefeat
dialogue.text: We still have lots to learn!$

dialogue.label: Route7_Text_YoungsterRubyIntro
dialogue.text: Chad and I train outside town.\nLet me show you our progress!$

dialogue.label: Route7_Text_YoungsterRubyPostBattle
dialogue.text: There are strong trainers here!\nI want to keep up with them.$

dialogue.label: Route7_Text_YoungsterRubyRematchIntro
dialogue.text: Chad and I tried a new training\nplan. Want to see my results?$

dialogue.label: EventScript_RouteTrainer_AROMA_LADY_NIKKI_Text_Defeat
dialogue.text: What a vivid bloom!$

dialogue.label: EventScript_RouteTrainer_AROMA_LADY_NIKKI_Text_Intro
dialogue.text: The flowers thin out as you get\ncloser to LAVENDER.\pThat makes each scent feel more\nprecious, don't you think?$

dialogue.label: EventScript_RouteTrainer_AROMA_LADY_NIKKI_Text_PostBattle
dialogue.text: Near LAVENDER, even flowers seem\nto grow more gently.\pIt suits this road.$

dialogue.label: EventScript_RouteTrainer_AROMA_LADY_NIKKI_Text_RematchIntro
dialogue.text: You returned along the quiet road.\pGood. Let's see what has bloomed\nin your team.$

dialogue.label: EventScript_RouteTrainer_PKMN_BREEDER_ALIZE_Text_Defeat
dialogue.text: Your team stayed calmer!$

dialogue.label: EventScript_RouteTrainer_PKMN_BREEDER_ALIZE_Text_Intro
dialogue.text: POKéMON raised near busy roads\nlearn to stay calm.\pMine trained beside SAFFRON's\ntraffic!$

dialogue.label: EventScript_RouteTrainer_PKMN_BREEDER_ALIZE_Text_PostBattle
dialogue.text: A good BREEDER watches where a\nPOKéMON grows up.\pRoad sounds can shape temperament.$

dialogue.label: EventScript_RouteTrainer_PKMN_BREEDER_ALIZE_Text_RematchIntro
dialogue.text: My POKéMON have heard every step\non this road.\pThey know yours too. Rematch?$

dialogue.label: EventScript_RouteTrainer_CAMPER_DREW_Text_Defeat
dialogue.text: You had plenty left!$

dialogue.label: EventScript_RouteTrainer_CAMPER_DREW_Text_Intro
dialogue.text: I watch the UNDERGROUND PATH\nentrance for tired travelers.\pIf you still have energy, prove it!$

dialogue.label: EventScript_RouteTrainer_CAMPER_DREW_Text_PostBattle
dialogue.text: The tunnel saves time, but ROUTE 8\nteaches patience.\pYou need both around SAFFRON.$

dialogue.label: EventScript_RouteTrainer_CAMPER_DREW_Text_RematchIntro
dialogue.text: You came back through the tunnel\ntraffic?\pThen you must be ready!$

dialogue.label: EventScript_RouteTrainer_LASS_ALI_Text_Defeat
dialogue.text: Your bond shines brightly.$

dialogue.label: EventScript_RouteTrainer_LASS_ALI_Text_Intro
dialogue.text: I am returning to LAVENDER to\npray for departed POKéMON.\pA quiet battle helps me prepare\nmy mind for the journey.$

dialogue.label: EventScript_RouteTrainer_LASS_ALI_Text_PostBattle
dialogue.text: LAVENDER lies east of here.\pWe remember departed POKéMON\nby caring for those beside us.$

dialogue.label: EventScript_RouteTrainer_LASS_ALI_Text_RematchIntro
dialogue.text: The road to LAVENDER gives me\ntime to reflect.\pShall we share another battle?$

dialogue.label: EventScript_RouteTrainer_PICNICKER_MARTHA_Text_Defeat
dialogue.text: I blinked first!$

dialogue.label: EventScript_RouteTrainer_PICNICKER_MARTHA_Text_Intro
dialogue.text: The road gets quiet before\nLAVENDER.\pThat's when a SCOUT should pay\nthe most attention.$

dialogue.label: EventScript_RouteTrainer_PICNICKER_MARTHA_Text_PostBattle
dialogue.text: When a place feels still, people\ndrop their guard.\pROUTE 8 taught me not to.$

dialogue.label: EventScript_RouteTrainer_PICNICKER_MARTHA_Text_RematchIntro
dialogue.text: You came back from LAVENDER?\pThen you know why I keep watch\nout here.$

dialogue.label: EventScript_RouteTrainer_CAMPER_BRYCE_Text_Defeat
dialogue.text: You kept steady!$

dialogue.label: EventScript_RouteTrainer_CAMPER_BRYCE_Text_Intro
dialogue.text: I set camp halfway between the\ncity noise and LAVENDER's quiet.\pIt's the perfect place to test\nyour nerve.$

dialogue.label: EventScript_RouteTrainer_CAMPER_BRYCE_Text_PostBattle
dialogue.text: Some roads are loud. Some roads\nare lonely.\pROUTE 8 manages to be both.$

dialogue.label: EventScript_RouteTrainer_CAMPER_BRYCE_Text_RematchIntro
dialogue.text: Back on the long road?\pThen let's see if your nerve\nheld up.$

dialogue.label: EventScript_RouteTrainer_PICNICKER_CELIA_Text_Defeat
dialogue.text: You read the route better!$

dialogue.label: EventScript_RouteTrainer_PICNICKER_CELIA_Text_Intro
dialogue.text: I mark the paths people miss when\nthey rush to the UNDERGROUND PATH.\pYou noticed me, so battle me!$

dialogue.label: EventScript_RouteTrainer_PICNICKER_CELIA_Text_PostBattle
dialogue.text: Shortcuts are useful, but looking\naround is how you find hidden\nplaces.$

dialogue.label: EventScript_RouteTrainer_PICNICKER_CELIA_Text_RematchIntro
dialogue.text: You found this side path again.\pA good SCOUT respects a sharp\nmemory!$

dialogue.label: EventScript_GymAdjacent_PSYCHIC_JOHAN_Text_Defeat
dialogue.text: You cut through the noise!$

dialogue.label: EventScript_GymAdjacent_PSYCHIC_JOHAN_Text_Intro
dialogue.text: The noise from SAFFRON makes it\nhard to hear a single thought.\pCan you focus on one command?$

dialogue.label: EventScript_GymAdjacent_PSYCHIC_JOHAN_Text_PostBattle
dialogue.text: I close my eyes and picture this\nroad. The footsteps tell me\pwhich way people are heading.$

dialogue.label: EventScript_GymAdjacent_PSYCHIC_JOHAN_Text_RematchIntro
dialogue.text: I recognised your steps this\ntime. Let's see if I can predict\pyour moves!$

dialogue.label: Route9_Text_AlanDefeat
dialogue.text: Hahahaha!\pYou beat me fair!$

dialogue.label: Route9_Text_AlanIntro
dialogue.text: Hahahaha!\pThis ridge wakes up the legs and\nthe lungs. Bring it on!$

dialogue.label: Route9_Text_AlanPostBattle
dialogue.text: Hahahaha!\pUs hearty hikers laugh so the\nmountains know we're coming.$

dialogue.label: Route9_Text_AlanRematchIntro
dialogue.text: Hahahaha!\nI'll win this time!$

dialogue.label: Route9_Text_BrentDefeat
dialogue.text: I lost my stance!$

dialogue.label: Route9_Text_BrentIntro
dialogue.text: The climb to ROCK TUNNEL is my\ntraining ground!\pKeep your stance low and steady!$

dialogue.label: Route9_Text_BrentPostBattle
dialogue.text: A strong stance keeps you steady\non uneven ground.\pThe mountain path punishes sloppy\nsteps.$

dialogue.label: Route9_Text_BrentRematchIntro
dialogue.text: I've practised my stance on\nloose stone. Try to knock me off\pbalance now!$

dialogue.label: Route9_Text_ConnerDefeat
dialogue.text: You hit harder!$

dialogue.label: Route9_Text_ConnerIntro
dialogue.text: This mountain path makes every\nbattle hit harder!\pLoose stones, tight turns-\nperfect balance training!$

dialogue.label: Route9_Text_ConnerPostBattle
dialogue.text: Train on rough ground and your\nbalance improves fast.\pThat's why I like ROUTE 9.$

dialogue.label: Route9_Text_ConnerRematchIntro
dialogue.text: I've sharpened my turns on this\nrocky path. Watch my team's\pfootwork!$

dialogue.label: Route9_Text_BriceDefeat
dialogue.text: You found better footing!$

dialogue.label: Route9_Text_BriceIntro
dialogue.text: The rocks here teach you where\nto put your feet.\pLet's see if your battling has\nthe same footing!$

dialogue.label: Route9_Text_BricePostBattle
dialogue.text: ROCK TUNNEL is tougher than this\nroad.\pIf ROUTE 9 tires you out, rest\nbefore heading in.$

dialogue.label: Route9_Text_BriceRematchIntro
dialogue.text: Hahaha!\nA little toughie, as always!$

dialogue.label: EventScript_RouteTrainer_YOUNGSTER_EDDIE_Text_Defeat
dialogue.text: Your team made better history!$

dialogue.label: EventScript_RouteTrainer_YOUNGSTER_EDDIE_Text_Intro
dialogue.text: These rocks are younger than the\nones in ROCK TUNNEL.\pStill, they have stories.\nBattle me and I'll tell you!$

dialogue.label: EventScript_RouteTrainer_YOUNGSTER_EDDIE_Text_PostBattle
dialogue.text: The surface stones here hint at\nthe tunnel ahead.\pThat's why RUIN MANIACS never\nwalk a road casually.$

dialogue.label: EventScript_RouteTrainer_YOUNGSTER_EDDIE_Text_RematchIntro
dialogue.text: Back to study the ridge?\pGood. A rematch is the best field\nnote.$

dialogue.label: EventScript_RouteTrainer_LASS_NORA_Text_Defeat
dialogue.text: My legs held, but my team didn't!$

dialogue.label: EventScript_RouteTrainer_LASS_NORA_Text_Intro
dialogue.text: I hike this road to toughen up\nbefore ROCK TUNNEL.\pDon't expect me to take it easy!$

dialogue.label: EventScript_RouteTrainer_LASS_NORA_Text_PostBattle
dialogue.text: Cerulean feels far behind once\nthe road turns rocky.\pThat's when the journey starts\nfeeling real.$

dialogue.label: EventScript_RouteTrainer_LASS_NORA_Text_RematchIntro
dialogue.text: Back from the tunnel road?\pThen show me how much stronger\nyour legs got!$

dialogue.label: EventScript_RouteTrainer_CAMPER_ISAAC_Text_Defeat
dialogue.text: You stayed sure-footed!$

dialogue.label: EventScript_RouteTrainer_CAMPER_ISAAC_Text_Intro
dialogue.text: A SCOUT checks the ledges before\nanyone gets careless.\pROUTE 9 has plenty to check!$

dialogue.label: EventScript_RouteTrainer_CAMPER_ISAAC_Text_PostBattle
dialogue.text: This route looks open, but the\nrocks guide where people move.\pA good SCOUT reads the ground.$

dialogue.label: EventScript_RouteTrainer_CAMPER_ISAAC_Text_RematchIntro
dialogue.text: Back on the ridge road?\pGood. Let's see if you remembered\nthe footing.$

dialogue.label: EventScript_RouteTrainer_PICNICKER_ALMA_Text_Defeat
dialogue.text: That shook the basket!$

dialogue.label: EventScript_RouteTrainer_PICNICKER_ALMA_Text_Intro
dialogue.text: I packed for a picnic, but ROUTE 9\nturned it into a hike.\pA battle break sounds perfect!$

dialogue.label: EventScript_RouteTrainer_PICNICKER_ALMA_Text_PostBattle
dialogue.text: You can still enjoy a rough road.\pYou just need sturdy shoes and\na steady POKéMON.$

dialogue.label: EventScript_RouteTrainer_PICNICKER_ALMA_Text_RematchIntro
dialogue.text: Back for another rocky picnic?\pThen let's battle before the food\ngets dusty.$

dialogue.label: SSAnne_1F_Room2_Text_AnnDefeat
dialogue.text: Oh, no!\nI went around the world for these!$

dialogue.label: SSAnne_1F_Room2_Text_AnnIntro
dialogue.text: I collected these POKéMON\nfrom all around the world!$

dialogue.label: SSAnne_1F_Room2_Text_AnnPostBattle
dialogue.text: You hurt my poor POKéMON!\pI demand that you heal them at a\nPOKéMON CENTER!$

dialogue.label: SSAnne_1F_Room2_Text_TylerDefeat
dialogue.text: Oh!\nThat was not proper at all!$

dialogue.label: SSAnne_1F_Room2_Text_TylerIntro
dialogue.text: Father says a proper trainer\naccepts every challenge.$

dialogue.label: SSAnne_1F_Room2_Text_TylerPostBattle
dialogue.text: I shall have to train harder\nbefore the next voyage.$

dialogue.label: SSAnne_1F_Room4_EventScript_TrendsettersBriRemi_Defeat
dialogue.text: You stole our grand entrance!$

dialogue.label: SSAnne_1F_Room4_EventScript_TrendsettersBriRemi_Intro
dialogue.text: A grand voyage needs\na grand entrance!$

dialogue.label: SSAnne_1F_Room4_EventScript_TrendsettersBriRemi_NeedTwo
dialogue.text: Bring two POKéMON and show us\nyour best combination!$

dialogue.label: SSAnne_1F_Room4_EventScript_TrendsettersBriRemi_Post
dialogue.text: Our next stop?\nThe shops in Celadon!$

dialogue.label: SSAnne_1F_Room5_Text_ArthurDefeat
dialogue.text: Humph! You rude child!\nYou have no sense of courtesy!$

dialogue.label: SSAnne_1F_Room5_Text_ArthurIntro
dialogue.text: You insolent pup!\nHow dare you barge in!$

dialogue.label: SSAnne_1F_Room5_Text_ArthurPostBattle
dialogue.text: I wish to be left alone!\nGet out!$

dialogue.label: SSAnne_1F_Room7_Text_ThomasDefeat
dialogue.text: My, my friends…$

dialogue.label: SSAnne_1F_Room7_Text_ThomasIntro
dialogue.text: I am but a solitary traveler…\pMy sole companions and friends are\nPOKéMON I caught on my journeys…$

dialogue.label: SSAnne_1F_Room7_Text_ThomasPostBattle
dialogue.text: You should be nice to friends!$

dialogue.label: SSAnne_2F_Room2_Text_DaleDefeat
dialogue.text: A costly lesson!$

dialogue.label: SSAnne_2F_Room2_Text_DaleIntro
dialogue.text: A fine voyage calls for a fine\nbattle, wouldn't you say?$

dialogue.label: SSAnne_2F_Room2_Text_DalePostBattle
dialogue.text: The ship's party was splendid.\pThe battles afterward have been\nrather lively, too.$

dialogue.label: SSAnne_2F_Room2_Text_BrooksDefeat
dialogue.text: Good match!\nAh, I feel young again!$

dialogue.label: SSAnne_2F_Room2_Text_BrooksIntro
dialogue.text: Competing against the young keeps\nme youthful.$

dialogue.label: SSAnne_2F_Room2_Text_BrooksPostBattle
dialogue.text: Fifteen years ago, I would\nhave won!$

dialogue.label: SSAnne_2F_Room4_Text_LamarDefeat
dialogue.text: I must salute you!$

dialogue.label: SSAnne_2F_Room4_Text_LamarIntro
dialogue.text: Which do you find more worthy,\na strong or a rare POKéMON?$

dialogue.label: SSAnne_2F_Room4_Text_LamarPostBattle
dialogue.text: Personally, I prefer strong and\nrare POKéMON.$

dialogue.label: SSAnne_2F_Room4_Text_DawnDefeat
dialogue.text: Take it easy!$

dialogue.label: SSAnne_2F_Room4_Text_DawnIntro
dialogue.text: I don't believe I saw you at the\nparty?$

dialogue.label: SSAnne_2F_Room4_Text_DawnPostBattle
dialogue.text: Oh, I adore your strong POKéMON!\nOh, how I envy you for them!$

dialogue.label: SSAnne_B1F_Room1_Text_BarnyDefeat
dialogue.text: Oh!\nHow uncouth of me!$

dialogue.label: SSAnne_B1F_Room1_Text_BarnyIntro
dialogue.text: Even below deck, one should keep\ntheir battling form polished.$

dialogue.label: SSAnne_B1F_Room1_Text_BarnyPostBattle
dialogue.text: I came below deck for quiet.\pInstead, I found quite the capable\ntrainer.$

dialogue.label: SSAnne_B1F_Room1_Text_PhillipDefeat
dialogue.text: Argh!\nBeaten by a kid!$

dialogue.label: SSAnne_B1F_Room1_Text_PhillipIntro
dialogue.text: Matey, you're walking the plank if\nyou lose!$

dialogue.label: SSAnne_B1F_Room1_Text_PhillipPostBattle
dialogue.text: When we're out at sea, jellyfish\nPOKéMON sometimes drift by.$

dialogue.label: SSAnne_B1F_Room2_Text_HueyDefeat
dialogue.text: Okay, you're not bad.$

dialogue.label: SSAnne_B1F_Room2_Text_HueyIntro
dialogue.text: Even us sailors have POKéMON, too!$

dialogue.label: SSAnne_B1F_Room2_Text_HueyPostBattle
dialogue.text: We caught all our POKéMON while\nwe were out at sea.$

dialogue.label: SSAnne_B1F_Room3_Text_DylanDefeat
dialogue.text: Argh!\nLost it!$

dialogue.label: SSAnne_B1F_Room3_Text_DylanIntro
dialogue.text: I like feisty kids like you!$

dialogue.label: SSAnne_B1F_Room3_Text_DylanPostBattle
dialogue.text: Sea POKéMON live in deep water.\nYou'll need a ROD to fish them up!$

dialogue.label: SSAnne_B1F_Room4_Text_DuncanDefeat
dialogue.text: Your spirit sank me!$

dialogue.label: SSAnne_B1F_Room4_Text_DuncanIntro
dialogue.text: Come on, then!\nMy sailor's pride is at stake!$

dialogue.label: SSAnne_B1F_Room4_Text_DuncanPostBattle
dialogue.text: Did you see the FISHING GURU in\nVERMILION CITY?$

dialogue.label: SSAnne_B1F_Room4_Text_LeonardDefeat
dialogue.text: Right!\nGood battle, mate!$

dialogue.label: SSAnne_B1F_Room4_Text_LeonardIntro
dialogue.text: You know what they say about\nsailors and battling!$

dialogue.label: SSAnne_B1F_Room4_Text_LeonardPostBattle
dialogue.text: Hahaha!\nWant to be a sailor, mate?$

dialogue.label: SSAnne_Deck_Text_TrevorDefeat
dialogue.text: I was just careless!$

dialogue.label: SSAnne_Deck_Text_TrevorIntro
dialogue.text: Ahoy, there!\nAre you seasick?$

dialogue.label: SSAnne_Deck_Text_TrevorPostBattle
dialogue.text: My pa said there are 100 kinds of\nPOKéMON. I think there are more.$

dialogue.label: SSAnne_Deck_Text_EdmondDefeat
dialogue.text: You're impressive!$

dialogue.label: SSAnne_Deck_Text_EdmondIntro
dialogue.text: Hey, matey!\pLet's do a little jig!$

dialogue.label: SSAnne_Deck_Text_EdmondPostBattle
dialogue.text: How many kinds of POKéMON do you\nthink there are in this big world?$

dialogue.label: SaffronCity_Dojo_Text_HitoshiDefeat
dialogue.text: Oof!\nI give up!$

dialogue.label: SaffronCity_Dojo_Text_HitoshiIntro
dialogue.text: Hwaah!\pYou're trespassing in our\nFIGHTING DOJO!$

dialogue.label: SaffronCity_Dojo_Text_HitoshiPostBattle
dialogue.text: The prime fighters across the land\ntrain here.$

dialogue.label: SaffronCity_Dojo_Text_HidekiDefeat
dialogue.text: Judge!\nOne point!$

dialogue.label: SaffronCity_Dojo_Text_HidekiIntro
dialogue.text: I hear you're good!\nShow me!$

dialogue.label: SaffronCity_Dojo_Text_HidekiPostBattle
dialogue.text: Our MASTER is a pro fighter.\nBe prepared to lose!$

dialogue.label: SaffronCity_Dojo_Text_AaronDefeat
dialogue.text: Yow!\nStubbed fingers!$

dialogue.label: SaffronCity_Dojo_Text_AaronIntro
dialogue.text: Hiyah!\nI have no fear for anything tough!\pI shatter boulders for training\nevery day!$

dialogue.label: SaffronCity_Dojo_Text_AaronPostBattle
dialogue.text: The only thing that frightens us is\npsychic power!$

dialogue.label: SaffronCity_Dojo_Text_MikeDefeat
dialogue.text: I bow to that technique!$

dialogue.label: SaffronCity_Dojo_Text_MikeIntro
dialogue.text: Hoargh!\nTake your shoes off!$

dialogue.label: SaffronCity_Dojo_Text_MikePostBattle
dialogue.text: You wait 'til you see our MASTER!\nI'm a small fry compared to him!$

dialogue.label: SaffronCity_Dojo_Text_ChoosePrizedFightingMon
dialogue.text: Indeed, I have lost!\pBut, I beseech you, do not take\nour emblem as your trophy!\pIn return, I will give you a prized\nFIGHTING POKéMON!\pChoose whichever one you like!$

dialogue.label: SaffronCity_Dojo_Text_MasterKoichiDefeat
dialogue.text: Hwa!\nArrgh! Beaten!$

dialogue.label: SaffronCity_Dojo_Text_MasterKoichiIntro
dialogue.text: Grunt!\pI am the KARATE MASTER!\nI am the LEADER here!\pYou wish to challenge us?\nExpect no mercy!\pFwaaa!$

dialogue.label: SaffronCity_Dojo_Text_StayAndTrainWithUs
dialogue.text: Grunt!\nStay and train at karate with us!$

dialogue.label: SaffronCity_Dojo_Text_CarlyDefeat
dialogue.text: A clean finish.$

dialogue.label: SaffronCity_Dojo_Text_CarlyIntro
dialogue.text: Black belts master technique.\pExperts master when to use it.\nShow me your judgment.$

dialogue.label: SaffronCity_Dojo_Text_CarlyPostBattle
dialogue.text: Power without timing is only\nnoise.\pA true martial artist makes one\nmotion answer everything.$

dialogue.label: SaffronCity_Dojo_Text_ExpertMaraDefeat
dialogue.text: You spotted the opening first!$

dialogue.label: SaffronCity_Dojo_Text_ExpertMaraIntro
dialogue.text: Watch your opponent carefully.\nEach move teaches you something.$

dialogue.label: SaffronCity_Dojo_Text_ExpertMaraPostBattle
dialogue.text: I ask my students what they\nnoticed before I give advice.\pThey often see what I miss.$

dialogue.label: SaffronCity_Dojo_Text_CrushKinAfter
dialogue.text: We grew up training side by side.\nNow our POKéMON do the same!$

dialogue.label: SaffronCity_Dojo_Text_CrushKinDefeat
dialogue.text: You found our opening!$

dialogue.label: SaffronCity_Dojo_Text_CrushKinIntro
dialogue.text: We train together as siblings!\nOur POKéMON follow our rhythm.\pShow us how your team works\nin a DOUBLE BATTLE!$

dialogue.label: SaffronCity_Dojo_Text_CrushKinNeedTwo
dialogue.text: Bring two POKéMON that can battle.\nWe always train as a pair!$

dialogue.label: Common_Text_NeedTwoPokemonForDoubleBattle
dialogue.text: You'll need two POKéMON with you\nfor a DOUBLE BATTLE.$

dialogue.label: SaffronCity_Gym_Text_ExplainMarshBadgeTakeThis
dialogue.text: A calm mind earns trust from\neven strong outsider POKéMON.\pKeep completing PROF. OAK's\nsubquests to strengthen that bond.$

dialogue.label: SaffronCity_Gym_Text_ReceivedChinglingFromSabrina
dialogue.text: {PLAYER} received CHINGLING\nfrom SABRINA!$

dialogue.label: SaffronCity_Gym_Text_SabrinaChinglingAdvice
dialogue.text: CHINGLING already feels close\nto you. Nurture that friendship.\pWhen its bond is strong enough,\nit can evolve into CHIMECHO\lby leveling up at night.$

dialogue.label: SaffronCity_Gym_Text_SabrinaDefeat
dialogue.text:
This loss shocks me!
But, a loss is a loss.\pI admit, I didn't work hard enough
to win.\pYour victory has earned you the
MARSHBADGE.$

dialogue.label: SaffronCity_Gym_Text_SabrinaGiftChingling
dialogue.text: SABRINA: Your calm presence\nearned this CHINGLING's trust.\pI would like you to take it\nwith you on your journey.$

dialogue.label: SaffronCity_Gym_Text_SabrinaIntro
dialogue.text:
I had a vision of your arrival.\pI am SABRINA.
SAFFRON CITY's GYM LEADER.\pYou kept your mind steady within
POKéMON TOWER's astral pull.\pI have had psychic powers since
I was a child.\pIt started when a spoon I
carelessly tossed, bent.\pI dislike battling, but if you wish,
I will show you my powers!{PLAY_BGM}{MUS_ENCOUNTER_GYM_LEADER}$

dialogue.label: SaffronCity_Gym_Text_SabrinaPostBattle
dialogue.text: Psychic power isn't something that\nonly a few people have.\pEveryone has psychic power.\nPeople just don't realize it.$

dialogue.label: SaffronCity_Gym_Text_SabrinaPostFieldVictory
dialogue.text: POKéMON TOWER's astral pressure\nhas settled.\pThe MARSHBADGE is proof that your\nmind held firm within it.$

dialogue.label: Text_GiveNicknameToThisMon
dialogue.text: Do you want to give a nickname to\nthis {STR_VAR_1}?$

dialogue.label: Text_MonSentToBoxBillsBoxFull
dialogue.text: BOX “{STR_VAR_3}” on\nBILL'S PC was full.\p{STR_VAR_2} was transferred to\nBOX “{STR_VAR_1}.”$

dialogue.label: Text_MonSentToBoxInBillsPC
dialogue.text: {STR_VAR_2} was transferred to\nBILL'S PC.\pIt was placed in \nBOX “{STR_VAR_1}.”$

dialogue.label: Text_MonSentToBoxInSomeonesPC
dialogue.text: {STR_VAR_2} was transferred to\nSomeone's PC.\pIt was placed in \nBOX “{STR_VAR_1}.”$

dialogue.label: Text_MonSentToBoxSomeonesBoxFull
dialogue.text: BOX “{STR_VAR_3}” on\nSomeone's PC was full.\p{STR_VAR_2} was transferred to\nBOX “{STR_VAR_1}.”$

dialogue.label: Text_NoMoreRoomForPokemon
dialogue.text: There's no more room for POKéMON!\pThe POKéMON BOXES are full and\ncan't accept any more!$

dialogue.label: SaffronCity_Gym_Text_OrinAfter
dialogue.text: A calm mind can learn\neven from defeat.$

dialogue.label: SaffronCity_Gym_Text_OrinDefeat
dialogue.text: My thoughts ran ahead of my\nteam!$

dialogue.label: SaffronCity_Gym_Text_OrinIntro
dialogue.text: Focus your thoughts.\nNow, focus your team!$

dialogue.label: SaffronCity_Gym_Text_AldenAfter
dialogue.text: The shortest path is not\nalways the clearest one.$

dialogue.label: SaffronCity_Gym_Text_AldenDefeat
dialogue.text: You found the clear way through!$

dialogue.label: SaffronCity_Gym_Text_AldenIntro
dialogue.text: These rooms test direction.\nI test concentration.$

dialogue.label: SaffronCity_Gym_Text_SilasAfter
dialogue.text: Prediction still needs practice.\nBring your VS SEEKER next time.$

dialogue.label: SaffronCity_Gym_Text_SilasDefeat
dialogue.text: I didn't predict that finish!$

dialogue.label: SaffronCity_Gym_Text_SilasIntro
dialogue.text: Can you read my next move?\nLet us find out.$

dialogue.label: SaffronCity_Gym_Text_MiraAfter
dialogue.text: Our training continues\nwhile SABRINA is away.$

dialogue.label: SaffronCity_Gym_Text_MiraDefeat
dialogue.text: My concentration slipped!$

dialogue.label: SaffronCity_Gym_Text_MiraIntro
dialogue.text: SABRINA values a steady mind.\nShow me yours in battle.$

dialogue.label: SaffronCity_Gym_Text_SeleneAfter
dialogue.text: Trust makes it easier\nto understand one another.$

dialogue.label: SaffronCity_Gym_Text_SeleneDefeat
dialogue.text: Your team heard you clearly!$

dialogue.label: SaffronCity_Gym_Text_SeleneIntro
dialogue.text: Close out the noise.\nListen to your POKéMON.$

dialogue.label: SaffronCity_Gym_Text_LyraAfter
dialogue.text: Come back with your VS SEEKER.\nThere is always more to learn.$

dialogue.label: SaffronCity_Gym_Text_LyraDefeat
dialogue.text: A clear and decisive answer!$

dialogue.label: SaffronCity_Gym_Text_LyraIntro
dialogue.text: A clear mind and a loyal team.\nThat is my kind of strength.$

dialogue.label: SilphCo_10F_Text_GruntDefeat
dialogue.text: I'm stunned!$

dialogue.label: SilphCo_10F_Text_GruntIntro
dialogue.text: Welcome to 10F!\nSo good of you to join me!$

dialogue.label: SilphCo_10F_Text_GruntPostBattle
dialogue.text: Nice try, but the boardroom is up\none more floor.$

dialogue.label: SilphCo_11F_Text_Grunt1Defeat
dialogue.text: Gaah!\nDemolished!$

dialogue.label: SilphCo_11F_Text_Grunt1Intro
dialogue.text: Halt! Do you have an appointment\nwith my BOSS?$

dialogue.label: SilphCo_11F_Text_Grunt1PostBattle
dialogue.text: Watch your step…\nMy BOSS likes his POKéMON tough!$

dialogue.label: SilphCo_11F_Text_Grunt2Defeat
dialogue.text: Don't…\nPlease!$

dialogue.label: SilphCo_11F_Text_Grunt2Intro
dialogue.text: Stop right there!\nDon't you move!$

dialogue.label: SilphCo_11F_Text_Grunt2PostBattle
dialogue.text: So, you want to see my BOSS?$

dialogue.label: SilphCo_11F_Text_GiovanniChallenge
dialogue.text: I will not allow sentiment to\ninterrupt absolute power.$

dialogue.label: SilphCo_11F_Text_GiovanniDefeat
dialogue.text: No…\nThe plan was flawless!$

dialogue.label: SilphCo_11F_Text_GiovanniIntro
dialogue.text:
GIOVANNI: You're the child from
POKEMON MANSION...\pSo, you followed me from
CINNABAR ISLAND.\pSILPH's MASTER BALL is no mere
product.\pIt is control made mechanical.
Command made perfect.\pWith its plans, TEAM ROCKET will
manufacture the means to reclaim\lMEWTWO.\pCome forth.
I'll deal with you now.$

dialogue.label: SilphCo_11F_Text_GiovanniPostBattle
dialogue.text:
GIOVANNI: So SILPH's MASTER BALL
will remain out of reach.\pNo matter.\pA BALL is only one way to claim
power.\pSILPH's signal research will
complete my device.\pI will call MEWTWO to ROUTE 7.\pOnce it answers, no LEAGUE,
no child, and no bond will stand\lin my way.\pTEAM ROCKET, withdraw.
We have what we need.$

dialogue.label: SilphCo_11F_Text_GiovanniScoffs
dialogue.text: GIOVANNI: Hmph.$

dialogue.label: SilphCo_11F_Text_PresidentInterruptsGiovanni
dialogue.text: PRESIDENT: GIOVANNI, stop this!\pThe MASTER BALL was never meant\nto enslave POKEMON.\pIf you force that power on MEWTWO,\nyou'll bring ruin on us all.$

dialogue.label: SilphCo_2F_Text_Grunt2Defeat
dialogue.text: I goofed!$

dialogue.label: SilphCo_2F_Text_Grunt2Intro
dialogue.text: Hey, kid!\nWhat are you wandering here for?$

dialogue.label: SilphCo_2F_Text_Grunt2PostBattle
dialogue.text: SILPH CO. will be associated with\nTEAM ROCKET!$

dialogue.label: SilphCo_2F_Text_Grunt1Defeat
dialogue.text: Tough!$

dialogue.label: SilphCo_2F_Text_Grunt1Intro
dialogue.text: No kids are allowed in here!$

dialogue.label: SilphCo_2F_Text_Grunt1PostBattle
dialogue.text: Diamond-shaped tiles are teleport\nblocks.\pThey're transporters for this\nhigh-tech building.$

dialogue.label: SilphCo_3F_Text_GruntDefeat
dialogue.text: I give up!$

dialogue.label: SilphCo_3F_Text_GruntIntro
dialogue.text: Quit messing with us, kid!$

dialogue.label: SilphCo_3F_Text_GruntPostBattle
dialogue.text: A hint? You can open doors with\na CARD KEY!$

dialogue.label: SilphCo_4F_Text_Grunt2Defeat
dialogue.text: Who are you?$

dialogue.label: SilphCo_4F_Text_Grunt2Intro
dialogue.text: Intruder spotted!$

dialogue.label: SilphCo_4F_Text_Grunt2PostBattle
dialogue.text: I better tell the BOSS on 11F!$

dialogue.label: SilphCo_4F_Text_Grunt1Defeat
dialogue.text: Arrgh!$

dialogue.label: SilphCo_4F_Text_Grunt1Intro
dialogue.text: TEAM ROCKET has taken control\nof SILPH CO.!$

dialogue.label: SilphCo_4F_Text_Grunt1PostBattle
dialogue.text: Fwahahaha!\nMy BOSS has been after this place!$

dialogue.label: SilphCo_5F_Text_Grunt2Defeat
dialogue.text: Cough…\nCough…$

dialogue.label: SilphCo_5F_Text_Grunt2Intro
dialogue.text: Show TEAM ROCKET a little respect!$

dialogue.label: SilphCo_5F_Text_Grunt2PostBattle
dialogue.text: Which reminds me.\pKOFFING evolves into WEEZING!$

dialogue.label: SilphCo_5F_Text_Grunt1Defeat
dialogue.text: Boom!$

dialogue.label: SilphCo_5F_Text_Grunt1Intro
dialogue.text: I heard a kid was wandering\naround.$

dialogue.label: SilphCo_5F_Text_Grunt1PostBattle
dialogue.text: It's not smart to pick a fight with\nTEAM ROCKET!$

dialogue.label: SilphCo_6F_Text_Grunt1Defeat
dialogue.text: Flame out!$

dialogue.label: SilphCo_6F_Text_Grunt1Intro
dialogue.text: I am one of the four ROCKET\nSIBLINGS!$

dialogue.label: SilphCo_6F_Text_Grunt1PostBattle
dialogue.text: No matter!\nMy siblings will avenge me!$

dialogue.label: SilphCo_6F_Text_Grunt2Defeat
dialogue.text: You traitor!$

dialogue.label: SilphCo_6F_Text_Grunt2Intro
dialogue.text: You dare betray TEAM ROCKET?$

dialogue.label: SilphCo_6F_Text_Grunt2PostBattle
dialogue.text: If you stand for justice, you\nbetray us bad guys!$

dialogue.label: SilphCo_7F_Text_Grunt1Defeat
dialogue.text: Aack!\nSiblings, I lost!$

dialogue.label: SilphCo_7F_Text_Grunt1Intro
dialogue.text: I am one of the four ROCKET\nSIBLINGS!$

dialogue.label: SilphCo_7F_Text_Grunt1PostBattle
dialogue.text: Doesn't matter.\nMy siblings will repay the favor!$

dialogue.label: SilphCo_7F_Text_Grunt2Defeat
dialogue.text: Fine!\nI lost!$

dialogue.label: SilphCo_7F_Text_Grunt2Intro
dialogue.text: A child intruder?\nThat must be you!$

dialogue.label: SilphCo_7F_Text_Grunt2PostBattle
dialogue.text: Go on home before my BOSS gets\nticked off!$

dialogue.label: SilphCo_7F_Text_Grunt3Defeat
dialogue.text: Lights out!$

dialogue.label: SilphCo_7F_Text_Grunt3Intro
dialogue.text: Uh-oh!\nI smell a little mouse!$

dialogue.label: SilphCo_7F_Text_Grunt3PostBattle
dialogue.text: You won't find my BOSS by just\nscurrying around!$

dialogue.label: SilphCo_7F_Text_RivalDefeat
dialogue.text: Tch!\nYou might actually make it\lto the top floor.$

dialogue.label: SilphCo_7F_Text_RivalIntro
dialogue.text:
{RIVAL}: I figured out why
they're here before you did,\lobviously.\pSILPH isn't just money.
It's capture tech.\pA MASTER BALL that can catch
anything...\pSomeone powerful would burn down
SAFFRON for that.\pSee BOSS? The lab reconstructed
my KABUSTAR from fossil pieces.\pI chose DOME and HASTE fragments.
Pretty good combination, huh?\pGENIUS evolved into ESPEON
while we trained one morning.\pNo stone. Just trust.
Guess I earned it, huh?\pYou're going upstairs, right?
Ready to battle me and prove\lyou won't fold when it matters?$

dialogue.label: SilphCo_7F_Text_RivalNotReady
dialogue.text: {RIVAL}: Figures.\pTry not to spend all day hiding\nbehind me.$

dialogue.label: SilphCo_7F_Text_RivalPostBattle
dialogue.text:
Fine. You can handle yourself.\pBut don't get excited.
I already knew this was bigger\lthan a robbery.\pWhoever is pulling TEAM ROCKET's
strings wants control.\pNot money. Not badges.
Control.\pI'm finding my own way through.
Try not to trail too far behind.\pSmell ya!$

dialogue.label: SilphCo_7F_Text_RivalWhatKeptYou
dialogue.text: {RIVAL}: Ha!\nTook you long enough, {PLAYER}.\pDon't tell me the ROCKETS\nactually slowed you down.$

dialogue.label: SilphCo_8F_Text_Grunt1Defeat
dialogue.text: Not enough grit!$

dialogue.label: SilphCo_8F_Text_Grunt1Intro
dialogue.text: That's as far as you'll go!$

dialogue.label: SilphCo_8F_Text_Grunt1PostBattle
dialogue.text: If you don't turn back…\nI'll call for backup!$

dialogue.label: SilphCo_8F_Text_Grunt2Defeat
dialogue.text: Whoo!\nOh, Siblings!$

dialogue.label: SilphCo_8F_Text_Grunt2Intro
dialogue.text: I am one of the four ROCKET\nSIBLINGS!$

dialogue.label: SilphCo_8F_Text_Grunt2PostBattle
dialogue.text: I'll leave you up to my siblings.$

dialogue.label: SilphCo_9F_Text_Grunt2Defeat
dialogue.text: Warg!\nSiblings, I lost!$

dialogue.label: SilphCo_9F_Text_Grunt2Intro
dialogue.text: I am one of the four ROCKET\nSIBLINGS!$

dialogue.label: SilphCo_9F_Text_Grunt2PostBattle
dialogue.text: My siblings will avenge me!$

dialogue.label: SilphCo_9F_Text_Grunt1Defeat
dialogue.text: Ghaaah!$

dialogue.label: SilphCo_9F_Text_Grunt1Intro
dialogue.text: Your POKéMON seem to adore you,\nkid!$

dialogue.label: SilphCo_9F_Text_Grunt1PostBattle
dialogue.text: If I had started as a TRAINER at\nyour age…$

dialogue.label: UndergroundPath_Tunnel_Text_PokefanAltonDefeat
dialogue.text: They got plenty of attention!$

dialogue.label: UndergroundPath_Tunnel_Text_PokefanAltonIntro
dialogue.text: I come down here when SAFFRON's\ncrowds get too loud.\pMy {PKMN} still like attention!$

dialogue.label: UndergroundPath_Tunnel_Text_PokefanAltonPostBattle
dialogue.text: A tunnel full of trainers feels\nfriendlier than a busy street.$

dialogue.label: UndergroundPath_Tunnel_Text_PokefanMiraDefeat
dialogue.text: That was a warm little battle.$

dialogue.label: UndergroundPath_Tunnel_Text_PokefanMiraIntro
dialogue.text: Everyone above hurries past each\nother toward SAFFRON.\pDown here, we can actually chat.$

dialogue.label: UndergroundPath_Tunnel_Text_PokefanMiraPostBattle
dialogue.text: I like hearing footsteps before\nI see who is coming.$

dialogue.label: UndergroundPath_Tunnel_Text_PokemaniacNolanDefeat
dialogue.text: A rare loss for my records!$

dialogue.label: UndergroundPath_Tunnel_Text_PokemaniacNolanIntro
dialogue.text: Shortcuts collect stories.\nThat makes this tunnel valuable.$

dialogue.label: UndergroundPath_Tunnel_Text_PokemaniacNolanPostBattle
dialogue.text: I catalogue every trainer who\npasses under SAFFRON.$

dialogue.label: UndergroundPath_Tunnel_Text_SuperNerdVanceDefeat
dialogue.text: My figures were off!$

dialogue.label: UndergroundPath_Tunnel_Text_SuperNerdVanceIntro
dialogue.text: The air pressure shifts near each\nstairwell.\pLet's test battle acoustics!$

dialogue.label: UndergroundPath_Tunnel_Text_SuperNerdVancePostBattle
dialogue.text: A cross tunnel changes sound in\nways a straight one never could.$

dialogue.label: UndergroundPath_Tunnel_Text_PokefanHugoDefeat
dialogue.text: That team has spirit!$

dialogue.label: UndergroundPath_Tunnel_Text_PokefanHugoIntro
dialogue.text: Four exits, one tunnel.\nEvery trainer brings a\ndifferent partner.\pShow me yours!$

dialogue.label: UndergroundPath_Tunnel_Text_PokefanHugoPostBattle
dialogue.text: I keep notes on the partners\npeople choose underground.$

dialogue.label: UndergroundPath_Tunnel_Text_PokemaniacDirkDefeat
dialogue.text: My rumor fizzled out!$

dialogue.label: UndergroundPath_Tunnel_Text_PokemaniacDirkIntro
dialogue.text: Rare {PKMN} rumors travel faster\nunderground than above.$

dialogue.label: UndergroundPath_Tunnel_Text_PokemaniacDirkPostBattle
dialogue.text: SAFFRON's streets talk business.\nDown here, people talk {PKMN}.$

dialogue.label: UndergroundPath_Tunnel_Text_PokefanRichDefeat
dialogue.text: Your POKEMON stole the show!$

dialogue.label: UndergroundPath_Tunnel_Text_PokefanRichIntro
dialogue.text: I came for the shortcut and\nstayed for the parade of\nPOKEMON!$

dialogue.label: UndergroundPath_Tunnel_Text_PokefanRichPostBattle
dialogue.text: Every entrance brings another\nteam to admire.$

dialogue.label: UndergroundPath_Tunnel_Text_SuperNerdLeslieDefeat
dialogue.text: Open circuit!$

dialogue.label: UndergroundPath_Tunnel_Text_SuperNerdLeslieIntro
dialogue.text: SAFFRON sits above us like a giant\ncircuit board.\pCare to complete a battle circuit?$

dialogue.label: UndergroundPath_Tunnel_Text_SuperNerdLesliePostBattle
dialogue.text: Every entrance feeds a different\nflow of trainers underground.$

dialogue.label: UndergroundPath_Tunnel_Text_PokemaniacRicardoDefeat
dialogue.text: I'll file that under defeat.$

dialogue.label: UndergroundPath_Tunnel_Text_PokemaniacRicardoIntro
dialogue.text: People drop odd things when they\nduck underground.\pI collect battles, too!$

dialogue.label: UndergroundPath_Tunnel_Text_PokemaniacRicardoPostBattle
dialogue.text: The path above belongs to traffic.\nThis path belongs to finds.$

dialogue.label: UndergroundPath_Tunnel_Text_PokefanElliotDefeat
dialogue.text: That was worth the wait!$

dialogue.label: UndergroundPath_Tunnel_Text_PokefanElliotIntro
dialogue.text: Rare teams pass under SAFFRON.\nLet me see yours up close!$

dialogue.label: UndergroundPath_Tunnel_Text_PokefanElliotPostBattle
dialogue.text: Aboveground everyone hurries.\nDown here, I can admire a\ngood team.$

dialogue.label: UndergroundPath_Tunnel_Text_PokefanSolDefeat
dialogue.text: I heard that loud and clear!$

dialogue.label: UndergroundPath_Tunnel_Text_PokefanSolIntro
dialogue.text: Every echo down here sounds\nlike another POKEMON cry.\pBattle me before I guess wrong!$

dialogue.label: UndergroundPath_Tunnel_Text_PokefanSolPostBattle
dialogue.text: The tunnel makes every team\nfeel a little mysterious.$

dialogue.label: UndergroundPath_Tunnel_Text_PokemaniacHideoDefeat
dialogue.text: Your story beats mine!$

dialogue.label: UndergroundPath_Tunnel_Text_PokemaniacHideoIntro
dialogue.text: I haunt this tunnel for odd teams\nand stranger battle stories.$

dialogue.label: UndergroundPath_Tunnel_Text_PokemaniacHideoPostBattle
dialogue.text: A real fanatic knows the best\nfinds are below the obvious path.$

dialogue.label: Common_Text_NeedTwoPokemonForDoubleBattle
dialogue.text: You'll need two POKéMON with you\nfor a DOUBLE BATTLE.$

dialogue.label: VermilionCity_Gym_Text_ExplainThunderBadge
dialogue.text:
That pass unlocks vitamins and
battle items at POKéMON MARTS.\pPower isn't handed to you.
Use those tools and train until\lyour POKéMON can hold it.\pBring me a RAICHU with real
voltage.\pThen I'll show you evolution
through serious output.$

dialogue.label: VermilionCity_Gym_Text_LtSurgeDeclineElectabuzzTrade
dialogue.text: No pressure, kid!\pCome back when you're ready to\nhandle that kind of power.$

dialogue.label: VermilionCity_Gym_Text_LtSurgeDefeat
dialogue.text: Now that's a shocker!\pYou're the real deal, kid!\pFine, then, take the THUNDERBADGE!$

dialogue.label: VermilionCity_Gym_Text_LtSurgeElectabuzzTradeComplete
dialogue.text: Hah!\nNow that's a power surge!\pTrading with an ELECTIRIZER\nturned ELECTABUZZ into ELECTIVIRE!$

dialogue.label: VermilionCity_Gym_Text_LtSurgeElectabuzzTradeDone
dialogue.text: That ELECTIVIRE was built for\nserious output.\pKeep it charged, kid!$

dialogue.label: VermilionCity_Gym_Text_LtSurgeIntro
dialogue.text:
So, you made it back, kid!\pI'm LT. SURGE.
VERMILION CITY's GYM LEADER.\pYou handled VOLT TACKLE training
without flinching.\pThat takes nerve!\pPower isn't handed to you.
You train until you can hold it!\pBut a GYM battle is combat!
No holding back!\pI tell you, kid, electric POKéMON
saved me during the war!\pNow show me you can stand against
real voltage!{PLAY_BGM}{MUS_ENCOUNTER_GYM_LEADER}$

dialogue.label: VermilionCity_Gym_Text_LtSurgeNotRaichu
dialogue.text: That's not RAICHU, kid!\pBring me the real lightning rod.$

dialogue.label: VermilionCity_Gym_Text_LtSurgeOfferElectabuzzTrade
dialogue.text: Hey, kid!\pYou've got a RAICHU with real\nvoltage, right?\pI've got an ELECTABUZZ holding\nan ELECTIRIZER.\pTrade me your RAICHU for it?$

dialogue.label: VermilionCity_Gym_Text_LtSurgePostBattle
dialogue.text: A little word of advice, kid!\pElectricity is sure powerful!\pBut training is how you make\nthat power obey!\pBut, it's useless against GROUND-\ntype POKéMON!$

dialogue.label: VermilionCity_Gym_Text_TakeThisWithYou
dialogue.text: The THUNDERBADGE proves you\ncleared VERMILION GYM!\pAnd with it, take this pass.\nIt'll get you special MART stock.$

dialogue.label: WatersEdge_EventScript_HarborTuberKai_Text_Defeat
dialogue.text: Whoa! My float did a flip!$

dialogue.label: WatersEdge_EventScript_HarborTuberKai_Text_Intro
dialogue.text: My float keeps bobbing when the\nships go by! Can your team stay\psteady?$

dialogue.label: WatersEdge_EventScript_HarborTuberKai_Text_PostBattle
dialogue.text: I count the ripples after each\nboat. The little ones always\pcatch up!$

dialogue.label: WatersEdge_EventScript_HarborTuberKai_Text_RematchIntro
dialogue.text: I stayed upright through three\nwakes! Now for your POKéMON!$

dialogue.label: WatersEdge_EventScript_HarborTuberMina_Text_Defeat
dialogue.text: My shell couldn't save us!$

dialogue.label: WatersEdge_EventScript_HarborTuberMina_Text_Intro
dialogue.text: I found a shell shaped like a\ntiny shield! My team wants to\ptest it.$

dialogue.label: WatersEdge_EventScript_HarborTuberMina_Text_PostBattle
dialogue.text: I put the shells back when I'm\ndone. Someone small might need a\phome.$

dialogue.label: WatersEdge_EventScript_HarborTuberMina_Text_RematchIntro
dialogue.text: Look, another shield shell! This\ntime we have a plan!$

dialogue.label: WatersEdge_EventScript_HarborFishermanOtto_Text_Defeat
dialogue.text: A fine catch, young one!$

dialogue.label: WatersEdge_EventScript_HarborFishermanOtto_Text_Intro
dialogue.text: I lower my line beside the\nmooring posts. No need for a\pfancy cast. Show me your\ntechnique!$

dialogue.label: WatersEdge_EventScript_HarborFishermanOtto_Text_PostBattle
dialogue.text: A still float isn't always a bad\nsign. Sometimes the fish are\pstudying you.$

dialogue.label: WatersEdge_EventScript_HarborFishermanOtto_Text_RematchIntro
dialogue.text: Same old rod, new trick. Watch\nthe tip!$

dialogue.label: WatersEdge_EventScript_HarborFishermanVale_Text_Defeat
dialogue.text: That's one for my records!$

dialogue.label: WatersEdge_EventScript_HarborFishermanVale_Text_Intro
dialogue.text: The forest runoff meets salt\nwater here. I never know what\pwill bite next!$

dialogue.label: WatersEdge_EventScript_HarborFishermanVale_Text_PostBattle
dialogue.text: I note each catch with the tide.\nEven familiar fish choose\pdifferent water.$

dialogue.label: WatersEdge_EventScript_HarborFishermanVale_Text_RematchIntro
dialogue.text: I've filled another page with\ncatches. Your team deserves a\ppage too!$

dialogue.label: WatersEdge_EventScript_HarborSwimmerDane_Text_Defeat
dialogue.text: Time for my shore break!$

dialogue.label: WatersEdge_EventScript_HarborSwimmerDane_Text_Intro
dialogue.text: I swim short lengths between\nrests on shore. Fast isn't much\puse if you can't get back!$

dialogue.label: WatersEdge_EventScript_HarborSwimmerDane_Text_PostBattle
dialogue.text: Boats need room to turn. I stay\nwell clear of their route, even\pon a good day.$

dialogue.label: WatersEdge_EventScript_HarborSwimmerDane_Text_RematchIntro
dialogue.text: Rested, warmed up, ready! Let's\nmake this a good length!$

dialogue.label: WatersEdge_EventScript_HarborSwimmerLina_Text_Defeat
dialogue.text: So much for a quiet swim!$

dialogue.label: WatersEdge_EventScript_HarborSwimmerLina_Text_Intro
dialogue.text: I can float without making a\nripple. My POKéMON aren't nearly\pso quiet!$

dialogue.label: WatersEdge_EventScript_HarborSwimmerLina_Text_PostBattle
dialogue.text: Lie back and listen. The ropes\ncreak, the gulls call... The\pharbor has a rhythm.$

dialogue.label: WatersEdge_EventScript_HarborSwimmerLina_Text_RematchIntro
dialogue.text: I heard your splashes coming.\nOur quiet break is over!$

dialogue.label: WatersEdge_EventScript_HarborSailorPax_Text_Defeat
dialogue.text: You slipped every knot!$

dialogue.label: WatersEdge_EventScript_HarborSailorPax_Text_Intro
dialogue.text: I tie knots aboard ship. In\nbattle, I like leaving my\popponent in a tangle!$

dialogue.label: WatersEdge_EventScript_HarborSailorPax_Text_PostBattle
dialogue.text: A knot should hold under strain,\nthen loosen when you need it.\pThat's a useful lesson ashore.$

dialogue.label: WatersEdge_EventScript_HarborSailorPax_Text_RematchIntro
dialogue.text: No loose ends in our plan today!\nLet's see you untie it!$

dialogue.label: WatersEdge_EventScript_HarborSailorMorgan_Text_Defeat
dialogue.text: A change of wind caught me!$

dialogue.label: WatersEdge_EventScript_HarborSailorMorgan_Text_Intro
dialogue.text: I watch the treeline to judge\nthe wind. A sailor needs more\pthan a view of the waves!$

dialogue.label: WatersEdge_EventScript_HarborSailorMorgan_Text_PostBattle
dialogue.text: Those trees mark the eastern\nshore. After a long voyage,\pgreen is a welcome sight.$

dialogue.label: WatersEdge_EventScript_HarborSailorMorgan_Text_RematchIntro
dialogue.text: Leaves fluttering, pennants\nflying... A fine breeze for\panother match!$

dialogue.label: WatersEdge_EventScript_HarborSailorRafe_Text_Defeat
dialogue.text: You carried that battle!$

dialogue.label: WatersEdge_EventScript_HarborSailorRafe_Text_Intro
dialogue.text: Loading cargo taught me to share\nthe weight. My team knows how to\ppull together!$

dialogue.label: WatersEdge_EventScript_HarborSailorRafe_Text_PostBattle
dialogue.text: The smallest deckhand can spot a\nslipping rope. I listen when\panyone calls out.$

dialogue.label: WatersEdge_EventScript_HarborSailorRafe_Text_RematchIntro
dialogue.text: All hands ready! We've learned\nto answer each other faster!$

dialogue.label: WatersEdge_EventScript_HarborTriathleteSkye_Text_Defeat
dialogue.text: You caught me in transition!$

dialogue.label: WatersEdge_EventScript_HarborTriathleteSkye_Text_Intro
dialogue.text: I practise changing from a swim\nto a run. The first few steps\palways feel strange!$

dialogue.label: WatersEdge_EventScript_HarborTriathleteSkye_Text_PostBattle
dialogue.text: I lay out my shoes before\nswimming. Finding them shouldn't\pbe the hardest part of training.$

dialogue.label: WatersEdge_EventScript_HarborTriathleteSkye_Text_RematchIntro
dialogue.text: Shoes ready, breath steady. This\ntransition includes a battle!$

dialogue.label: WatersEdge_EventScript_HarborTriathleteRory_Text_Defeat
dialogue.text: I spent too much too soon!$

dialogue.label: WatersEdge_EventScript_HarborTriathleteRory_Text_Intro
dialogue.text: I'm working on even splits.\nStarting too fast cost me my\plast race. Race my team instead!$

dialogue.label: WatersEdge_EventScript_HarborTriathleteRory_Text_PostBattle
dialogue.text: I measure progress by what I\nhave left at the finish, not how\pI feel at the start.$

dialogue.label: WatersEdge_EventScript_HarborTriathleteRory_Text_RematchIntro
dialogue.text: I've saved something for the\nfinal stretch this time!$

dialogue.label: WatersEdge_EventScript_HarborTriathleteElle_Text_Defeat
dialogue.text: A well-earned water break!$

dialogue.label: WatersEdge_EventScript_HarborTriathleteElle_Text_Intro
dialogue.text: My partner sets our training\npace. Today it wants to stop and\pchallenge you!$

dialogue.label: WatersEdge_EventScript_HarborTriathleteElle_Text_PostBattle
dialogue.text: Some days we train hard. Other\ndays we walk along the trees.\pRest is part of getting\nstronger.$

dialogue.label: WatersEdge_EventScript_HarborTriathleteElle_Text_RematchIntro
dialogue.text: My partner spotted you again. I\nthink it wants a rematch!$

dialogue.label: VictoryRoad_1F_Text_RolandoDefeat
dialogue.text: I had a chance…$

dialogue.label: VictoryRoad_1F_Text_RolandoIntro
dialogue.text: I can see you're good.\nLet me see exactly how good!$

dialogue.label: VictoryRoad_1F_Text_RolandoPostBattle
dialogue.text: Tch!\nI concede, you are better than I!$

dialogue.label: VictoryRoad_1F_Text_NaomiDefeat
dialogue.text: I lost out…\nVICTORY ROAD chose you this time.$

dialogue.label: VictoryRoad_1F_Text_NaomiIntro
dialogue.text: I wonder if you are good enough\nfor me?$

dialogue.label: VictoryRoad_1F_Text_NaomiPostBattle
dialogue.text: I never wanted to lose to anybody,\nespecially to a younger kid…$

dialogue.label: VictoryRoad_1F_Text_ExpertIvoDefeat
dialogue.text: Your judgment held under strain!$

dialogue.label: VictoryRoad_1F_Text_ExpertIvoIntro
dialogue.text: Strength brought you this far.\nNow show me your judgment.$

dialogue.label: VictoryRoad_1F_Text_ExpertIvoPostBattle
dialogue.text: The last climb can tempt you to\nrush. Save enough strength to\pgreet what waits beyond it.$

dialogue.label: VictoryRoad_1F_Text_ExpertKarinaDefeat
dialogue.text: You carried your lessons well!$

dialogue.label: VictoryRoad_1F_Text_ExpertKarinaIntro
dialogue.text: The road ahead tests us all.\nShow me what you have learned.$

dialogue.label: VictoryRoad_1F_Text_ExpertKarinaPostBattle
dialogue.text: I think of every teacher who\nhelped me reach this road.\pLosing gives me one more to\nremember.$

dialogue.label: VictoryRoad_2F_Text_DawsonDefeat
dialogue.text: No!\nYou really do belong on this road.$

dialogue.label: VictoryRoad_2F_Text_DawsonIntro
dialogue.text: If you can get through here,\nyou can go meet the ELITE FOUR.$

dialogue.label: VictoryRoad_2F_Text_DawsonPostBattle
dialogue.text: I can beat you when it comes to\nknowledge about POKéMON!$

dialogue.label: VictoryRoad_2F_Text_DaisukeDefeat
dialogue.text: Atcho!\nEven my focus cracked.$

dialogue.label: VictoryRoad_2F_Text_DaisukeIntro
dialogue.text: This here is VICTORY ROAD.\nIt's the final test for TRAINERS!$

dialogue.label: VictoryRoad_2F_Text_DaisukePostBattle
dialogue.text: If you get stuck, try moving some\nboulders around.$

dialogue.label: VictoryRoad_2F_Text_NelsonDefeat
dialogue.text: You got me!\nThat's ELITE FOUR resolve.$

dialogue.label: VictoryRoad_2F_Text_NelsonIntro
dialogue.text: Ah, so you wish to challenge the\nELITE FOUR?$

dialogue.label: VictoryRoad_2F_Text_NelsonPostBattle
dialogue.text: {RIVAL} also came through here.$

dialogue.label: VictoryRoad_2F_Text_VincentDefeat
dialogue.text: I got whipped on the final road.$

dialogue.label: VictoryRoad_2F_Text_VincentIntro
dialogue.text: Come on!\nI'll whip you!$

dialogue.label: VictoryRoad_2F_Text_VincentPostBattle
dialogue.text: You earned the right to be on\nVICTORY ROAD…$

dialogue.label: VictoryRoad_2F_Text_GregoryDefeat
dialogue.text: Well done!\nYou didn't flinch from the climb.$

dialogue.label: VictoryRoad_2F_Text_GregoryIntro
dialogue.text: Is VICTORY ROAD too tough?$

dialogue.label: VictoryRoad_2F_Text_GregoryPostBattle
dialogue.text: Many TRAINERS give up their\nchallenge here and go home.$

dialogue.label: VictoryRoad_2F_Text_KaiTessDefeat
dialogue.text: You found the gap between us!$

dialogue.label: VictoryRoad_2F_Text_KaiTessIntro
dialogue.text: This cave tests your teamwork.\nShow us how your team works!$

dialogue.label: VictoryRoad_2F_Text_KaiTessNotEnoughMons
dialogue.text: Bring two ready POKéMON\nso we can battle as a pair!$

dialogue.label: VictoryRoad_2F_Text_KaiTessPostBattle
dialogue.text: We cover each other when\nthe going gets tough.$

dialogue.label: VictoryRoad_2F_Text_StevieDefeat
dialogue.text: My training is far from over!$

dialogue.label: VictoryRoad_2F_Text_StevieIntro
dialogue.text: Every cave is a training ground.\nShow me your fighting spirit!$

dialogue.label: VictoryRoad_2F_Text_SteviePostBattle
dialogue.text: Rock Tunnel taught me patience.\nThis road will test my resolve.$

dialogue.label: VictoryRoad_2F_Text_AceTrainerFIrisDefeat
dialogue.text: You know your team well!$

dialogue.label: VictoryRoad_2F_Text_AceTrainerFIrisIntro
dialogue.text: This road tests every weakness.\nHow well do you know your team?$

dialogue.label: VictoryRoad_2F_Text_AceTrainerFIrisPostBattle
dialogue.text: I want to reach the LEAGUE\nwith a team I can trust.$

dialogue.label: VictoryRoad_2F_Text_AceTrainerFTheaDefeat
dialogue.text: You made those moves count!$

dialogue.label: VictoryRoad_2F_Text_AceTrainerFTheaIntro
dialogue.text: Power alone will not be enough.\nMake every move count!$

dialogue.label: VictoryRoad_2F_Text_AceTrainerFTheaPostBattle
dialogue.text: The right move at the right time\ncan change the whole battle.$

dialogue.label: VictoryRoad_3F_Text_GeorgeDefeat
dialogue.text: The rumors were true!$

dialogue.label: VictoryRoad_3F_Text_GeorgeIntro
dialogue.text: I heard rumors of a child prodigy.$

dialogue.label: VictoryRoad_3F_Text_GeorgePostBattle
dialogue.text: So, it was you who beat GIOVANNI\nof TEAM ROCKET?$

dialogue.label: VictoryRoad_3F_Text_AlexaDefeat
dialogue.text: Oh!\nSo strong!$

dialogue.label: VictoryRoad_3F_Text_AlexaIntro
dialogue.text: TRAINERS live to seek stronger\nopponents.$

dialogue.label: VictoryRoad_3F_Text_AlexaPostBattle
dialogue.text: By fighting tough battles, you get\nstronger.$

dialogue.label: VictoryRoad_3F_Text_ColbyDefeat
dialogue.text: I don't believe it!$

dialogue.label: VictoryRoad_3F_Text_ColbyIntro
dialogue.text: Only the chosen can pass here!$

dialogue.label: VictoryRoad_3F_Text_ColbyPostBattle
dialogue.text: All TRAINERS here are headed to\nthe POKéMON LEAGUE.\pDon't let down your guard.$

dialogue.label: VictoryRoad_3F_Text_CarolineDefeat
dialogue.text: I'm furious!$

dialogue.label: VictoryRoad_3F_Text_CarolineIntro
dialogue.text: I'll show you just how good you\nare. Not!$

dialogue.label: VictoryRoad_3F_Text_CarolinePostBattle
dialogue.text: You showed me just how good\nI was…$

dialogue.label: VictoryRoad_3F_Text_RayDefeat
dialogue.text: RAY: Ludicrous!\nThis can't be!$

dialogue.label: VictoryRoad_3F_Text_RayIntro
dialogue.text: RAY: Together, the two of us are\ndestined for greatness!$

dialogue.label: VictoryRoad_3F_Text_RayNotEnoughMons
dialogue.text: RAY: Together, the two of us are\nstriving for the pinnacle.\pWe need you to bring two POKéMON\ninto battle with us.$

dialogue.label: VictoryRoad_3F_Text_RayPostBattle
dialogue.text: RAY: You've beaten us.\nGreatness remains elusive…$

dialogue.label: VictoryRoad_3F_Text_TyraDefeat
dialogue.text: TYRA: Oh, but…$

dialogue.label: VictoryRoad_3F_Text_TyraIntro
dialogue.text: TYRA: We're trying to become\nchampions together.$

dialogue.label: VictoryRoad_3F_Text_TyraNotEnoughMons
dialogue.text: TYRA: You can't battle with us if\nyou have only one POKéMON.$

dialogue.label: VictoryRoad_3F_Text_TyraPostBattle
dialogue.text: TYRA: You've taught me that power\ncan be infinite in shape and form.$

dialogue.label: ViridianChannel_Text_FenAfter
dialogue.text: ROUTE 2 is back to the west.\nI like to stop here before\pheading farther from home.$

dialogue.label: ViridianChannel_Text_FenDefeat
