dialogue.text: That was quite a splash!$

dialogue.label: ViridianChannel_Text_FenIntro
dialogue.text: The bridge shakes when people run.\nThe fish always notice first!$

dialogue.label: ViridianChannel_Text_FenRematch
dialogue.text: Back across the CHANNEL?\nLet's see what you have learned!$

dialogue.label: ViridianChannel_Text_HarlanAfter
dialogue.text: Keep heading east for ROUTE 16.\nFollow the bridges and you can\pcross without entering the water.$

dialogue.label: ViridianChannel_Text_HarlanDefeat
dialogue.text: You reeled that one in!$

dialogue.label: ViridianChannel_Text_HarlanIntro
dialogue.text: I fish from these wide platforms.\nThere is room to let others pass!$

dialogue.label: ViridianChannel_Text_HarlanRematch
dialogue.text: Another crossing, another battle!$

dialogue.label: ViridianChannel_Text_CoralAfter
dialogue.text: The rocks narrow the swimming\nspace here. I stay close to\pthe crossing when I need a rest.$

dialogue.label: ViridianChannel_Text_CoralDefeat
dialogue.text: Time to catch my breath!$

dialogue.label: ViridianChannel_Text_CoralIntro
dialogue.text: The water feels different from\nthe view up on the bridge!$

dialogue.label: ViridianChannel_Text_CoralRematch
dialogue.text: Ready for another round\nout on the water?$

dialogue.label: Common_Text_NeedTwoPokemonForDoubleBattle
dialogue.text: You'll need two POKéMON with you\nfor a DOUBLE BATTLE.$

dialogue.label: ViridianCity_Gym_Text_ExplainEarthBadgeTakeThis
dialogue.text:
The EARTHBADGE is evidence of
your mastery as a TRAINER.\pBut obedience is earned through
the trust recorded in your\lFIELD AIDE work.\pWith all eight BADGES, head west
from VIRIDIAN onto ROUTE 22.\pThen go north through ROUTE 23
and VICTORY ROAD to reach\lthe INDIGO LEAGUE.$

dialogue.label: ViridianCity_Gym_Text_GiovanniDefeat
dialogue.text: Ha!\nThat was a truly intense fight.\lYou have won!\pAs proof, here is the EARTHBADGE!\n{PAUSE_MUSIC}{PLAY_BGM}{MUS_OBTAIN_BADGE}{PAUSE 0xFE}{PAUSE 0x56}{RESUME_MUSIC}$

dialogue.label: ViridianCity_Gym_Text_GiovanniIntro
dialogue.text:
GIOVANNI: You have seen me seek
power in ruins, in industry, and\lbefore MEWTWO itself.\pEvery time, you stood in my way.\pVery well.
No machines. No inventions.\lNo stolen advantage.\pOnly a TRAINER and his team.\pFace GIOVANNI, LEADER of the
VIRIDIAN GYM!{PLAY_BGM}{MUS_ENCOUNTER_ROCKET}$

dialogue.label: ViridianCity_Gym_Text_GiovanniPostBattle
dialogue.text:
GIOVANNI: I chased absolute power
because I mistook control for\lstrength.\pA creature in a vat.
A BALL that never fails.\lA command no one could refuse.\pBut MEWTWO answered control with
defiance.\pMy own POKéMON answered trust.\pYou stood before power without
trying to own it.\pYou trusted your team, and they
trusted you.\pThat is what I had forgotten.
That is what TEAM ROCKET must\llearn.\pAs of today, TEAM ROCKET changes
course.\pNo more shadows.
No more conquest.\pI will begin again, not as a tyrant,
but as a TRAINER.\pFarewell, {PLAYER}.$

dialogue.label: ViridianForest_Text_RickDefeat
dialogue.text: No!\nCATERPIE got tangled up in the\nforest pace!$

dialogue.label: ViridianForest_Text_RickIntro
dialogue.text: Hey! You have POKéMON!\nCome on!\lLet's battle 'em!$

dialogue.label: ViridianForest_Text_RickPostBattle
dialogue.text: Ssh! You'll scare the bugs away.\nAnother time, okay?$

dialogue.label: ViridianForest_Text_DougDefeat
dialogue.text: Huh?\nI ran out of POKéMON!$

dialogue.label: ViridianForest_Text_DougIntro
dialogue.text: Yo!\nYou can't jam out if you're a\lPOKéMON TRAINER!$

dialogue.label: ViridianForest_Text_DougPostBattle
dialogue.text: That totally stinks! I'm going to\ncatch some stronger ones!$

dialogue.label: ViridianForest_Text_SammyDefeat
dialogue.text: I give!\nYou're good at this!$

dialogue.label: ViridianForest_Text_SammyIntro
dialogue.text: Hey, wait up!\nWhat's the hurry? Why the rush?$

dialogue.label: ViridianForest_Text_SammyPostBattle
dialogue.text: Sometimes, you can find stuff on\nthe ground.\pI'm looking for the stuff I\ndropped. Can you help me?$

dialogue.label: ViridianForest_Text_AnthonyDefeat
dialogue.text: Oh, boo.\nNothing went right.$

dialogue.label: ViridianForest_Text_AnthonyIntro
dialogue.text: I might be little, but I won't like\nit if you go easy on me!$

dialogue.label: ViridianForest_Text_AnthonyPostBattle
dialogue.text: I lost some of my allowance…$

dialogue.label: ViridianForest_Text_CharlieDefeat
dialogue.text: Oh!\nGuess evolving fast isn't the same\nas battling well.$

dialogue.label: ViridianForest_Text_CharlieIntro
dialogue.text: Did you know that POKéMON evolve?$

dialogue.label: ViridianForest_Text_CharliePostBattle
dialogue.text: BUG POKéMON evolve quickly.\nThey're a lot of fun!$

dialogue.label: Common_Text_NeedTwoPokemonForDoubleBattle
dialogue.text: You'll need two POKéMON with you\nfor a DOUBLE BATTLE.$

dialogue.label: ViridianForest_Text_ErikaAfterBattle
dialogue.text:
ERIKA: You are remarkably strong.\pThis battle was witnessed, so it
shall stand as your GYM challenge.\pI must confer on you the
RAINBOWBADGE.
{PAUSE_MUSIC}{PLAY_BGM}{MUS_OBTAIN_BADGE}{PAUSE 0xFE}{PAUSE 0x56}{RESUME_MUSIC}\pI saw trust in the way your
POKéMON stood with you.\pFriendship can guide evolution
as surely as sunlight guides\la bud into bloom.\pPlease come to CELADON GYM.
There, I will give a reward for\lthe growth you have shown.$

dialogue.label: ViridianForest_Text_ErikaBattleIntro
dialogue.text: Very well.\pShow me how friendship has helped\nyour POKéMON grow.\pLet us begin.{PLAY_BGM MUS_ENCOUNTER_GYM_LEADER}$

dialogue.label: ViridianForest_Text_ErikaChallenge
dialogue.text:
ERIKA: How fortunate.
That is just the lesson I hoped\lthis forest would offer.\pSome POKéMON bloom only when
friendship has taken root.\pThat kind of evolution is a bond,
not merely a change in form.\pBefore I return, may I ask you for
a proper GYM challenge?\pWith my GYM GUIDE present, the
match will be official.$

dialogue.label: ViridianForest_Text_ErikaDefeat
dialogue.text: Oh!\nI concede defeat.$

dialogue.label: ViridianForest_Text_ErikaLookingForRoot
dialogue.text:
ERIKA: Oh, hello.\pI came to VIRIDIAN FOREST in
search of an ENERGY ROOT.\pRoots are quiet things, yet they
bind a whole garden together.\pA root grown here is said to heal
because the forest shares its\lstrength as one family.\pWild ODDISH and BELLSPROUT
sometimes carry ENERGY ROOTS.\pCatch one here and check its
held item. Bring a root to me.$

dialogue.label: ViridianForest_Text_ErikaShownRoot
dialogue.text:
ERIKA: Oh!
That ENERGY ROOT is splendid.\pSee how many tiny roots gather
into one strong whole?\pIt reminds me that families,
friends, and communities grow\lbest together.\pIf I could find one of my own, I
would gladly return to the GYM.$

dialogue.label: ViridianForest_Text_ExplainRainbowKey
dialogue.text: The RAINBOW KEY opens the\nBERRY PATCH next door to\lCELADON GYM.\pPlease feel free to pick the\nberries growing there.$

dialogue.label: ViridianForest_Text_GymAideTypeAdvice
dialogue.text:
GYM AIDE: Before you battle,
remember ERIKA uses GRASS types.\pFIRE, ICE, FLYING, BUG and POISON
moves are strong against GRASS.\pA second type can change that.
Watch out for status moves, too!$

dialogue.label: ViridianForest_Text_GymGuideFoundErika
dialogue.text:
ERIKA!
I am so glad I found you!\pAnd look, I found an ENERGY ROOT
on the way here.\pIt was tucked among other roots,
all holding the soil together.$

dialogue.label: EventScript_GymAdjacent_AROMA_LADY_NIKKI_Text_Defeat
dialogue.text: Your team made quite an\nimpression!$

dialogue.label: EventScript_GymAdjacent_AROMA_LADY_NIKKI_Text_Intro
dialogue.text: Something sweet is drifting\nfrom deeper in the forest.\pFollow it after our battle!$

dialogue.label: EventScript_GymAdjacent_AROMA_LADY_NIKKI_Text_PostBattle
dialogue.text:
The flowers in VIRIDIAN FOREST
are so beautiful.\pThey seem more vibrant and grow
in number the closer you get to\lthe centre of the forest.\pAlmost like something is drawing
them inward.$

dialogue.label: EventScript_GymAdjacent_AROMA_LADY_NIKKI_Text_RematchIntro
dialogue.text: That rich scent is here\nagain. Let us see what else\phas changed!$

dialogue.label: Text_ApexRumorRecorded
dialogue.text: Rumour recorded.\pCompare three accounts in your\nLOGBOOK to find an APEX POKéMON.\pIf you flee from its battle,\nit will leave for good.$

dialogue.label: Text_ApexRumorUpdated
dialogue.text: Rumour updated.$

dialogue.label: EventScript_GymAdjacent_AROMA_LADY_VIOLET_Text_Defeat
dialogue.text: A stronger blend than mine!$

dialogue.label: EventScript_GymAdjacent_AROMA_LADY_VIOLET_Text_Intro
dialogue.text: I blend scents a little at a\ntime. My battle plan needs\pjust the right balance!$

dialogue.label: EventScript_GymAdjacent_AROMA_LADY_VIOLET_Text_PostBattle
dialogue.text: One strong scent can drown\nout the rest. I give each of\pmy POKéMON room to shine.$

dialogue.label: EventScript_GymAdjacent_AROMA_LADY_VIOLET_Text_RematchIntro
dialogue.text: I adjusted my formula. Would\nyou help me test it?$

dialogue.label: EventScript_GymAdjacent_AROMA_LADY_ROSE_Text_Defeat
dialogue.text: Our moment passed so quickly!$

dialogue.label: EventScript_GymAdjacent_AROMA_LADY_ROSE_Text_Intro
dialogue.text: Some flowers open only in\nshade. My POKéMON are ready\pto come out!$

dialogue.label: EventScript_GymAdjacent_AROMA_LADY_ROSE_Text_PostBattle
dialogue.text: I leave woodland flowers\nwhere they grow. Their roots\pneed more than a vase can\noffer.$

dialogue.label: EventScript_GymAdjacent_AROMA_LADY_ROSE_Text_RematchIntro
dialogue.text: We have rested in the shade.\nTime to bloom again!$

dialogue.label: EventScript_ForestTrainer_BUG_CATCHER_NILES_Text_Defeat
dialogue.text: My surprise came unwrapped!$

dialogue.label: EventScript_ForestTrainer_BUG_CATCHER_NILES_Text_Intro
dialogue.text: See that curled leaf? Something\nbuilt a shelter inside it! My\pbugs have a surprise too!$

dialogue.label: EventScript_ForestTrainer_BUG_CATCHER_NILES_Text_PostBattle
dialogue.text: I leave curled leaves alone. I'd\nhate someone tearing down my\proof to say hello.$

dialogue.label: EventScript_ForestTrainer_BUG_CATCHER_NILES_Text_RematchIntro
dialogue.text: I found more leaf shelters! My\nteam has been busy growing too!$

dialogue.label: EventScript_ForestTrainer_BUG_MANIAC_CEDAR_Text_Defeat
dialogue.text: An unexpected result!$

dialogue.label: EventScript_ForestTrainer_BUG_MANIAC_CEDAR_Text_Intro
dialogue.text: I compare the patterns on shed\nskins. No two finds are quite\palike. Let me study your team!$

dialogue.label: EventScript_ForestTrainer_BUG_MANIAC_CEDAR_Text_PostBattle
dialogue.text: An empty shell isn't a dead bug.\nIt may be proof that something\pis still growing.$

dialogue.label: EventScript_ForestTrainer_BUG_MANIAC_CEDAR_Text_RematchIntro
dialogue.text: New notes, new questions. Shall\nwe test another theory?$

dialogue.label: EventScript_ForestTrainer_PKMN_RANGER_HAZEL_Text_Defeat
dialogue.text: You handled that with care!$

dialogue.label: EventScript_ForestTrainer_PKMN_RANGER_HAZEL_Text_Intro
dialogue.text: I keep fallen branches off the\ntrail. A clear path protects the\pplants beside it. Ready for a\nfield test?$

dialogue.label: EventScript_ForestTrainer_PKMN_RANGER_HAZEL_Text_PostBattle
dialogue.text: I move a branch only as far as I\nneed to. Something may still be\pliving beneath it.$

dialogue.label: EventScript_ForestTrainer_PKMN_RANGER_HAZEL_Text_RematchIntro
dialogue.text: The trail is clear again. Let's\ncheck how your team is doing!$

dialogue.label: EventScript_ForestTrainer_PKMN_BREEDER_ELI_Text_Defeat
dialogue.text: They stayed brave to the end!$

dialogue.label: EventScript_ForestTrainer_PKMN_BREEDER_ELI_Text_Intro
dialogue.text: My young POKéMON startle at\nrustling leaves. We take little\pwalks to build their confidence.$

dialogue.label: EventScript_ForestTrainer_PKMN_BREEDER_ELI_Text_PostBattle
dialogue.text: I let them investigate a sound\nbefore moving on. Confidence\pgrows faster than orders can\nforce it.$

dialogue.label: EventScript_ForestTrainer_PKMN_BREEDER_ELI_Text_RematchIntro
dialogue.text: They recognised your footsteps!\nWould you help with another\plesson?$

dialogue.label: EventScript_ForestTrainer_CAMPER_PAX_Text_Defeat
dialogue.text: I lost your trail!$

dialogue.label: EventScript_ForestTrainer_CAMPER_PAX_Text_Intro
dialogue.text: I follow tracks without\nstepping on them. Try to stay\pahead of my team!$

dialogue.label: EventScript_ForestTrainer_CAMPER_PAX_Text_PostBattle
dialogue.text: Bent grass shows a direction.\nA single print rarely tells\pthe whole story.$

dialogue.label: EventScript_ForestTrainer_CAMPER_PAX_Text_RematchIntro
dialogue.text: Fresh tracks, familiar\ntrainer! Ready for another\pround?$
